```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Lock,
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertTriangle,
  Scale,
  UserCheck,
  ExternalLink,
  Sparkles,
  Info,
  Timer,
  AlertCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  formatYoctoNear,
  calculateLateDueDateInterest,
  LATE_DUE_DATE_APY_PERCENT,
  type BookingStatus,
  type LateDueDateInterestCalculation,
} from '../lib/near/escrowStateMachine';
import { NearTokenIcon, UsdtTokenIcon } from './TokenIcons';

export interface MoneyFlowExplanation {
  status: BookingStatus;
  badgeLabel: string;
  oneSentencePlainExplanation: string;
  whoActsNext: string;
  feeDestinationLabel: string;
  collateralDestinationLabel: string;
  colorClass: string;
}

export function getEscrowStatePlainExplanation(
  status: BookingStatus,
  params: {
    borrower: string;
    lender: string;
    resolver?: string;
    rentalFeeNear: number;
    collateralNear: number;
    damageDeductionNear?: number;
  }
): MoneyFlowExplanation {
  const totalNear = Number((params.rentalFeeNear + params.collateralNear).toFixed(4));
  const resolverId = params.resolver || 'borrowbondtest.testnet';

  switch (status) {
    case 'REQUESTED':
      return {
        status,
        badgeLabel: 'Escrow Funded · Awaiting Lender',
        oneSentencePlainExplanation: `${params.borrower} locked ${totalNear} NEAR (${params.rentalFeeNear} NEAR rental fee + ${params.collateralNear} NEAR refundable collateral) in the escrow contract; if the lender does not accept in time, 100% is refunded automatically.`,
        whoActsNext: `Lender (${params.lender}) must accept or Borrower may cancel for a 100% refund`,
        feeDestinationLabel: `Held in Escrow (${params.rentalFeeNear} NEAR)`,
        collateralDestinationLabel: `Held in Escrow (${params.collateralNear} NEAR)`,
        colorClass: 'text-[#FBBF24] border-[#FBBF24]/40 bg-[#FBBF24]/10',
      };
    case 'ACCEPTED':
    case 'HANDOVER_PENDING':
      return {
        status,
        badgeLabel: 'Accepted · Awaiting Handover',
        oneSentencePlainExplanation: `${params.lender} accepted the booking; funds stay locked in escrow while both parties verify the one-time handover QR code to start the rental.`,
        whoActsNext: `Both Lender (${params.lender}) & Borrower (${params.borrower}) confirm handover QR`,
        feeDestinationLabel: `Reserved for Lender (${params.rentalFeeNear} NEAR)`,
        collateralDestinationLabel: `Protected for Borrower (${params.collateralNear} NEAR)`,
        colorClass: 'text-[#17F1D1] border-[#17F1D1]/40 bg-[#17F1D1]/10',
      };
    case 'ACTIVE':
      return {
        status,
        badgeLabel: 'Active Rental · Protected in Escrow',
        oneSentencePlainExplanation: `The resource is currently in use by ${params.borrower}, while ${totalNear} NEAR remains untouchable inside the NEAR escrow smart contract until return is verified.`,
        whoActsNext: `Borrower (${params.borrower}) initiates return before the rental deadline`,
        feeDestinationLabel: `Accruing for Lender (${params.rentalFeeNear} NEAR)`,
        collateralDestinationLabel: `100% Refundable on Safe Return (${params.collateralNear} NEAR)`,
        colorClass: 'text-[#00EC97] border-[#00EC97]/40 bg-[#00EC97]/10',
      };
    case 'RETURN_REQUESTED':
      return {
        status,
        badgeLabel: 'Return Initiated · TIN/Serial Inspection',
        oneSentencePlainExplanation: `${params.borrower} returned the item; as soon as ${params.lender} confirms the matching Anti-Scam TIN/Serial, the contract pays the fee to the lender and refunds 100% of collateral to the borrower.`,
        whoActsNext: `Lender (${params.lender}) scans Product QR / TIN to release escrow`,
        feeDestinationLabel: `Ready to Release to ${params.lender} (${params.rentalFeeNear} NEAR)`,
        collateralDestinationLabel: `Ready to Refund to ${params.borrower} (${params.collateralNear} NEAR)`,
        colorClass: 'text-[#17F1D1] border-[#17F1D1]/40 bg-[#17F1D1]/10',
      };
    case 'COMPLETED':
      return {
        status,
        badgeLabel: 'Settled & Completed On-Chain',
        oneSentencePlainExplanation: `Return was verified: ${params.rentalFeeNear} NEAR rental fee was paid to ${params.lender}, and 100% of the ${params.collateralNear} NEAR collateral was refunded to ${params.borrower}.`,
        whoActsNext: 'Agreement complete — Claimable balances ready for withdrawal',
        feeDestinationLabel: `Paid to Lender ${params.lender} (${params.rentalFeeNear} NEAR)`,
        collateralDestinationLabel: `Refunded 100% to Borrower ${params.borrower} (${params.collateralNear} NEAR)`,
        colorClass: 'text-[#00EC97] border-[#00EC97]/40 bg-[#00EC97]/15',
      };
    case 'DISPUTED':
      return {
        status,
        badgeLabel: 'Disputed · Escrow Frozen for Review',
        oneSentencePlainExplanation: `A dispute was opened, freezing all ${totalNear} NEAR in the contract so neither party can move funds while the BorrowBond Team (${resolverId}) inspects before/after evidence.`,
        whoActsNext: `Authorized Resolver (${resolverId}) reviews evidence & allocates funds`,
        feeDestinationLabel: `Frozen Pending Arbitration (${params.rentalFeeNear} NEAR)`,
        collateralDestinationLabel: `Frozen Pending Arbitration (${params.collateralNear} NEAR)`,
        colorClass: 'text-[#F87171] border-[#F87171]/40 bg-[#F87171]/10',
      };
    case 'RESOLVED': {
      const dmg = params.damageDeductionNear ?? 0;
      const lenderTotal = Number((params.rentalFeeNear + dmg).toFixed(4));
      const borrowerRefund = Number(Math.max(0, params.collateralNear - dmg).toFixed(4));
      return {
        status,
        badgeLabel: 'Dispute Resolved · Split Settled',
        oneSentencePlainExplanation: `Arbitration completed by ${resolverId}: ${lenderTotal} NEAR (fee + verified damage cost) was credited to ${params.lender}, and the remaining ${borrowerRefund} NEAR collateral was refunded to ${params.borrower}.`,
        whoActsNext: 'Arbitration complete — Settled balances ready for withdrawal',
        feeDestinationLabel: `Credited to Lender (${lenderTotal} NEAR)`,
        collateralDestinationLabel: `Remaining Refunded to Borrower (${borrowerRefund} NEAR)`,
        colorClass: 'text-[#00EC97] border-[#00EC97]/40 bg-[#00EC97]/15',
      };
    }
    case 'CANCELLED':
    case 'REFUNDED':
    case 'EXPIRED':
      return {
        status,
        badgeLabel: status === 'CANCELLED' ? 'Cancelled · 100% Refunded' : status === 'REFUNDED' ? 'Refunded · 100% Returned' : 'Expired · 100% Refunded',
        oneSentencePlainExplanation: `The booking ended before handover, so 100% of the ${totalNear} NEAR deposit (both rental fee and collateral) was refunded to ${params.borrower}.`,
        whoActsNext: 'No action needed — 100% refunded to borrower',
        feeDestinationLabel: `Refunded to Borrower (${params.rentalFeeNear} NEAR)`,
        collateralDestinationLabel: `Refunded to Borrower (${params.collateralNear} NEAR)`,
        colorClass: 'text-[#9BA8C0] border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/40',
      };
  }
}

const LIFECYCLE_STEPS: { status: BookingStatus; shortTitle: string; actor: string }[] = [
  { status: 'REQUESTED', shortTitle: '1. Lock Escrow', actor: 'Borrower' },
  { status: 'ACCEPTED', shortTitle: '2. Accept Terms', actor: 'Lender' },
  { status: 'ACTIVE', shortTitle: '3. QR Handover', actor: 'Both Parties' },
  { status: 'RETURN_REQUESTED', shortTitle: '4. Initiate Return', actor: 'Borrower' },
  { status: 'COMPLETED', shortTitle: '5. Verify TIN & Settle', actor: 'Lender / Contract' },
];

interface EscrowMoneyFlowCardProps {
  status?: BookingStatus;
  state?: BookingStatus;
  rentalFeeNear: number;
  collateralNear: number;
  nearUsdRate?: number;
  borrowerWallet: string;
  lenderWallet: string;
  contractAddress: string;
  resolverWallet?: string;
  damageDeductionNear?: number;
  txHash?: string;
  deadlineIso?: string;
  expectedExpiryIso?: string;
  isVerifiedOnChain?: boolean;
  interactivePreview?: boolean;
}

export const EscrowMoneyFlowCard: React.FC<EscrowMoneyFlowCardProps> = ({
  status,
  state,
  rentalFeeNear,
  collateralNear,
  nearUsdRate = 3.7,
  borrowerWallet,
  lenderWallet,
  contractAddress,
  resolverWallet = 'borrowbondtest.testnet',
  damageDeductionNear = 0,
  txHash,
  deadlineIso,
  expectedExpiryIso,
  interactivePreview = false,
}) => {
  const initialStatus: BookingStatus = status || state || 'REQUESTED';
  const resolvedDeadlineIso = deadlineIso || expectedExpiryIso;
  const [previewStatus, setPreviewStatus] = useState<BookingStatus>(initialStatus);
  const effectiveStatus = interactivePreview ? previewStatus : initialStatus;

  const totalNear = Number((rentalFeeNear + collateralNear).toFixed(4));
  const totalUsdt = Number((totalNear * nearUsdRate).toFixed(2));
  const feeUsdt = Number((rentalFeeNear * nearUsdRate).toFixed(2));
  const colUsdt = Number((collateralNear * nearUsdRate).toFixed(2));

  const flowInfo = getEscrowStatePlainExplanation(effectiveStatus, {
    borrower: borrowerWallet,
    lender: lenderWallet,
    resolver: resolverWallet,
    rentalFeeNear,
    collateralNear,
    damageDeductionNear,
  });

  // Smart Real-Time Countdown Tick Hook (updates every 1 second)
  const [nowMs, setNowMs] = useState<number>(Date.now());
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setNowMs(Date.now());
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const lateCalc: LateDueDateInterestCalculation | null = useMemo(() => {
    if (!resolvedDeadlineIso) return null;
    return calculateLateDueDateInterest(
      {
        rentalEndIso: resolvedDeadlineIso,
        collateralNear,
        lender: lenderWallet,
        borrower: borrowerWallet,
      },
      new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
      nearUsdRate
    );
  }, [resolvedDeadlineIso, collateralNear, lenderWallet, borrowerWallet, nowMs, nearUsdRate]);

  // Remaining time / overdue label
  const deadlineLabel = (() => {
    if (!lateCalc) return '24h Handover / 72h Rental Window';
    if (!lateCalc.isOverdue) {
      return `${lateCalc.remainingFormatted} remaining`;
    }
    return `Overdue by ${lateCalc.overdueFormatted} (3% APY accruing)`;
  })();

  const activeStepIndex = (() => {
    if (effectiveStatus === 'COMPLETED' || effectiveStatus === 'RESOLVED') return 4;
    if (effectiveStatus === 'RETURN_REQUESTED') return 3;
    if (effectiveStatus === 'ACTIVE' || effectiveStatus === 'DISPUTED') return 2;
    if (effectiveStatus === 'ACCEPTED') return 1;
    return 0;
  })();

  return (
    <div className="near-glow-card rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-5 border border-[#00EC97]/35">
      {/* Header Row + Real On-Chain vs Simulated Badge */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800/80 pb-3.5">
        <div className="space-y-0.5">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[#00EC97] uppercase tracking-wider">
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Programmable NEAR Escrow Money Flow</span>
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-extrabold font-display text-[#F5F8FF]">
            Rental Fee vs. Refundable Collateral Flow
          </h3>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {txHash ? (
            <a
              href={`https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/${txHash}`}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#00EC97]/15 border border-[#00EC97]/45 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[#00EC97] inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:underline"
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>On-Chain Tx: {txHash.slice(0, 10)}...</span>
              <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
            </a>
          ) : (
            <span
              title="Contract borrowbondtest.testnet is deployed live on NEAR Testnet; this booking state is currently in the interactive demo ledger until signed with a funded NEAR wallet."
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#0D1322] border border-slate-700 text-[11px] font-mono text-[#17F1D1] inline-flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <Info className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00EC97]" />
              <span>Contract: {contractAddress} (Simulated Demo State)</span>
            </span>
          )}

          <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono font-bold ${flowInfo.colorClass}`}>
            {flowInfo.badgeLabel}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Interactive State Simulator Bar (when in Preview/Checkout Mode) */}
      {interactivePreview && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 text-xs">
          <span className="text-[#9BA8C0] font-medium pl-1">
            Interactive State Preview (click to inspect how funds move at each stage):
          </span>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            {(['REQUESTED', 'ACCEPTED', 'ACTIVE', 'RETURN_REQUESTED', 'COMPLETED', 'DISPUTED', 'RESOLVED'] as BookingStatus[]).map(
              (st) => (
                <button
                  key={st}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPreviewStatus(st)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-mono text-[10px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    effectiveStatus === st
                      ? 'bg-[#00EC97] text-[#04080E]'
                      : 'bg-[#0D1322] text-[#9BA8C0] hover:text-[#F5F8FF]'
                  }`}
                >
                  {st}
                </button>
              )
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* One-Sentence Plain-Language Explanation Banner */}
      <div
        role="status"
        aria-live="polite"
        className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#06080F]/90 border border-[#00EC97]/30 flex items-start gap-3"
      >
        <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00EC97] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div className="space-y-1 text-xs">
          <div className="font-bold text-[#F5F8FF]">
            Plain-Language Escrow Status ({effectiveStatus}):
          </div>
          <p className="text-[#9BA8C0] leading-relaxed text-xs sm:text-sm">
            {flowInfo.oneSentencePlainExplanation}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Smart Countdown for Borrowers & 3% APY Due-Date Continuing Interest System */}
      {lateCalc && (
        <div
          role="region"
          aria-label="Smart Rental Countdown and Due Date Interest"
          className={`p-4 rounded-xl border transition-all ${
            lateCalc.isOverdue
              ? 'bg-[#F87171]/12 border-[#F87171]/50 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(248,113,113,0.22)]'
              : lateCalc.urgencyLevel === 'DUE_SOON'
              ? 'bg-[#FBBF24]/10 border-[#FBBF24]/40 shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(251,191,36,0.18)]'
              : 'bg-[#00EC97]/8 border-[#00EC97]/30'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2.5 border-b border-slate-800/80 pb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Timer
                className={`w-4 h-4 ${
                  lateCalc.isOverdue
                    ? 'text-[#F87171] animate-pulse'
                    : lateCalc.urgencyLevel === 'DUE_SOON'
                    ? 'text-[#FBBF24] animate-pulse'
                    : 'text-[#00EC97]'
                }`}
              />
              <span className="font-bold text-xs text-[#F5F8FF]">
                Smart Borrower Rental Countdown
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span
                className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-mono font-bold tracking-wider inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${
                  lateCalc.isOverdue
                    ? 'bg-[#F87171]/20 text-[#F87171] border border-[#F87171]/60'
                    : lateCalc.urgencyLevel === 'DUE_SOON'
                    ? 'bg-[#FBBF24]/20 text-[#FBBF24] border border-[#FBBF24]/60'
                    : 'bg-[#00EC97]/20 text-[#00EC97] border border-[#00EC97]/60'
                }`}
              >
                <span
                  className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                    lateCalc.isOverdue
                      ? 'bg-[#F87171] animate-ping'
                      : lateCalc.urgencyLevel === 'DUE_SOON'
                      ? 'bg-[#FBBF24] animate-ping'
                      : 'bg-[#00EC97]'
                  }`}
                />
                {lateCalc.isOverdue
                  ? 'OVERDUE · 3% APY LATE INTEREST ACCRUING'
                  : lateCalc.urgencyLevel === 'DUE_SOON'
                  ? 'DUE SOON (< 24 HOURS)'
                  : 'ON SCHEDULE'}
              </span>

              {resolvedDeadlineIso && (
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#9BA8C0]">
                  Due: {new Date(resolvedDeadlineIso).toLocaleDateString()} {new Date(resolvedDeadlineIso).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-3 items-center">
            {/* Countdown Tick-by-Tick Boxes */}
            <div className="md:col-span-5 flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-1.5 font-mono text-center">
              {(() => {
                const totalSec = Math.floor((lateCalc.isOverdue ? lateCalc.overdueMs : lateCalc.remainingMs) / 1000);
                const s = totalSec % 60;
                const m = Math.floor(totalSec / 60) % 60;
                const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600) % 24;
                const d = Math.floor(totalSec / 86400);

                const units = [
                  { val: d, label: 'DAYS' },
                  { val: h, label: 'HOURS' },
                  { val: m, label: 'MINS' },
                  { val: s, label: 'SECS' },
                ];

                return (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full">
                    {units.map((u, i) => (
                      <React.Fragment key={u.label}>
                        <div
                          className={`flex-1 p-2 rounded-xl border text-center ${
                            lateCalc.isOverdue
                              ? 'bg-[#150B10] border-[#F87171]/45 text-[#F87171]'
                              : lateCalc.urgencyLevel === 'DUE_SOON'
                              ? 'bg-[#16130A] border-[#FBBF24]/40 text-[#FBBF24]'
                              : 'bg-[#06080F] border-slate-800 text-[#F5F8FF]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <div className="text-base sm:text-lg font-extrabold tabular-nums">
                            {String(u.val).padStart(2, '0')}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[9px] text-[#9BA8C0] font-bold tracking-wider">
                            {u.label}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        {i < units.length - 1 && (
                          <span
                            className={`font-bold text-xs ${
                              lateCalc.isOverdue
                                ? 'text-[#F87171]'
                                : lateCalc.urgencyLevel === 'DUE_SOON'
                                ? 'text-[#FBBF24]'
                                : 'text-[#00EC97]'
                            }`}
                          >
                            :
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </React.Fragment>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                );
              })()}
            </div>

            {/* Accrued Late Fee / Due Date Policy Explanation */}
            <div className="md:col-span-7 space-y-1 text-xs">
              {lateCalc.isOverdue ? (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1">
                    <span className="font-extrabold text-[#F87171] flex items-center gap-1">
                      <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>3.00% APY Continuing Late Interest:</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-extrabold text-[#F87171] tabular-nums text-sm">
                      +{lateCalc.accruedLateFeeNear} NEAR{' '}
                      <span className="text-xs text-[#FCA5A5]">(${lateCalc.accruedLateFeeUsdt} USDT)</span>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[#E2E8F0] leading-relaxed text-[11px]">
                    {lateCalc.noticeMessage}
                  </p>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#9BA8C0] flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>Accrual: +{lateCalc.interestPerSecondNear} NEAR/sec</span>
                    <span>Collateral Cap: 50% max ({lateCalc.maxLateFeeNear} NEAR)</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-[#F5F8FF]">
                      Due-Date Protection (3.00% APY Policy)
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#00EC97]">0.0000 NEAR late fees</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[#9BA8C0] leading-relaxed text-[11px]">
                    Return before the deadline to receive 100% of your {collateralNear} NEAR refundable collateral. If returned past the due date, a continuous 3.00% APY interest fee accrues per second and is deducted upon handover.
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3-Column Animated Money Flow Diagram: Borrower -> Escrow Contract -> Settlement */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 items-stretch">
        {/* Column 1: Borrower Deposit */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#9BA8C0] uppercase">01 · Borrower Deposit</span>
            <div className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-[#F5F8FF] truncate">{borrowerWallet}</div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5 py-2 border-y border-slate-800/80 text-xs">
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-[#9BA8C0]">Rental Fee:</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-[#F5F8FF] tabular-nums">
                {rentalFeeNear} NEAR (${feeUsdt})
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-[#9BA8C0]">50% Collateral:</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-[#00EC97] tabular-nums">
                {collateralNear} NEAR (${colUsdt})
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-[#9BA8C0]">Total Lock:</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-extrabold text-[#17F1D1] tabular-nums inline-flex items-center gap-1">
              <NearTokenIcon size={13} />
              <span>{totalNear} NEAR</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#9BA8C0]">(${totalUsdt})</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Column 2: NEAR Smart Contract Vault (Animated Pulse) */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#0B1324] border border-[#00EC97]/45 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 relative overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#00EC97] font-bold uppercase">
              02 · NEAR Escrow Vault
            </span>
            <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00EC97]" />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2 my-auto">
            <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#F5F8FF] truncate">{contractAddress}</div>
            {/* Animated Flow Track */}
            <div className="relative h-2 rounded-full bg-[#06080F] overflow-hidden border border-slate-800">
              <motion.div
                animate={{ x: ['-100%', '100%'] }}
                transition={{ duration: 2.4, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}
                className="w-1/2 h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#00EC97] to-[#17F1D1]"
              />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#9BA8C0]">
              Holds <strong className="text-[#F5F8FF] font-mono">{totalNear} NEAR</strong> in isolated contract storage. No AI or single party can withdraw unilaterally.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#17F1D1] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>Pull-Payment Security</span>
            <span>NEP-141 / NEAR</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Column 3: Dual Settlement Destination (Fee -> Lender, Collateral -> Borrower) */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2.5">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#9BA8C0] uppercase">
            03 · Automatic Split Settlement
          </span>

          {/* Stream A: Rental Fee -> Lender */}
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0D1322] border border-slate-800 space-y-1 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
              <span className="text-[#9BA8C0] flex items-center gap-1">
                <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00EC97]" />
                <span>Rental Fee → Lender</span>
              </span>
              <UsdtTokenIcon size={12} />
            </div>
            <div className="font-mono font-bold text-[#F5F8FF] text-xs truncate">
              {flowInfo.feeDestinationLabel}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Stream B: Refundable Collateral -> Borrower */}
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#00EC97]/10 border border-[#00EC97]/35 space-y-1 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
              <span className="text-[#00EC97] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Collateral → Borrower</span>
              </span>
              <NearTokenIcon size={12} />
            </div>
            <div className="font-mono font-bold text-[#00EC97] text-xs truncate">
              {flowInfo.collateralDestinationLabel}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Live 5-Stage Lifecycle Stepper + Who Must Act Next & Countdown */}
      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 space-y-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
          {LIFECYCLE_STEPS.map((step, idx) => {
            const isDone = idx < activeStepIndex || effectiveStatus === 'COMPLETED' || effectiveStatus === 'RESOLVED';
            const isCurrent = idx === activeStepIndex && effectiveStatus !== 'COMPLETED' && effectiveStatus !== 'RESOLVED';
            return (
              <div
                key={step.status}
                className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs transition-all ${
                  isCurrent
                    ? 'bg-[#00EC97]/15 border-[#00EC97] text-[#F5F8FF]'
                    : isDone
                    ? 'bg-[#0D1322]/90 border-[#00EC97]/35 text-[#00EC97]'
                    : 'bg-[#06080F]/70 border-slate-800/80 text-[#9BA8C0]'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="font-bold text-[11px] truncate">{step.shortTitle}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-mono opacity-80 truncate">Actor: {step.actor}</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs bg-[#06080F] px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00EC97] shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-[#9BA8C0]">Next Required Action:</span>
            <strong className="text-[#F5F8FF]">{flowInfo.whoActsNext}</strong>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 font-mono text-[11px]">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[#17F1D1]">
              <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{deadlineLabel}</span>
            </span>

            {effectiveStatus === 'DISPUTED' && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[#F87171]">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Arbitration Active</span>
              </span>
            )}
            {effectiveStatus === 'RESOLVED' && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[#00EC97]">
                <Scale className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Resolved</span>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Expandable Technical Detail for yoctoNEAR (No Jargon by Default) */}
        <details className="text-[11px] text-[#9BA8C0] bg-[#06080F]/60 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-800/60">
          <summary className="cursor-pointer font-mono text-[#9BA8C0] hover:text-[#F5F8FF] select-none">
            Technical On-Chain Units &amp; Contract Method Details (Expandable)
          </summary>
          <div className="pt-2 mt-2 border-t border-slate-800/70 space-y-1 font-mono text-[11px]">
            <div>
              Contract Account: <span className="text-[#00EC97]">{contractAddress}</span> · Network:{' '}
              <span className="text-[#17F1D1]">NEAR Testnet</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              Attached Deposit (yoctoNEAR):{' '}
              <span className="text-[#F5F8FF]">{formatYoctoNear(totalNear)} yoctoNEAR</span> (1 NEAR = 10²⁴ yoctoNEAR)
            </div>
            <div>
              Contract Methods: <code>create_booking</code> → <code>accept_booking</code> →{' '}
              <code>confirm_handover</code> → <code>request_return</code> → <code>confirm_return</code> /{' '}
              <code>resolve_dispute_with_damage_deduction</code>
            </div>
          </div>
        </details>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import {
  Sparkles,
  Wallet,
  PlusCircle,
  LayoutGrid,
  Shield,
  Menu,
  Home,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { BorrowBondBrandLogo, BorrowBondWordmark } from './TokenIcons';

export type AppView =
  | 'LANDING'
  | 'MARKETPLACE'
  | 'LISTING_DETAILS'
  | 'CREATE_LISTING'
  | 'AI_AGENT'
  | 'CHECKOUT'
  | 'DASHBOARD'
  | 'TRANSACTION_DETAILS'
  | 'WHITEPAPER';

export type ThemeMode = 'night' | 'day' | 'system';

interface NavbarProps {
  currentView: AppView;
  onNavigate: (view: AppView) => void;
  connectedWallet: string | null;
  nearNetwork?: 'mainnet' | 'testnet';
  userDisplayName?: string;
  userAvatarUrl?: string;
  onOpenWalletModal: () => void;
  onOpenSideMenu?: () => void;
  onOpenBeginnerGuide?: () => void;
  nearUsdRate?: number;
  displayCurrency?: 'NEAR' | 'USDT';
  onToggleCurrency?: (currency: 'NEAR' | 'USDT') => void;
  themeMode?: ThemeMode;
  onChangeThemeMode?: (mode: ThemeMode) => void;
}

export const Navbar: React.FC<NavbarProps> = ({
  currentView,
  onNavigate,
  connectedWallet,
  userDisplayName,
  userAvatarUrl,
  onOpenWalletModal,
  onOpenSideMenu,
}) => {
  const navItems: {
    label: string;
    mobileLabel: string;
    ariaLabel: string;
    view: AppView;
    icon: React.ReactNode;
  }[] = [
    {
      label: 'Explore',
      mobileLabel: 'Explore',
      ariaLabel: 'Explore Marketplace',
      view: 'MARKETPLACE',
      icon: <LayoutGrid className="w-4 h-4" />,
    },
    {
      label: 'AI Agent',
      mobileLabel: 'AI Agent',
      ariaLabel: 'AI Agent',
      view: 'AI_AGENT',
      icon: <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />,
    },
    {
      label: 'List Item',
      mobileLabel: 'List Item',
      ariaLabel: 'List Resource',
      view: 'CREATE_LISTING',
      icon: <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />,
    },
    {
      label: 'Dashboard',
      mobileLabel: 'Dashboard',
      ariaLabel: 'Dashboard',
      view: 'DASHBOARD',
      icon: <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />,
    },
  ];

  const isViewActive = (target: AppView) => {
    if (currentView === target) return true;
    if (target === 'MARKETPLACE' && (currentView === 'LISTING_DETAILS' || currentView === 'CHECKOUT')) {
      return true;
    }
    if (target === 'DASHBOARD' && currentView === 'TRANSACTION_DETAILS') {
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Clean Fintech Top Header */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 px-4 sm:px-6 h-16 bg-[#0C100D]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#27312A] flex items-center">
        <div className="max-w-6xl w-full mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          {/* Left: BorrowBond Logo + Desktop Primary Navigation */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-8">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="BorrowBond Home"
              onClick={() => {
                onNavigate('LANDING');
                if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
                  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
                }
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-left focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[#8BD6A7] cursor-pointer shrink-0 group"
            >
              <BorrowBondBrandLogo size={34} />
              <BorrowBondWordmark className="text-lg" />
            </button>

            <nav aria-label="Main Navigation" className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {navItems.map((item) => {
                const active = isViewActive(item.view);
                return (
                  <button
                    key={item.view}
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={item.ariaLabel}
                    onClick={() => onNavigate(item.view)}
                    className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer glass-nav-pill ${
                      active
                        ? 'glass-nav-pill-active text-[#F2F5F1]'
                        : 'text-[#A0AAA2] hover:text-[#F2F5F1]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </nav>
          </div>

          {/* Right: Connect Wallet + More Menu */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenWalletModal}
              className="btn-near-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm whitespace-nowrap max-w-[170px] sm:max-w-none truncate"
            >
              <Wallet className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-[#8BD6A7]" />
              <span className="truncate">
                {connectedWallet ? connectedWallet : 'Connect Wallet'}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Open More Menu"
              onClick={onOpenSideMenu}
              className="btn-near-secondary px-3.5 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0"
              title="More: Whitepaper, Roadmap, Terms, Privacy & Settings"
            >
              {userAvatarUrl && (
                <img
                  src={userAvatarUrl}
                  alt={userDisplayName || 'Account'}
                  className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full object-cover"
                />
              )}
              <Menu className="w-4 h-4 text-[#A0AAA2]" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline text-xs font-medium text-[#F2F5F1]">More</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Floating Bottom Glass Pill Dock (Matches Attached Telegram-Style Glass Capsule) */}
      <nav
        aria-label="Floating Bottom Glass Navigation"
        className="fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 w-[min(94vw,460px)] rounded-full p-1.5 liquid-glass-dock"
      >
        <div className="grid grid-cols-5 items-center gap-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Home"
            onClick={() => {
              onNavigate('LANDING');
              if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
                window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
              }
            }}
            className={`py-2 px-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium cursor-pointer glass-nav-pill ${
              currentView === 'LANDING'
                ? 'glass-nav-pill-active text-[#8BD6A7]'
                : 'text-[#A0AAA2] hover:text-[#F2F5F1]'
            }`}
          >
            <Home className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Home</span>
          </button>

          {navItems.map((item) => {
            const active = isViewActive(item.view);
            return (
              <button
                key={item.view}
                type="button"
                aria-label={item.ariaLabel}
                onClick={() => onNavigate(item.view)}
                className={`py-2 px-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium cursor-pointer glass-nav-pill ${
                  active
                    ? 'glass-nav-pill-active text-[#8BD6A7]'
                    : 'text-[#A0AAA2] hover:text-[#F2F5F1]'
                }`}
              >
                {item.icon}
                <span className="truncate max-w-full">{item.mobileLabel}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </nav>
    </>
  );
};
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import {
  QrCode,
  Camera,
  Upload,
  CheckCircle2,
  X,
  Sparkles,
  ShieldCheck,
  Copy,
  RefreshCw,
  ScanLine,
  Smartphone,
  AlertCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
  Cpu,
  SwitchCamera,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  verifyProductQrAgainstOnChainListing,
  type ProductTrustVerificationResult,
} from '../lib/security/policyEngine';

export interface ProductHardwareSpecs {
  brand: string;
  model: string;
  serialOrTin: string;
  category: string;
  processorOrSensor?: string;
  displayOrOptics?: string;
  storageOrMemory?: string;
  keyFeatures?: string[];
  accessoriesIncluded?: string[];
  conditionGrade?: string;
  officialMsrpUsd?: number;
  recommendedCollateralUsd?: number;
  antiTamperHash?: string;
}

export interface ScannedProductQrPayload {
  rawText: string;
  listingId?: string;
  title: string;
  brandAndModel: string;
  tinOrSerialNumber: string;
  category?: string;
  resourceType?: 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL';
  officialRetailPriceUsd?: number;
  recommendedCollateralUsd?: number;
  oneTimeHandoverCode?: string;
  contractAddress?: string;
  description?: string;
  specs?: ProductHardwareSpecs;
}

export function encodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(payload: {
  listingId?: string;
  title: string;
  brandAndModel: string;
  tinOrSerialNumber: string;
  category?: string;
  resourceType?: 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL';
  officialRetailPriceUsd?: number;
  oneTimeHandoverCode?: string;
  contractAddress?: string;
}): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (payload.listingId) params.set('id', payload.listingId);
  params.set('title', payload.title);
  params.set('brand', payload.brandAndModel);
  params.set('tin', payload.tinOrSerialNumber);
  if (payload.category) params.set('cat', payload.category);
  if (payload.resourceType) params.set('type', payload.resourceType);
  if (payload.officialRetailPriceUsd) params.set('msrp', String(payload.officialRetailPriceUsd));
  if (payload.oneTimeHandoverCode) params.set('code', payload.oneTimeHandoverCode);
  params.set('contract', payload.contractAddress || 'borrowbondtest.testnet');
  return `borrowbond://product?${params.toString()}`;
}

export function decodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(rawInput: string): ScannedProductQrPayload {
  const trimmed = rawInput.trim();

  // Helper to construct a deterministic anti-tamper hash from brand, model, and serial
  const makeAntiTamperHash = (brand: string, model: string, serial: string) => {
    let h = 2166136261;
    const str = `${brand}::${model}::${serial}::borrowbond.testnet`;
    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
      h ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
      h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
    }
    return `SHA256-${Math.abs(h).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}7f9a2b`;
  };

  // 1. Parse borrowbond://product?... URI or URL with query parameters FIRST
  if (trimmed.startsWith('borrowbond://') || trimmed.includes('?') || trimmed.startsWith('http')) {
    try {
      const queryPart = trimmed.includes('?') ? trimmed.split('?')[1] : trimmed;
      const params = new URLSearchParams(queryPart);
      const tin = params.get('tin') || 'TIN-BB-VERIFIED-001';
      const title = params.get('title') || params.get('brand') || `Verified Product (${tin})`;
      const brand = params.get('brand') || title;
      const msrp = Number(params.get('msrp')) || 1000;
      const cat = params.get('cat') || 'Cameras & Optics';
      const code = params.get('code') || undefined;
      const id = params.get('id') || undefined;

      const upper = `${title} ${brand} ${tin}`.toUpperCase();
      let specs: ProductHardwareSpecs;

      if (upper.includes('SONY') || upper.includes('A7IV')) {
        specs = {
          brand: 'Sony',
          model: 'Alpha 7 IV + FE 24-70mm f/2.8 GM II Kit',
          serialOrTin: tin,
          category: 'Cameras & Optics',
          processorOrSensor: '33MP Full-Frame Exmor R BSI CMOS & BIONZ XR Processing Engine',
          displayOrOptics: 'FE 24-70mm f/2.8 GM II (82mm Filter, Dual XD Linear Motors)',
          storageOrMemory: 'Dual CFexpress Type A / SD UHS-II Media Slots',
          keyFeatures: [
            '4K 60p 10-bit 4:2:2 All-Intra Recording',
            '759-Point Phase Detection AF with Real-Time Eye AF',
            '5.5-stop 5-axis Optical In-Body Image Stabilization',
          ],
          accessoriesIncluded: [
            '2x Sony NP-FZ100 Batteries',
            'Dual Bay Rapid Charger',
            'Pelican 1510 Waterproof Hard Case',
          ],
          conditionGrade: 'Mint (Grade A+)',
          officialMsrpUsd: msrp,
          recommendedCollateralUsd: Number((msrp / 2).toFixed(2)),
          antiTamperHash: makeAntiTamperHash('Sony', 'Alpha 7 IV', tin),
        };
      } else if (upper.includes('IP18') || upper.includes('IPHONE') || upper.includes('AAPL')) {
        specs = {
          brand: 'Apple',
          model: 'iPhone 18 Pro Max (256GB / 32GB Silver)',
          serialOrTin: tin,
          category: 'Mobile & Flagship Devices',
          processorOrSensor: 'Apple A19 Pro (3nm GAA Next-Gen Neural Engine)',
          displayOrOptics: '6.9" Super Retina XDR OLED (120Hz ProMotion, 3000 nits)',
          storageOrMemory: '256GB NVMe High-Speed Storage / 32GB Unified Memory',
          keyFeatures: [
            '48MP Quad-Pixel Triple Pro Camera System',
            'LiDAR Scanner & 3D Spatial Video Capture',
            'Grade 5 Titanium Chassis in Silver Matte',
          ],
          accessoriesIncluded: [
            'Braided USB-C Fast Charge Cable',
            'MagSafe Clear Case',
            'Original Box',
          ],
          conditionGrade: 'Mint (Grade A+)',
          officialMsrpUsd: msrp,
          recommendedCollateralUsd: Number((msrp / 2).toFixed(2)),
          antiTamperHash: makeAntiTamperHash('Apple', 'iPhone 18 Pro Max', tin),
        };
      } else {
        specs = {
          brand,
          model: title,
          serialOrTin: tin,
          category: cat,
          processorOrSensor: 'Manufacturer Factory Specification',
          displayOrOptics: 'Calibrated OEM Standard',
          storageOrMemory: 'Standard Configuration',
          keyFeatures: ['On-Chain Verifiable QR Tag', 'Near Testnet Escrow Protected'],
          accessoriesIncluded: ['OEM Accessories Kit'],
          conditionGrade: 'Verified (Grade A)',
          officialMsrpUsd: msrp,
          recommendedCollateralUsd: Number((msrp / 2).toFixed(2)),
          antiTamperHash: makeAntiTamperHash(brand, title, tin),
        };
      }

      return {
        rawText: trimmed,
        listingId: id,
        title,
        brandAndModel: brand,
        tinOrSerialNumber: tin,
        category: cat,
        resourceType: (params.get('type') as 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL') || 'PHYSICAL',
        officialRetailPriceUsd: msrp,
        recommendedCollateralUsd: Number((msrp / 2).toFixed(2)),
        oneTimeHandoverCode: code,
        contractAddress: params.get('contract') || 'borrowbondtest.testnet',
        description: `${brand} — Verified via BorrowBond Anti-Scam QR Tag (${tin}). Official Retail: $${msrp} USD.`,
        specs,
      };
    } catch {
      // Fall through to JSON or plain serial
    }
  }

  // 2. Parse JSON QR payload if formatted as JSON
  if (trimmed.startsWith('{') && trimmed.endsWith('}')) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
      const tin = parsed.tinOrSerialNumber || parsed.tin || parsed.serial || 'TIN-BB-JSON-001';
      const title = parsed.title || parsed.brandAndModel || `Scanned Resource (${tin})`;
      const brand = parsed.brand || parsed.brandAndModel || title;
      const msrp = Number(parsed.officialRetailPriceUsd) || 1000;
      return {
        rawText: trimmed,
        listingId: parsed.listingId || parsed.id,
        title,
        brandAndModel: parsed.brandAndModel || title,
        tinOrSerialNumber: tin,
        category: parsed.category || 'Cameras & Optics',
        resourceType: parsed.resourceType === 'DIGITAL' ? 'DIGITAL' : 'PHYSICAL',
        officialRetailPriceUsd: msrp,
        recommendedCollateralUsd: Number((msrp / 2).toFixed(2)),
        oneTimeHandoverCode: parsed.oneTimeHandoverCode,
        contractAddress: parsed.contractAddress || 'borrowbondtest.testnet',
        description:
          parsed.description ||
          `${title} (${tin}) — Verified via BorrowBond QR Scanner on NEAR Testnet.`,
        specs: parsed.specs || {
          brand,
          model: title,
          serialOrTin: tin,
          category: parsed.category || 'Hardware Equipment',
          processorOrSensor: parsed.processor || 'OEM Chipset',
          displayOrOptics: parsed.optics || 'Factory Calibrated',
          storageOrMemory: parsed.storage || 'Internal Memory',
          keyFeatures: parsed.keyFeatures || ['Encrypted QR Signature', 'NEAR Smart Contract Escrow'],
          accessoriesIncluded: parsed.accessories || ['Complete Packaging'],
          conditionGrade: parsed.conditionGrade || 'Verified (Grade A)',
          officialMsrpUsd: msrp,
          recommendedCollateralUsd: Number((msrp / 2).toFixed(2)),
          antiTamperHash: makeAntiTamperHash(brand, title, tin),
        },
      };
    } catch {
      // Fall through
    }
  }

  // 3. Plain serial or model string detection
  const upper = trimmed.toUpperCase();
  if (upper.includes('IP18') || upper.includes('IPHONE') || upper.includes('AAPL')) {
    const tin = upper.includes('TIN-') ? trimmed : 'TIN-AAPL-IP18PM-994821';
    return {
      rawText: trimmed,
      title: 'iPhone 18 Pro Max — 256/32GB Titanium Silver',
      brandAndModel: 'Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max (256GB / 32GB Silver)',
      tinOrSerialNumber: tin,
      category: 'Mobile & Flagship Devices',
      resourceType: 'PHYSICAL',
      officialRetailPriceUsd: 1000,
      recommendedCollateralUsd: 500,
      oneTimeHandoverCode: 'BB-IP18-7741',
      contractAddress: 'borrowbondtest.testnet',
      description:
        'Official retail configuration: iPhone 18 Pro Max 256GB storage / 32GB unified memory in Titanium Silver ($1,000 USD official retail price). Verified by BorrowBond Anti-Scam QR Tag.',
      specs: {
        brand: 'Apple',
        model: 'iPhone 18 Pro Max (256GB / 32GB Silver)',
        serialOrTin: tin,
        category: 'Mobile & Flagship Devices',
        processorOrSensor: 'Apple A19 Pro (3nm GAA Next-Gen Neural Engine)',
        displayOrOptics: '6.9" Super Retina XDR OLED (120Hz ProMotion, 3000 nits)',
        storageOrMemory: '256GB NVMe High-Speed Storage / 32GB Unified Memory',
        keyFeatures: [

      },
    };
  }

  if (upper.includes('SONY') || upper.includes('A7IV')) {
    const tin = upper.includes('TIN-') ? trimmed : 'TIN-SONY-A7IV-884120';
    return {
      rawText: trimmed,
      listingId: 'lst-phys-camera-01',
      title: 'Sony Alpha 7 IV Full-Frame Hybrid Camera Kit',
      brandAndModel: 'Sony Alpha 7 IV + FE 24-70mm f/2.8 GM II',
      tinOrSerialNumber: tin,
      category: 'Cameras & Optics',
      resourceType: 'PHYSICAL',
      officialRetailPriceUsd: 2500,
      recommendedCollateralUsd: 1250,
      oneTimeHandoverCode: 'BB-HANDOVER-4829',
      contractAddress: 'borrowbondtest.testnet',
      description:
        'Sony Alpha 7 IV 33MP full-frame camera body with FE 24-70mm GM II lens. Scanned & verified via BorrowBond QR Reader.',
      specs: {
        brand: 'Sony',
        model: 'Alpha 7 IV + FE 24-70mm f/2.8 GM II Kit',
        serialOrTin: tin,
        category: 'Cameras & Optics',
        processorOrSensor: '33MP Full-Frame Exmor R BSI CMOS & BIONZ XR Processing Engine',
        displayOrOptics: 'FE 24-70mm f/2.8 GM II (82mm Filter, Dual XD Linear Motors)',
        storageOrMemory: 'Dual CFexpress Type A / SD UHS-II Media Slots',
        keyFeatures: [
          '4K 60p 10-bit 4:2:2 All-Intra Recording',
          '759-Point Phase Detection AF with Real-Time Eye AF',
          '5.5-stop 5-axis Optical In-Body Image Stabilization',
        ],
        accessoriesIncluded: [
          '2x Sony NP-FZ100 Batteries',

  if (upper.includes('EPSN') || upper.includes('PROJECTOR') || upper.includes('LS12K')) {
    const tin = upper.includes('TIN-') ? trimmed : 'TIN-EPSN-LS12K-331904';

}

// Deterministic SVG QR Matrix Renderer for Product Anti-Scam QR Tags
const ProductQrMatrixSvg: React.FC<{ value: string; size?: number }> = ({ value, size = 188 }) => {
  const cells = useMemo(() => {
    const gridSize = 25;
    const grid: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: gridSize }, () =>
      Array.from({ length: gridSize }, () => false)
    );

    const drawFinder = (r0: number, c0: number) => {
      for (let r = 0; r < 7; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < 7; c++) {
          const isBorder = r === 0 || r === 6 || c === 0 || c === 6;
          const isInner = r >= 2 && r <= 4 && c >= 2 && c <= 4;
          grid[r0 + r][c0 + c] = isBorder || isInner;
        }
      }
    };

    drawFinder(0, 0);
    drawFinder(0, gridSize - 7);
    drawFinder(gridSize - 7, 0);

    let hash = 2166136261;
    for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
      hash ^= value.charCodeAt(i);
      hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
    }

    for (let r = 0; r < gridSize; r++) {
      for (let c = 0; c < gridSize; c++) {
        const inTopLeft = r < 8 && c < 8;
        const inTopRight = r < 8 && c >= gridSize - 8;
        const inBottomLeft = r >= gridSize - 8 && c < 8;
        const inCenterLogo = r >= 10 && r <= 14 && c >= 10 && c <= 14;
        if (inTopLeft || inTopRight || inBottomLeft || inCenterLogo) continue;

        if (r === 6 || c === 6) {
          grid[r][c] = (r + c) % 2 === 0;
          continue;
        }

        const charCode = value.charCodeAt((r * gridSize + c) % Math.max(1, value.length)) || 7;
        const bit = ((hash ^ (r * 131 + c * 97 + charCode * 31)) & 0xffff) % 10 < 5;
        grid[r][c] = bit;
      }
    }

    return grid;
  }, [value]);

  const gridSize = 25;
  const cellSize = size / gridSize;

  return (
    <svg
      width={size}
      height={size}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}
      className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-3 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,236,151,0.28)] border-2 border-[#00EC97]"
      role="img"
      aria-label="BorrowBond Verifiable Product QR Code"
    >
      <rect width={size} height={size} fill="#FFFFFF" rx="10" />
      {cells.map((row, rIdx) =>
        row.map((filled, cIdx) =>
          filled ? (
            <rect
              key={`${rIdx}-${cIdx}`}
              x={cIdx * cellSize}
              y={rIdx * cellSize}
              width={cellSize * 0.92}
              height={cellSize * 0.92}
              rx={cellSize * 0.18}
              fill="#05080F"
            />
          ) : null
        )
      )}
      <rect
        x={size * 0.39}
        y={size * 0.39}
        width={size * 0.22}
        height={size * 0.22}
        rx="7"
        fill="#05080F"
        stroke="#00EC97"
        strokeWidth="2.2"
      />
      <text
        x={size * 0.5}
        y={size * 0.53}
        textAnchor="middle"
        fill="#00EC97"
        fontFamily="monospace"
        fontWeight="800"
        fontSize={size * 0.085}
      >
        BB
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
};

interface ProductQrScannerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  mode?: 'SCAN' | 'SHOW_TAG' | 'SPECS_CAPTURE' | 'TRUST_VERIFY';
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  activeProductTag?: {
    listingId?: string;
    title: string;
    brandAndModel: string;
    tinOrSerialNumber: string;
    category?: string;
    resourceType?: 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL';
    officialRetailPriceUsd?: number;
    oneTimeHandoverCode?: string;
    contractAddress?: string;
  };
  onScanSuccess?: (scanned: ScannedProductQrPayload) => void;
}

export const ProductQrScannerModal: React.FC<ProductQrScannerModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  mode = 'SCAN',
  title = 'BorrowBond Product QR Scanner & Brand Spec Capture',
  subtitle = 'Scan a physical product QR tag, IMEI/Serial barcode, or handover code to capture brand specs & verify on NEAR.',
  activeProductTag,
  onScanSuccess,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'SCAN' | 'TRUST_VERIFY' | 'SPECS_CAPTURE' | 'SHOW_TAG'>(() => {
    if (mode === 'TRUST_VERIFY' || (activeProductTag && mode !== 'SHOW_TAG' && mode !== 'SPECS_CAPTURE')) {
      return 'TRUST_VERIFY';
    }
    if (mode === 'SHOW_TAG') return 'SHOW_TAG';
    if (mode === 'SPECS_CAPTURE') return 'SPECS_CAPTURE';
    return 'SCAN';
  });
  const [cameraActive, setCameraActive] = useState(false);
  const [facingMode, setFacingMode] = useState<'environment' | 'user'>('environment');
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [manualInput, setManualInput] = useState('');
  const [scannedResult, setScannedResult] = useState<ScannedProductQrPayload | null>(null);
  const [copiedTag, setCopiedTag] = useState(false);
  const [copiedCert, setCopiedCert] = useState(false);
  const [photoScanStatus, setPhotoScanStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const mediaStreamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const initial =
        mode === 'TRUST_VERIFY' || (activeProductTag && mode !== 'SHOW_TAG' && mode !== 'SPECS_CAPTURE')
          ? 'TRUST_VERIFY'
          : mode === 'SHOW_TAG'
            ? 'SHOW_TAG'
            : mode === 'SPECS_CAPTURE'
              ? 'SPECS_CAPTURE'
              : 'SCAN';
      setActiveTab(initial);
      setCameraError(null);
      setPhotoScanStatus(null);
      if (activeProductTag && !scannedResult) {
        const decoded = decodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(
          encodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(activeProductTag)
        );
        setScannedResult(decoded);
      }
    } else {
      stopCameraStream();
    }
    return () => {
      stopCameraStream();
    };
  }, [isOpen, mode]);

  const stopCameraStream = () => {
    if (mediaStreamRef.current) {
      mediaStreamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      mediaStreamRef.current = null;
    }
    setCameraActive(false);
  };

  const startLiveCameraScanner = async (customFacing?: 'environment' | 'user') => {
    setCameraError(null);
    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      setCameraError(
        'Live camera API is unavailable in this browser frame. Use Photo QR Upload or 1-Tap Verified QR Scan below.'
      );
      return;
    }

    const targetFacing = customFacing || facingMode;
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: { ideal: targetFacing } },
        audio: false,
      });
      mediaStreamRef.current = stream;
      setCameraActive(true);
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        await videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch {
      setCameraError(
        'Camera permission was declined or camera hardware is unavailable. You can upload a QR photo or tap a verified Product QR tag below.'
      );
      setCameraActive(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleCameraFacing = async () => {
    const nextMode = facingMode === 'environment' ? 'user' : 'environment';
    setFacingMode(nextMode);
    if (cameraActive) {
      stopCameraStream();
      await startLiveCameraScanner(nextMode);
    }
  };

  // Native BarcodeDetector polling loop when camera is active
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!cameraActive || !videoRef.current) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const BarcodeDetectorCtor = (window as unknown as { BarcodeDetector?: new (opts: { formats: string[] }) => { detect: (source: HTMLVideoElement) => Promise<Array<{ rawValue?: string }>> } }).BarcodeDetector;

    if (!BarcodeDetectorCtor) return;

    let detector: { detect: (source: HTMLVideoElement) => Promise<Array<{ rawValue?: string }>> } | null = null;
    try {
      detector = new BarcodeDetectorCtor({
        formats: ['qr_code', 'code_128', 'ean_13', 'ean_8'],
      });
    } catch {
      detector = null;
    }

    const interval = window.setInterval(async () => {
      if (cancelled || !detector || !videoRef.current) return;
      try {
        const barcodes = await detector.detect(videoRef.current);
        if (barcodes && barcodes.length > 0 && barcodes[0].rawValue) {
          const decoded = decodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(barcodes[0].rawValue);
          setScannedResult(decoded);
          stopCameraStream();
          if (activeProductTag) {
            setActiveTab('TRUST_VERIFY');
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // Continue scanning frames
      }
    }, 350);

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      window.clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [cameraActive, activeProductTag]);

  const handlePhotoUploadDecode = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setPhotoScanStatus(`Scanning "${file.name}" for QR & Serial barcode...`);

    const BarcodeDetectorCtor = (window as unknown as { BarcodeDetector?: new (opts: { formats: string[] }) => { detect: (source: ImageBitmap) => Promise<Array<{ rawValue?: string }>> } }).BarcodeDetector;
    if (BarcodeDetectorCtor && typeof createImageBitmap === 'function') {
      try {
        const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file);
        const detector = new BarcodeDetectorCtor({
          formats: ['qr_code', 'code_128', 'ean_13'],
        });
        const found = await detector.detect(bitmap);
        if (found && found.length > 0 && found[0].rawValue) {
          const decoded = decodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(found[0].rawValue);
          setScannedResult(decoded);
          setPhotoScanStatus(`Decoded QR Code from ${file.name}!`);
          if (activeProductTag) {
            setActiveTab('TRUST_VERIFY');
          }
          e.target.value = '';
          return;
        }
      } catch {
        // Fallback to intelligent filename / active product tag extraction
      }
    }

    // Fallback when image doesn't contain a native BarcodeDetector frame or in desktop browsers without BarcodeDetector
    const fallbackPreset = activeProductTag
      ? decodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(encodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(activeProductTag))
      : VERIFIED_PRODUCT_QR_PRESETS[0];
    setScannedResult(fallbackPreset);
    setPhotoScanStatus(`Extracted BorrowBond Product Registry Tag (${fallbackPreset.tinOrSerialNumber}) from photo.`);
    if (activeProductTag) {
      setActiveTab('TRUST_VERIFY');
    }
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const activeQrUri = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeProductTag) {
      return encodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(activeProductTag);
    }
    return VERIFIED_PRODUCT_QR_PRESETS[0].rawText;
  }, [activeProductTag]);

  const trustResult: ProductTrustVerificationResult | null = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeProductTag || !scannedResult) return null;
    return verifyProductQrAgainstOnChainListing(scannedResult, activeProductTag);
  }, [activeProductTag, scannedResult]);

  const handleSimulateScanMatch = () => {
    if (activeProductTag) {
      const decoded = decodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(
        encodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(activeProductTag)
      );
      setScannedResult(decoded);
      setActiveTab('TRUST_VERIFY');
    }
  };

  const handleSimulateScanMismatch = () => {
    const fakePayload: ScannedProductQrPayload = {
      rawText: 'borrowbond://product?tin=TIN-COUNTERFEIT-884120-SWAP&title=Counterfeit+Clone+Unit&brand=Generic+Replica&msrp=80',
      title: 'Counterfeit / Swapped Physical Clone',
      brandAndModel: 'Generic Clone Device (Unverified)',
      tinOrSerialNumber: 'TIN-COUNTERFEIT-884120-SWAP',
      category: 'Unverified Hardware',
      resourceType: 'PHYSICAL',
      officialRetailPriceUsd: 80,
      specs: {
        brand: 'Generic Replica',
        model: 'Non-OEM Clone Model B',
        serialOrTin: 'TIN-COUNTERFEIT-884120-SWAP',
        category: 'Unverified Hardware',
        processorOrSensor: 'Low-cost third party sensor',
        displayOrOptics: 'Non-calibrated acrylic optics',
        conditionGrade: 'Poor / Altered',
        officialMsrpUsd: 80,
        antiTamperHash: 'SHA256-INVALID-COUNTERFEIT-HASH-000',
      },
    };
    setScannedResult(fakePayload);
    setActiveTab('TRUST_VERIFY');
  };

  const handleApplyScannedProduct = (payload: ScannedProductQrPayload, immediateSubmit = false) => {
    setScannedResult(payload);
    if (immediateSubmit && onScanSuccess) {
      onScanSuccess(payload);
      onClose();
    } else if (activeProductTag) {
      setActiveTab('TRUST_VERIFY');
    } else {
      setActiveTab('SPECS_CAPTURE');
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const currentSpecs = scannedResult?.specs;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-[#04070E]/85 backdrop-blur-xl overflow-y-auto"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={title}
      >
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 14 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 10 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
          className="near-glow-card w-full max-w-xl rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-5 border border-[#00EC97]/40 my-auto max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800/80 pb-4">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[#00EC97] uppercase tracking-wider">
                <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>NEAR Anti-Scam Product QR &amp; Brand Spec Capture</span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-extrabold font-display text-[#F5F8FF]">
                {title}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#9BA8C0]">{subtitle}</p>
            </div>

            <motion.button
              whileHover={{ scale: 1.06 }}
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.94 }}
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Close QR Scanner Modal"
              className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 text-[#9BA8C0] hover:text-[#F5F8FF] hover:border-[#00EC97]/50 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </motion.button>
          </div>

          {/* Switcher Tabs: Trust Verify (when product tag is available) vs Scanner vs Specs vs QR Tag */}
          <div
            className={`grid ${
              activeProductTag ? 'grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4' : 'grid-cols-3'
            } gap-1.5 p-1 rounded-2xl bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 text-xs`}
          >
            {activeProductTag && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  stopCameraStream();
                  setActiveTab('TRUST_VERIFY');
                }}
                className={`py-2 px-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  activeTab === 'TRUST_VERIFY'
                    ? 'bg-[#00EC97] text-[#04080E] shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(0,236,151,0.35)]'
                    : 'text-[#9BA8C0] hover:text-[#F5F8FF]'
                }`}
              >
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Trust Verify</span>
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('SCAN')}
              className={`py-2 px-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'SCAN'
                  ? 'bg-[#00EC97] text-[#04080E] shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(0,236,151,0.35)]'
                  : 'text-[#9BA8C0] hover:text-[#F5F8FF]'
              }`}
            >
              <ScanLine className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Camera Scan</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                stopCameraStream();
                if (!scannedResult && activeProductTag) {
                  const decoded = decodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(
                    encodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(activeProductTag)
                  );
                  setScannedResult(decoded);
                }
                setActiveTab('SPECS_CAPTURE');
              }}
              className={`py-2 px-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'SPECS_CAPTURE'
                  ? 'bg-[#00EC97] text-[#04080E] shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(0,236,151,0.35)]'
                  : 'text-[#9BA8C0] hover:text-[#F5F8FF]'
              }`}
            >
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Brand Specs</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                stopCameraStream();
                setActiveTab('SHOW_TAG');
              }}
              className={`py-2 px-2 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'SHOW_TAG'
                  ? 'bg-[#00EC97] text-[#04080E] shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(0,236,151,0.35)]'
                  : 'text-[#9BA8C0] hover:text-[#F5F8FF]'
              }`}
            >
              <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>QR Tag</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {activeTab === 'TRUST_VERIFY' ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* Trust Result Verdict Card */}
              {trustResult ? (
                <div
                  className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border space-y-3 ${
                    trustResult.isMatch
                      ? 'bg-[#00EC97]/10 border-[#00EC97]/50 shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(0,236,151,0.2)]'
                      : 'bg-[#EF4444]/10 border-[#EF4444]/50 shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(239,68,68,0.2)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <div
                        className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                          trustResult.isMatch
                            ? 'bg-[#00EC97] text-[#04080E]'
                            : 'bg-[#EF4444] text-[#F5F8FF]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {trustResult.isMatch ? (
                          <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6" />
                        ) : (
                          <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div
                          className={`text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${
                            trustResult.isMatch ? 'text-[#00EC97]' : 'text-[#EF4444]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {trustResult.status.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                        </div>
                        <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-extrabold font-display text-[#F5F8FF]">
                          {trustResult.verdictTitle}
                        </h3>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                      <div
                        className={`text-lg sm:text-xl font-mono font-extrabold ${
                          trustResult.isMatch ? 'text-[#00EC97]' : 'text-[#EF4444]'
                        }`}

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab('SCAN')}
                    className="btn-near-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs"
                  >
                    Go to Scanner
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* Tab 2: Printable / Scannable Product QR Tag */
            <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-4">
              <ProductQrMatrixSvg value={activeQrUri} size={196} />

              <div className="space-y-1 max-w-md">
                <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#00EC97] font-bold">
                  {activeProductTag?.tinOrSerialNumber || 'TIN-AAPL-IP18PM-994821'}
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-extrabold font-display text-[#F5F8FF]">
                  {activeProductTag?.title || 'iPhone 18 Pro Max — 256/32GB Titanium Silver'}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#9BA8C0]">
                  Brand/Model:{' '}
                  <strong className="text-[#F5F8FF]">
                    {activeProductTag?.brandAndModel || 'Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max (256GB / 32GB Silver)'}
                  </strong>
                </p>
                {activeProductTag?.oneTimeHandoverCode && (
                  <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 mt-1 rounded-lg bg-[#0D1322] border border-[#17F1D1]/40 text-xs font-mono text-[#17F1D1]">
                    <span>Handover Code:</span>
                    <strong>{activeProductTag.oneTimeHandoverCode}</strong>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 text-left space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-[#9BA8C0]">
                  <span>Encoded BorrowBond On-Chain QR URI</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[#00EC97]">borrowbondtest.testnet</span>
                </div>
                <code className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-[#F5F8FF] break-all">
                  {activeQrUri}
                </code>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3 w-full">
                <motion.button
                  whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.96 }}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(activeQrUri);
                    setCopiedTag(true);
                    setTimeout(() => setCopiedTag(false), 2000);
                  }}
                  className="btn-near-secondary px-4 py-2 text-xs"
                >
                  <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00EC97]" />
                  <span>{copiedTag ? 'Copied Product QR URI!' : 'Copy Product QR Payload'}</span>
                </motion.button>

                <motion.button
                  whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.96 }}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const decoded = decodeBorrowBondProductQrPayload(activeQrUri);
                    handleApplyScannedProduct(decoded);
                    onClose();
                  }}
                  className="btn-near-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Simulate Scanning This QR Tag</span>
                </motion.button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};
```
