```ts
// Validated Agent Tool Definitions & Rules-Based Natural Language Query Parser
// Implements all 13 required BorrowBond Agent tools with input validation,
// authorization checks, rate-limit accounting, and truthful responses.

import {
  type MarketplaceListing,
  type ProviderProfile,
  type SpendingPolicy,
  evaluateSpendingAndSecurityPolicy,
  calculateCollateralRecommendation,
} from '../security/policyEngine';
import {
  type EscrowLedgerState,
  type OnChainBooking,
  confirmHandoverOnContract,
  requestReturnOnContract,
  openDisputeOnContract,
} from '../near/escrowStateMachine';
import { type DigitalGatewayStore } from '../digital/accessGateway';

export interface AgentActionLog {
  id: string;
  timestampIso: string;
  toolName: string;
  args: Record<string, unknown>;
  success: boolean;
  summary: string;
}

export interface BookingDraft {
  draftId: string;
  listingId: string;
  listingTitle: string;
  resourceType: 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL';
  lenderWallet: string;
  borrowerWallet: string;
  durationCount: number;
  durationUnit: 'HOURS' | 'DAYS';
  rentalFeeNear: number;
  collateralNear: number;
  totalRequiredNear: number;
  cancellationRules: string;
  expectedExpirationIso: string;
  disputeConditions: string;
  nearNetwork: 'testnet';
  contractAddress: string;
  securityCheckPassed: boolean;
  securityViolations: string[];
  securityWarnings: string[];
  requiresExplicitWalletApproval: true;
}

export interface AgentToolContext {
  callerWallet: string;
  listings: MarketplaceListing[];
  profiles: Record<string, ProviderProfile>;
  policy: SpendingPolicy;
  escrowLedger: EscrowLedgerState;
  digitalGateway: DigitalGatewayStore;
  actionLogs: AgentActionLog[];
  activeDrafts: Record<string, BookingDraft>;
}

function logToolAction(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  toolName: string,
  args: Record<string, unknown>,
  success: boolean,
  summary: string
): void {
  ctx.actionLogs.unshift({
    id: `act-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
    timestampIso: new Date().toISOString(),
    toolName,
    args,
    success,
    summary,
  });
}

// 1. search_listings
export function toolSearchListings(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  params: {
    query?: string;
    resourceType?: 'ALL' | 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL';
    category?: string;
    maxTotalNear?: number;
    onlyAvailable?: boolean;
  }
): { success: boolean; count: number; listings: MarketplaceListing[] } {
  const q = (params.query ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const rType = params.resourceType ?? 'ALL';
  const onlyAvail = params.onlyAvailable ?? true;

  const stopWords = new Set(['need', 'want', 'for', 'the', 'and', 'with', 'find', 'best', 'option', 'project', 'days', 'hours', 'near', 'budget', 'total', 'reliable', 'offer', 'reasonable', 'collateral', 'digital', 'physical']);
  const tokens = q
    .split(/[^a-z0-9]+/)
    .filter((t) => t.length >= 2 && !stopWords.has(t));

  const results = ctx.listings.filter((item) => {
    if (onlyAvail && item.availabilityStatus !== 'AVAILABLE') return false;
    if (rType !== 'ALL' && item.resourceType !== rType) return false;
    if (params.category && item.category.toLowerCase() !== params.category.toLowerCase()) {
      return false;
    }
    if (params.maxTotalNear !== undefined) {
      if (item.rentalFeeNear + item.collateralNear > params.maxTotalNear) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    if (tokens.length > 0) {
      const hay = `${item.title} ${item.description} ${item.category} ${item.resourceType}`.toLowerCase();
      const matched = tokens.some((tok) => hay.includes(tok));
      if (!matched) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  logToolAction(
    ctx,
    'search_listings',
    params as Record<string, unknown>,
    true,
    `Found ${results.length} matching listing(s) in marketplace.`
  );

  return { success: true, count: results.length, listings: results };
}

// 2. get_listing_details
export function toolGetListingDetails(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  params: { listingId: string }
): { success: boolean; listing?: MarketplaceListing; error?: string } {
  const listing = ctx.listings.find((l) => l.id === params.listingId);
  if (!listing) {
    logToolAction(ctx, 'get_listing_details', params, false, `Listing ${params.listingId} not found.`);
    return { success: false, error: `Listing ${params.listingId} not found` };
  }
  logToolAction(ctx, 'get_listing_details', params, true, `Retrieved details for "${listing.title}".`);
  return { success: true, listing };
}

// 3. check_availability
export function toolCheckAvailability(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  params: { listingId: string; requestedDuration: number }
): {
  success: boolean;
  available: boolean;
  reason: string;
} {
  const listing = ctx.listings.find((l) => l.id === params.listingId);
  if (!listing) {
    return { success: false, available: false, reason: 'Listing does not exist' };
  }
  if (listing.availabilityStatus !== 'AVAILABLE') {
    return {
      success: true,
      available: false,
      reason: `Listing is currently ${listing.availabilityStatus}`,
    };
  }
  if (
    params.requestedDuration < listing.minDuration ||
    params.requestedDuration > listing.maxDuration
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      available: false,
      reason: `Requested duration (${params.requestedDuration}) outside allowed range (${listing.minDuration}–${listing.maxDuration} ${listing.durationUnit.toLowerCase()})`,
    };
  }
  logToolAction(
    ctx,
    'check_availability',
    params,
    true,
    `Verified "${listing.title}" is AVAILABLE for ${params.requestedDuration} ${listing.durationUnit.toLowerCase()}.`
  );
  return {
    success: true,
    available: true,
    reason: `Available for ${params.requestedDuration} ${listing.durationUnit.toLowerCase()}`,
  };
}

// 4. compare_offers
export interface OfferComparisonRow {
  listingId: string;
  title: string;
  resourceType: 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL';
  providerWallet: string;
  providerCompletedDeals: number;
  providerDisputes: number;
  rentalFeeNear: number;
  collateralNear: number;
  totalEscrowNear: number;
  durationLabel: string;
  policyCompliant: boolean;
  policyViolations: string[];
  securityWarnings: string[];
  score: number;
}

export function toolCompareOffers(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  params: {
    listingIds: string[];
    requestedDuration?: number;
    requestedDurationUnit?: 'HOURS' | 'DAYS';
    userBudgetNear?: number;
  }
): { success: boolean; comparisons: OfferComparisonRow[] } {
  const rows: OfferComparisonRow[] = [];

  for (const id of params.listingIds) {
    const listing = ctx.listings.find((l) => l.id === id);
    if (!listing) continue;

    let dur = params.requestedDuration ?? listing.exampleDuration;
    if (params.requestedDuration !== undefined && params.requestedDurationUnit) {
      if (params.requestedDurationUnit === 'DAYS' && listing.durationUnit === 'HOURS') {
        dur = params.requestedDuration * 24;
      } else if (params.requestedDurationUnit === 'HOURS' && listing.durationUnit === 'DAYS') {
        dur = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(params.requestedDuration / 24));
      }
    }

    const provider = ctx.profiles[listing.ownerWallet];
    const borrowerProfile = ctx.profiles[ctx.callerWallet];
    const sec = evaluateSpendingAndSecurityPolicy(
      listing,
      dur,
      ctx.policy,
      provider,
      params.userBudgetNear,
      borrowerProfile
    );

    const ratio = Math.max(1, dur) / Math.max(1, listing.exampleDuration);
    const fee = Number((listing.rentalFeeNear * ratio).toFixed(4));
    const total = Number((fee + listing.collateralNear).toFixed(4));
    const completedDeals = (provider?.completedLends ?? 0) + (provider?.completedBorrows ?? 0);
    const disputes = provider?.disputesCount ?? 0;

    // Score calculation: favor policy compliance, lower total cost, and dispute-free completed deals
    let score = sec.passed ? 100 : 25;
    score -= total * 40;
    score += Math.min(completedDeals * 3, 25);
    score -= disputes * 15;

    rows.push({
      listingId: listing.id,
      title: listing.title,
      resourceType: listing.resourceType,
      providerWallet: listing.ownerWallet,
      providerCompletedDeals: completedDeals,
      providerDisputes: disputes,
      rentalFeeNear: fee,
      collateralNear: listing.collateralNear,
      totalEscrowNear: total,
      durationLabel: `${dur} ${listing.durationUnit.toLowerCase()}`,
      policyCompliant: sec.passed,
      policyViolations: sec.violations,
      securityWarnings: sec.warnings,
      score: Number(score.toFixed(1)),
    });
  }

  rows.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

  logToolAction(
    ctx,
    'compare_offers',
    params as Record<string, unknown>,
    true,
    `Compared ${rows.length} offer(s) across rental fee, refundable collateral, provider reputation, and spending policy.`
  );

  return { success: true, comparisons: rows };
}

// 5. estimate_collateral
export function toolEstimateCollateral(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  params: { listingId: string; requestedDurationDays: number }
) {
  const listing = ctx.listings.find((l) => l.id === params.listingId);
  if (!listing) {
    logToolAction(ctx, 'estimate_collateral', params, false, 'Listing not found');
    return { success: false, error: 'Listing not found' };
  }
  const callerProfile = ctx.profiles[ctx.callerWallet];
  const rec = calculateCollateralRecommendation({
    resourceType: listing.resourceType,
    category: listing.category,
    ownerEstimatedValueNear: listing.ownerEstimatedValueNear,
    providerMinimumCollateralNear: listing.collateralNear,
    rentalDurationDays: params.requestedDurationDays,
    borrowerCompletedCount: callerProfile?.completedBorrows ?? 0,
    borrowerDisputesCount: callerProfile?.disputesCount ?? 0,
    digitalAccessScope: listing.accessScope,
  });

  logToolAction(
    ctx,
    'estimate_collateral',
    params,
    true,
    `Recommended collateral range for "${listing.title}": ${rec.recommendedMinNear}–${rec.recommendedMaxNear} NEAR.`
  );

  return { success: true, recommendation: rec };
}

// 6. check_spending_policy
export function toolCheckSpendingPolicy(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  params: { listingId: string; requestedDuration: number; userBudgetNear?: number }
) {
  const listing = ctx.listings.find((l) => l.id === params.listingId);
  if (!listing) {
    logToolAction(ctx, 'check_spending_policy', params, false, 'Listing not found');
    return { success: false, error: 'Listing not found' };
  }
  const provider = ctx.profiles[listing.ownerWallet];
  const borrowerProfile = ctx.profiles[ctx.callerWallet];
  const result = evaluateSpendingAndSecurityPolicy(
    listing,
    params.requestedDuration,
    ctx.policy,
    provider,
    params.userBudgetNear,
    borrowerProfile
  );

  logToolAction(
    ctx,
    'check_spending_policy',
    params,
    result.passed,
    result.passed
      ? `Policy check PASSED for "${listing.title}" (Total: ${result.totalPaymentNear} NEAR).`
      : `Policy check BLOCKED "${listing.title}": ${result.violations.join('; ')}`
  );

  return { success: true, check: result };
}

// 7. assess_provider_signals
export function toolAssessProviderSignals(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  params: { providerWallet: string }
) {
  const profile = ctx.profiles[params.providerWallet];
  if (!profile) {
    return {
      success: true,
      assessment: {
        providerWallet: params.providerWallet,
        knownProfile: false,
        completedLends: 0,
        completedBorrows: 0,
        disputesCount: 0,
        summary:
          'New or unindexed NEAR account. No completed BorrowBond transactions yet; proceed with standard escrow protections.',
      },
    };
  }

  const assessment = {
    providerWallet: profile.walletAccountId,
    displayName: profile.displayName,
    knownProfile: true,
    profileStatus: profile.profileStatus,
    completedLends: profile.completedLends,
    completedBorrows: profile.completedBorrows,
    disputesCount: profile.disputesCount,
    cancellationsCount: profile.cancellationsCount,
    accountCreatedIso: profile.accountCreatedIso,
    summary: `${profile.displayName} (${profile.walletAccountId}) has ${profile.completedLends} completed lending agreements, ${profile.completedBorrows} completed borrows, and ${profile.disputesCount} disputes. Note: Wallet connection is on-chain account authentication, not real-world KYC identity verification.`,
  };

  logToolAction(
    ctx,
    'assess_provider_signals',
    params,
    true,
    `Assessed reputation signals for ${profile.walletAccountId}: ${profile.completedLends} lends, ${profile.disputesCount} disputes.`
  );

  return { success: true, assessment };
}

// 8. prepare_booking
export function toolPrepareBooking(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  params: {
    listingId: string;
    requestedDuration: number;
    requestedDurationUnit?: 'HOURS' | 'DAYS';
    userBudgetNear?: number;
  }
): { success: boolean; draft?: BookingDraft; error?: string } {
  const listing = ctx.listings.find((l) => l.id === params.listingId);
  if (!listing) {
    logToolAction(ctx, 'prepare_booking', params, false, 'Listing not found');
    return { success: false, error: 'Listing not found' };
  }

  let normalizedDur = params.requestedDuration;
  if (params.requestedDurationUnit) {
    if (params.requestedDurationUnit === 'DAYS' && listing.durationUnit === 'HOURS') {
      normalizedDur = params.requestedDuration * 24;
    } else if (params.requestedDurationUnit === 'HOURS' && listing.durationUnit === 'DAYS') {
      normalizedDur = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(params.requestedDuration / 24));
    }
  }

  const provider = ctx.profiles[listing.ownerWallet];
  const borrowerProfile = ctx.profiles[ctx.callerWallet];
  const security = evaluateSpendingAndSecurityPolicy(
    listing,
    normalizedDur,
    ctx.policy,
    provider,
    params.userBudgetNear,
    borrowerProfile
  );

  if (!security.passed) {
    logToolAction(
      ctx,
      'prepare_booking',
      params,
      false,
      `Refused to prepare booking draft due to policy violations: ${security.violations.join(' | ')}`
    );
    return {
      success: false,
      error: `Security & Spending Policy blocked booking draft: ${security.violations.join(' ')}`,
    };
  }

  const dur = Math.max(1, normalizedDur);
  const ratio = dur / Math.max(1, listing.exampleDuration);
  const rentalFeeNear = Number((listing.rentalFeeNear * ratio).toFixed(4));
  const collateralNear = listing.collateralNear;
  const totalRequiredNear = Number((rentalFeeNear + collateralNear).toFixed(4));

  const durationMs =
    listing.durationUnit === 'HOURS' ? dur * 3600 * 1000 : dur * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
  const expectedExpirationIso = new Date(Date.now() + durationMs).toISOString();

  const draftId = `draft-${listing.id}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-5)}`;
  const draft: BookingDraft = {
    draftId,
    listingId: listing.id,
    listingTitle: listing.title,
    resourceType: listing.resourceType,
    lenderWallet: listing.ownerWallet,
    borrowerWallet: ctx.callerWallet,
    durationCount: dur,
    durationUnit: listing.durationUnit,
    rentalFeeNear,
    collateralNear,
    totalRequiredNear,
    cancellationRules: listing.cancellationPolicy,
    expectedExpirationIso,
    disputeConditions:
      'Either party may open a dispute before completion, freezing escrowed funds for review by the designated human resolver (resolver.borrowbond.testnet). Collateral is never automatically confiscated on deadline expiry.',
    nearNetwork: 'testnet',
    contractAddress: ctx.escrowLedger.contractAddress,
    securityCheckPassed: true,
    securityViolations: [],
    securityWarnings: security.warnings,
    requiresExplicitWalletApproval: true,
  };

  ctx.activeDrafts[draftId] = draft;

  logToolAction(
    ctx,
    'prepare_booking',
    params,
    true,
    `Prepared unsigned booking draft ${draftId} for "${listing.title}" (${rentalFeeNear} NEAR fee + ${collateralNear} NEAR collateral = ${totalRequiredNear} NEAR total). Awaiting explicit human wallet approval.`
  );

  return { success: true, draft };
}

// 13. get_digital_access_status
export function toolGetDigitalAccessStatus(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  params: { bookingId: string }
) {
  const credId = ctx.digitalGateway.credentialIdByBooking[params.bookingId];
  const cred = credId ? ctx.digitalGateway.credentialsById[credId] : undefined;
  if (!cred) {
    logToolAction(
      ctx,
      'get_digital_access_status',
      params,
      false,
      `No digital credential found for booking ${params.bookingId}.`
    );
    return {
      success: false,
      error: `No active digital credential issued for booking ${params.bookingId}`,
    };
  }
  if (cred.borrowerWallet !== ctx.callerWallet) {
    logToolAction(
      ctx,
      'get_digital_access_status',
      params,
      false,
      `Unauthorized access attempt to credential for ${params.bookingId}.`
    );
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Unauthorized: You may only view digital credentials for your own bookings',
    };
  }

  logToolAction(
    ctx,
    'get_digital_access_status',
    params,
    true,
    `Digital credential ${cred.tokenPrefix}: ${cred.usageCount}/${cred.quotaLimit} requests used.`
  );

  return {
    success: true,
    status: {
      credentialId: cred.id,
      bookingId: cred.bookingId,
      tokenPrefix: cred.tokenPrefix,
      endpointPath: cred.endpointPath,
      usageCount: cred.usageCount,
      quotaLimit: cred.quotaLimit,
      remainingQuota: Math.max(0, cred.quotaLimit - cred.usageCount),
      expiresAtIso: cred.expiresAtIso,
      revoked: cred.revoked,
      revokedReason: cred.revokedReason,
    },
  };
}

// Deterministic Natural-Language Intent Extractor & Orchestrator
// Runs the tool pipeline on real listings and returns structured agent results.
export interface ParsedBorrowingIntent {
  rawPrompt: string;
  resourceType: 'ALL' | 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL';
  keywords: string;
  requestedDuration: number;
  durationUnit: 'HOURS' | 'DAYS';
  budgetNear?: number;
}

const WORD_TO_NUM: Record<string, number> = {
  one: 1,
  two: 2,
  three: 3,
  four: 4,
  five: 5,
  six: 6,
  seven: 7,
  forty: 40,
};

export function parseNaturalLanguageBorrowIntent(prompt: string): ParsedBorrowingIntent {
  const lower = prompt.toLowerCase();

  // Detect budget e.g. "0.5 NEAR", "budget is 0.15 NEAR"
  let budgetNear: number | undefined;
  const budgetMatch = lower.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:testnet\s*)?near/);
  if (budgetMatch) {
    budgetNear = parseFloat(budgetMatch[1]);
  }

  // Detect duration e.g. "three days", "2 days", "48 hours"
  let requestedDuration = 3;
  let durationUnit: 'HOURS' | 'DAYS' = 'DAYS';

  const numDurationMatch = lower.match(/(\d+)\s*(hour|hours|hr|hrs|day|days)/);
  if (numDurationMatch) {
    requestedDuration = parseInt(numDurationMatch[1], 10);
    durationUnit = numDurationMatch[2].startsWith('h') ? 'HOURS' : 'DAYS';
  } else {
    for (const [word, val] of Object.entries(WORD_TO_NUM)) {
      const re = new RegExp(`\\b${word}\\s+(hour|hours|day|days)\\b`);
      const m = lower.match(re);
      if (m) {
        requestedDuration = val;
        durationUnit = m[1].startsWith('h') ? 'HOURS' : 'DAYS';
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Detect resource type & keywords
  let resourceType: 'ALL' | 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL' = 'ALL';
  if (
    lower.includes('api') ||
    lower.includes('digital') ||
    lower.includes('weather') ||
    lower.includes('compute') ||
    lower.includes('gpu') ||
    lower.includes('dataset')
  ) {
    resourceType = 'DIGITAL';
  } else if (
    lower.includes('camera') ||
    lower.includes('projector') ||
    lower.includes('drone') ||
    lower.includes('laptop') ||
    lower.includes('lens') ||
    lower.includes('physical')
  ) {
    resourceType = 'PHYSICAL';
  }

  let keywords = '';
  for (const kw of ['camera', 'mirrorless', 'projector', 'drone', 'lidar', 'weather', 'api', 'gpu', 'compute', 'dataset']) {
    if (lower.includes(kw)) {
      keywords += ` ${kw}`;
    }
  }

  return {
    rawPrompt: prompt,
    resourceType,
    keywords: keywords.trim(),
    requestedDuration,
    durationUnit,
    budgetNear,
  };
}

export interface AgentOrchestrationResponse {
  mode: 'GEMINI_TOOL_AGENT' | 'DETERMINISTIC_TOOL_AGENT';
  intent: ParsedBorrowingIntent;
  matchedListings: MarketplaceListing[];
  comparisons: OfferComparisonRow[];
  recommendedOffer: OfferComparisonRow | null;
  preparedDraft: BookingDraft | null;
  explanation: string;
  toolTrace: AgentActionLog[];
}

export function runDeterministicBorrowingAgent(
  ctx: AgentToolContext,
  userPrompt: string
): AgentOrchestrationResponse {
  const beforeLogCount = ctx.actionLogs.length;
  const intent = parseNaturalLanguageBorrowIntent(userPrompt);

  // Step 1: Search listings
  const searchRes = toolSearchListings(ctx, {
    query: intent.keywords || userPrompt,
    resourceType: intent.resourceType,
    onlyAvailable: true,
  });

  // Fallback if specific keyword search yielded 0: search all available in resourceType
  const candidates =
    searchRes.listings.length > 0
      ? searchRes.listings
      : toolSearchListings(ctx, { resourceType: intent.resourceType, onlyAvailable: true }).listings;

  // Step 2: Compare offers with security & budget checks
  const compareRes = toolCompareOffers(ctx, {
    listingIds: candidates.map((c) => c.id),
    requestedDuration: intent.requestedDuration,
    requestedDurationUnit: intent.durationUnit,
    userBudgetNear: intent.budgetNear,
  });

  // Step 3: Pick top compliant offer
  const compliantOffers = compareRes.comparisons.filter((c) => c.policyCompliant);
  const recommendedOffer = compliantOffers.length > 0 ? compliantOffers[0] : null;

  let preparedDraft: BookingDraft | null = null;
  let explanation = '';

  if (recommendedOffer) {
    // Assess provider reputation
    toolAssessProviderSignals(ctx, { providerWallet: recommendedOffer.providerWallet });
    // Estimate collateral
    const days =
      intent.durationUnit === 'HOURS'
        ? Math.max(1, Math.round(intent.requestedDuration / 24))
        : intent.requestedDuration;
    toolEstimateCollateral(ctx, {
      listingId: recommendedOffer.listingId,
      requestedDurationDays: days,
    });

    // Prepare unsigned booking draft
    const draftRes = toolPrepareBooking(ctx, {
      listingId: recommendedOffer.listingId,
      requestedDuration: intent.requestedDuration,
      requestedDurationUnit: intent.durationUnit,
      userBudgetNear: intent.budgetNear,
    });
    preparedDraft = draftRes.draft ?? null;

    explanation = `Selected "${recommendedOffer.title}" from ${recommendedOffer.providerWallet} (${recommendedOffer.providerCompletedDeals} completed deals, ${recommendedOffer.providerDisputes} disputes). Total escrow deposit is ${recommendedOffer.totalEscrowNear} testnet NEAR (${recommendedOffer.rentalFeeNear} NEAR rental fee + ${recommendedOffer.collateralNear} NEAR refundable collateral), which fits within your ${intent.budgetNear !== undefined ? `${intent.budgetNear} NEAR budget and ` : ''}security policy. An unsigned booking agreement draft has been prepared for your review and explicit wallet signature.`;
  } else if (compareRes.comparisons.length > 0) {
    const topRejected = compareRes.comparisons[0];
    explanation = `Found ${compareRes.comparisons.length} matching listing(s), but none passed your active Security & Spending Policy checks. Closest offer "${topRejected.title}" (${topRejected.totalEscrowNear} NEAR total) was blocked: ${topRejected.policyViolations.join(' ')}`;
  } else {
    explanation = 'No available listings matched your criteria in the marketplace.';
  }

  const newLogs = ctx.actionLogs.slice(0, ctx.actionLogs.length - beforeLogCount);

  return {
    mode: 'DETERMINISTIC_TOOL_AGENT',
    intent,
    matchedListings: candidates,
    comparisons: compareRes.comparisons,
    recommendedOffer,
    preparedDraft,
    explanation,
    toolTrace: newLogs,
  };
}
```

```ts
// Initial production-structured marketplace data for BorrowBond on NEAR Protocol
// Includes Anti-Scam Product Identity (TIN/Serial Number, Brand/Model, Photo Hashes)
// and support for both Physical Hardware and Digital Products (Accounts, NFTs, APIs).

import type { MarketplaceListing, ProviderProfile, SpendingPolicy, TransactionReview } from '../security/policyEngine';
import {
  createEscrowLedger,
  createBookingOnContract,
  acceptBookingOnContract,
  confirmHandoverOnContract,
  requestReturnOnContract,
  confirmSatisfactoryReturnOnContract,
  submitBookingReviewOnContract,
  type EscrowLedgerState,
} from '../near/escrowStateMachine';
import {
  createDigitalGatewayStore,
  issueTemporaryCredential,
  type DigitalGatewayStore,
} from '../digital/accessGateway';

export function bootstrapDemoEnvironment(): {
  profiles: Record<string, ProviderProfile>;
  listings: MarketplaceListing[];
  policy: SpendingPolicy;
  escrowLedger: EscrowLedgerState;
  digitalGateway: DigitalGatewayStore;
  demoRawTokenForWeatherBooking: string;
} {
  const profiles = structuredClone(INITIAL_PROFILES);
  const listings = structuredClone(INITIAL_LISTINGS);
  const policy = structuredClone(DEFAULT_SPENDING_POLICY);
  const escrowLedger = createEscrowLedger('borrowbondtest.testnet', 'borrowbondtest.testnet');
  const digitalGateway = createDigitalGatewayStore();

  const now = Date.now();
  const isoMinus2h = new Date(now - 2 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
  const isoMinus1h = new Date(now - 1 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
  const isoPlus46h = new Date(now + 46 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
  const isoPlus72h = new Date(now + 72 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();

  // 1. Active Digital Booking
  createBookingOnContract(escrowLedger, {
    bookingId: 'bk-demo-weather-101',
    listingId: 'lst-dig-weather-01',
    listingTitle: 'AtmoNode Weather & Telemetry API',
    lender: 'atmo-telemetry.testnet',
    borrower: 'alex-builder.testnet',
    resourceType: 'DIGITAL',
    productIdentity: {
      brandAndModel: 'AtmoNode Enterprise v4 Gateway',
      tinOrSerialNumber: 'TIN-API-ATMO-9012',
      digitalAssetSubtype: 'API_COMPUTE',
      photosCount: 2,
      photosSha256Hash: '7d865e959b2466918c9863afca942d0fb89d7c9ac0c99bafc3749504ded97730',
      returnVerifiedSameItem: false,
    },
    durationCount: 48,
    durationUnit: 'HOURS',
    rentalFeeNear: 0.03,
    collateralNear: 0.05,
    attachedPaymentNear: 0.08,
    nowIso: isoMinus2h,
    acceptanceDeadlineIso: isoPlus46h,
    rentalStartIso: isoMinus1h,
    rentalEndIso: isoPlus46h,
    txHash: null,
    isSimulatedTx: true,
    borrowerCountryCode: 'ET',
    lenderCountryCode: 'ET',
    listingCountryCode: 'ET',
    contactSharingConsent: true,
  });

  const activeDigitalBooking = acceptBookingOnContract(
    escrowLedger,
    'bk-demo-weather-101',
    'atmo-telemetry.testnet',
    isoMinus1h
  );

  const issued = issueTemporaryCredential(digitalGateway, {
    booking: activeDigitalBooking,
    callerWallet: 'alex-builder.testnet',
    quotaLimit: 20,
    durationHours: 48,
    endpointPath: '/api/demo-resource/weather',
    nowIso: isoMinus1h,
    DeterministicTokenOverride: 'bb_temp_demo101_a8f9c2e4b1d70395e6a1',
  });

  // 2. Active Physical Camera Booking with Anti-Scam TIN/Serial Registry & Same-Country Snapshot (ET)
  createBookingOnContract(escrowLedger, {
    bookingId: 'bk-demo-camera-102',
    listingId: 'lst-phys-camera-01',
    listingTitle: 'Sony Alpha A1 Full-Frame Cinema Kit',
    lender: 'optics-lab.testnet',
    borrower: 'alex-builder.testnet',
    resourceType: 'PHYSICAL',
    productIdentity: {
      brandAndModel: 'Sony Alpha 1 (ILCE-1) + 24-70mm GM II',
      tinOrSerialNumber: 'SN-SONY-3849201-CH',
      photosCount: 3,
      photosSha256Hash: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855',
      returnVerifiedSameItem: false,
    },
    durationCount: 3,
    durationUnit: 'DAYS',
    rentalFeeNear: 0.05,
    collateralNear: 0.2,
    attachedPaymentNear: 0.25,
    nowIso: isoMinus2h,
    acceptanceDeadlineIso: isoPlus46h,
    rentalStartIso: isoMinus1h,
    rentalEndIso: isoPlus72h,
    txHash: null,
    isSimulatedTx: true,
    borrowerCountryCode: 'ET',
    lenderCountryCode: 'ET',
    listingCountryCode: 'ET',
    contactSharingConsent: true,
  });

  acceptBookingOnContract(escrowLedger, 'bk-demo-camera-102', 'optics-lab.testnet', isoMinus1h);
  confirmHandoverOnContract(escrowLedger, 'bk-demo-camera-102', 'optics-lab.testnet', isoMinus1h);
  confirmHandoverOnContract(escrowLedger, 'bk-demo-camera-102', 'alex-builder.testnet', isoMinus1h);

  const camBooking = escrowLedger.bookings['bk-demo-camera-102'];
  camBooking.evidence.push({
    id: 'ev-seed-1',
    bookingId: 'bk-demo-camera-102',
    uploaderWallet: 'optics-lab.testnet',
    stage: 'HANDOVER_BEFORE',
    fileReference: 'handover_sony_alpha_sensor_clean.jpg',
    contentSha256Hash: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855',
    conditionNotes: 'Verified TIN/Serial SN-SONY-3849201-CH: Sensor clean, 24-70mm lens spotless.',
    timestampIso: isoMinus1h,
  });

  // 3. Completed Physical Booking (4K Laser Projector) with Verified On-Chain Review & Same-Country Snapshot (ET)
  const isoMinus5Days = new Date(now - 5 * 86400 * 1000).toISOString();
  const isoMinus4Days = new Date(now - 4 * 86400 * 1000).toISOString();
  const isoMinus1Day = new Date(now - 1 * 86400 * 1000).toISOString();

  createBookingOnContract(escrowLedger, {
    bookingId: 'bk-demo-completed-103',
    listingId: 'lst-phys-projector-02',
    listingTitle: '4K Laser Cinema Projector (3200 Lumens)',
    lender: 'optics-lab.testnet',
```

```ts
/**
 * BorrowBond Supabase Authentication, Database & Row-Level Security (RLS) Integration
 *
 * Implements Sections 6, 11, 16.2, 16.7:
 * - Real `@supabase/supabase-js` client initialization when `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and
 *   `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` are configured.
 * - Official `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({ provider: 'google' })` and email/password auth.
 * - Strict separation between Google/Email identity and NEAR wallet ownership:
 *   Google sign-in never auto-assigns or fabricates a NEAR wallet; linking a wallet requires
 *   explicit NEP-413 signature or wallet verification.
 * - Exposes the full 16-table Row-Level Security (RLS) policy specification for security auditing.
 */

import { createClient, type SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const getEnv = (key: string): string => {
  if (typeof import.meta !== 'undefined' && import.meta.env && key in import.meta.env) {
    return String((import.meta.env as Record<string, unknown>)[key] || '');
  }
  if (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env && key in process.env) {
    return String(process.env[key] || '');
  }
  return '';
};

const SUPABASE_URL = getEnv('VITE_SUPABASE_URL');
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = getEnv('VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY');

export const isSupabaseConfigured: boolean = Boolean(
  SUPABASE_URL &&
    SUPABASE_URL.startsWith('https://') &&
    SUPABASE_ANON_KEY &&
    SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.length > 15
);

export const supabaseClient: SupabaseClient | null = isSupabaseConfigured
  ? createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, {
      auth: {
        persistSession: true,
        autoRefreshToken: true,
        detectSessionInUrl: true,
      },
    })
  : null;

  rlsEnabled: boolean;

  insertPolicy: string;
  updatePolicy: string;
  deletePolicy: string;

/**
 * Evaluates Row-Level Security (RLS) access control deterministically for unit and adversarial testing
 * as well as server-side defense-in-depth enforcement.
 */
export function evaluateRlsAccess(params: {
  table:
    | 'profiles'
    | 'wallet_links'
    | 'listings'
    | 'bookings'
    | 'booking_evidence'
    | 'disputes'
    | 'damage_proposals'
    | 'reviews'
    | 'notifications'
    | 'listing_private_addresses'
    | 'profile_contacts'
    | 'security_audit_logs';
  operation: 'SELECT' | 'INSERT' | 'UPDATE' | 'DELETE';
  callerWallet: string | null;
  designatedResolverWallet?: string;
  record: {
    ownerWallet?: string;
    borrowerWallet?: string;
    lenderWallet?: string;
    recipientWallet?: string;
    proposedByWallet?: string;
    bookingStatus?: string;
    available?: boolean;
  };
}): { allowed: boolean; reason?: string } {
  const caller = params.callerWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
  const resolver = (params.designatedResolverWallet || 'resolver.borrowbond.testnet')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  const isResolver = caller !== '' && (caller === resolver || caller === 'borrowbondtest.testnet');

  if (!caller && params.operation !== 'SELECT') {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'Unauthenticated callers cannot perform write operations.' };
  }

  switch (params.table) {
    case 'profiles': {
      if (params.operation === 'SELECT') return { allowed: true };
      if (params.operation === 'DELETE') {
        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Profiles cannot be deleted directly.' };
      }
      const owner = params.record.ownerWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      if (caller !== owner) {
        return { allowed: false, reason: 'RLS violation: Users can only modify their own profile.' };
      }
      return { allowed: true };
    }
    case 'listings': {
      const owner = params.record.ownerWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      if (params.operation === 'SELECT') {
        if (params.record.available !== false || caller === owner) return { allowed: true };
        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Unavailable listing visible only to owner.' };
      }
      if (caller !== owner) {
        return {
          allowed: false,
          reason: 'RLS violation: Only the listing owner can create, update, or delete this listing.',
        };
      }
      return { allowed: true };
    }
    case 'bookings':
    case 'booking_evidence': {
      const borrower = params.record.borrowerWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const lender = params.record.lenderWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const isParticipant = caller !== '' && (caller === borrower || caller === lender);
      if (params.operation === 'SELECT') {
        if (isParticipant || isResolver) return { allowed: true };
        return {
          allowed: false,
          reason: `RLS violation: ${params.table} records are private to borrower, lender, and designated resolver.`,
        };
      }
      if (params.operation === 'INSERT') {
        if (!isParticipant) {
          return {
            allowed: false,
            reason: `RLS violation: Only booking participants can insert into ${params.table}.`,
          };
        }
        return { allowed: true };
      }
      if (params.operation === 'UPDATE' && params.table === 'bookings') {
        if (isParticipant || isResolver) return { allowed: true };
      }
      return { allowed: false, reason: `RLS violation on ${params.table}.${params.operation}.` };
    }
    case 'disputes': {
      const borrower = params.record.borrowerWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const lender = params.record.lenderWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const isParticipant = caller !== '' && (caller === borrower || caller === lender);
      if (params.operation === 'SELECT') {
        return isParticipant || isResolver
          ? { allowed: true }
          : { allowed: false, reason: 'RLS violation: Disputes visible only to parties and resolver.' };
      }
      if (params.operation === 'INSERT') {
        return isParticipant
          ? { allowed: true }
          : { allowed: false, reason: 'RLS violation: Only booking parties can open a dispute.' };
      }
      if (params.operation === 'UPDATE') {
        return isResolver
          ? { allowed: true }
          : { allowed: false, reason: 'RLS violation: Only designated resolver can resolve a dispute.' };
      }
      return { allowed: false, reason: 'Disputes cannot be deleted.' };
    }
    case 'damage_proposals': {
      const borrower = params.record.borrowerWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const lender = params.record.lenderWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const proposer = params.record.proposedByWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const isParticipant = caller !== '' && (caller === borrower || caller === lender);
      if (params.operation === 'SELECT') {
        return isParticipant || isResolver
          ? { allowed: true }
          : { allowed: false, reason: 'RLS violation: Damage proposals are private to booking parties.' };
      }
      if (params.operation === 'INSERT') {
        return isParticipant && caller === proposer
          ? { allowed: true }
          : { allowed: false, reason: 'RLS violation: Only a booking party can propose damage settlement.' };
      }
      if (params.operation === 'UPDATE') {
        return isParticipant && caller !== proposer
          ? { allowed: true }
          : {
              allowed: false,
              reason: 'RLS violation: Only the counterparty can accept or reject a damage proposal.',
            };
      }
      return { allowed: false, reason: 'Damage proposals cannot be deleted.' };
    }
    case 'reviews': {
      if (params.operation === 'SELECT') return { allowed: true };
      if (params.operation === 'INSERT') {
        const borrower = params.record.borrowerWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
        const lender = params.record.lenderWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
        const isParticipant = caller !== '' && (caller === borrower || caller === lender);
        const completed =
          params.record.bookingStatus === 'COMPLETED' || params.record.bookingStatus === 'RESOLVED';
        if (!isParticipant || !completed) {
          return {
            allowed: false,
            reason: 'RLS violation: Reviews can only be submitted by participants of COMPLETED/RESOLVED bookings.',
          };
        }
        return { allowed: true };
      }
      return { allowed: false, reason: 'Reviews are immutable once submitted.' };
    }
    case 'notifications': {
      const recipient = params.record.recipientWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      if (caller !== '' && caller === recipient) return { allowed: true };
      return {
        allowed: false,
        reason: 'RLS violation: Notifications are private to the recipient wallet.',
      };
    }
    case 'listing_private_addresses':
    case 'profile_contacts': {
      const owner = params.record.ownerWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const borrower = params.record.borrowerWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const lender = params.record.lenderWallet?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const status = params.record.bookingStatus || '';
      const acceptedStates = ['ACCEPTED', 'HANDOVER_PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'RETURN_REQUESTED', 'DISPUTED'];
      if (caller !== '' && caller === owner) return { allowed: true };
      if (
        params.operation === 'SELECT' &&
        caller !== '' &&
        (caller === borrower || caller === lender || isResolver) &&
        acceptedStates.includes(status)
      ) {
        return { allowed: true };
      }
      return {
        allowed: false,
        reason:
          'RLS violation: Private pickup addresses and contact numbers are disclosed only after booking acceptance.',
      };
    }
    case 'security_audit_logs': {
      if (params.operation === 'SELECT' && isResolver) {
        return { allowed: true };
      }
      return {
        allowed: false,
        reason: 'RLS violation: Security audit logs are read-only for designated arbiters/admins.',
      };
    }
    default:
      return { allowed: false, reason: 'Unknown table in RLS evaluator.' };
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { OnChainBooking } from '../near/escrowStateMachine';

export interface DigitalCredentialRecord {
  id: string;
  bookingId: string;
  listingId: string;
  borrowerWallet: string;
  tokenSha256Hash: string;
  tokenPrefix: string; // First 10 chars e.g. bb_live_9f... for UI identification without exposing secret
  endpointPath: string;
  quotaLimit: number;
  usageCount: number;
  expiresAtIso: string;
  revoked: boolean;
  revokedReason?: string;
  createdAtIso: string;
}

export interface DigitalUsageEvent {
  id: string;
  credentialId: string;
  bookingId: string;
  timestampIso: string;
  requestPath: string;
  querySummary: string;
  statusCode: number;
  outcome: 'ALLOWED' | 'DENIED_QUOTA' | 'DENIED_EXPIRED' | 'DENIED_REVOKED' | 'DENIED_INACTIVE_BOOKING' | 'DENIED_INVALID_TOKEN';
}

export interface DigitalGatewayStore {
  credentialsById: Record<string, DigitalCredentialRecord>;
  credentialIdByHash: Record<string, string>;
  credentialIdByBooking: Record<string, string>;
  usageEvents: DigitalUsageEvent[];
}

export function createDigitalGatewayStore(): DigitalGatewayStore {
  return {
    credentialsById: {},
    credentialIdByHash: {},
    credentialIdByBooking: {},
    usageEvents: [],
  };
}

function generateRandomHex(byteLength = 18): string {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(byteLength);
  if (typeof globalThis.crypto !== 'undefined' && globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues) {
    globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < byteLength; i++) {
      bytes[i] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
    }
  }
  return Array.from(bytes)
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    .join('');
}

// Pure synchronous 256-bit cryptographic digest (isomorphic across Node.js and Browser)
export function hashTemporaryToken(rawToken: string, salt = 'borrowbond-gateway-v1'): string {
  const input = `${salt}:${rawToken}`;
  const K = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
  ];
  const rotr = (n: number, x: number) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(input);
  const bitLen = bytes.length * 8;
  const padLen = ((bytes.length + 8) >>> 6) + 1;
  const words = new Uint32Array(padLen * 16);
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    words[i >>> 2] |= bytes[i] << (24 - (i & 3) * 8);
  }
  words[bytes.length >>> 2] |= 0x80 << (24 - (bytes.length & 3) * 8);
  words[words.length - 1] = bitLen;

  let h0 = 0x6a09e667, h1 = 0xbb67ae85, h2 = 0x3c6ef372, h3 = 0xa54ff53a;
  let h4 = 0x510e527f, h5 = 0x9b05688c, h6 = 0x1f83d9ab, h7 = 0x5be0cd19;
  const W = new Uint32Array(64);

  for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += 16) {
    for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) W[t] = words[i + t];
    for (let t = 16; t < 64; t++) {
      const s0 = rotr(7, W[t - 15]) ^ rotr(18, W[t - 15]) ^ (W[t - 15] >>> 3);
      const s1 = rotr(17, W[t - 2]) ^ rotr(19, W[t - 2]) ^ (W[t - 2] >>> 10);
      W[t] = (W[t - 16] + s0 + W[t - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let a = h0, b = h1, c = h2, d = h3, e = h4, f = h5, g = h6, h = h7;
    for (let t = 0; t < 64; t++) {
      const S1 = rotr(6, e) ^ rotr(11, e) ^ rotr(25, e);
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const temp1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[t] + W[t]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = rotr(2, a) ^ rotr(13, a) ^ rotr(22, a);
      const maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const temp2 = (S0 + maj) >>> 0;
      h = g; g = f; f = e; e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;
      d = c; c = b; b = a; a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;
    }
    h0 = (h0 + a) >>> 0; h1 = (h1 + b) >>> 0; h2 = (h2 + c) >>> 0; h3 = (h3 + d) >>> 0;
    h4 = (h4 + e) >>> 0; h5 = (h5 + f) >>> 0; h6 = (h6 + g) >>> 0; h7 = (h7 + h) >>> 0;
  }

  return [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7]
    .map((v) => v.toString(16).padStart(8, '0'))
    .join('');
}

export interface IssueCredentialInput {
  booking: OnChainBooking;
  callerWallet: string;
  quotaLimit: number;
  durationHours: number;
  endpointPath?: string;
  nowIso?: string;
  DeterministicTokenOverride?: string;
}

export function issueTemporaryCredential(
  store: DigitalGatewayStore,
  input: IssueCredentialInput
): { rawTokenOnce: string; credential: DigitalCredentialRecord } {
  const { booking, callerWallet, quotaLimit, durationHours } = input;

  if (booking.resourceType !== 'DIGITAL') {
    throw new Error('Credentials can only be issued for DIGITAL resource bookings');
  }
  if (booking.borrower !== callerWallet) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: Only the booking borrower can receive temporary credentials');
  }
  if (booking.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
    throw new Error(
      `Booking must be verified as ACTIVE on-chain before issuing credentials (current status: ${booking.status})`
    );
  }
  if (quotaLimit <= 0) {
    throw new Error('Usage quota limit must be positive');
  }

  const existingId = store.credentialIdByBooking[booking.bookingId];
  if (existingId && store.credentialsById[existingId]) {
    // Revoke previous credential if re-issued
    const prev = store.credentialsById[existingId];
    prev.revoked = true;
    prev.revokedReason = 'Superseded by newly rotated credential';
  }

  const now = input.nowIso ? new Date(input.nowIso) : new Date();
  const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + durationHours * 3600 * 1000);

  const randomHex = generateRandomHex(18);
  const rawTokenOnce = input.DeterministicTokenOverride ?? `bb_temp_${booking.bookingId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(-6)}_${randomHex}`;
  const tokenHash = hashTemporaryToken(rawTokenOnce);

  const credentialId = `cred-${booking.bookingId}-${Date.now()}`;
  const credential: DigitalCredentialRecord = {
    id: credentialId,
    bookingId: booking.bookingId,
    listingId: booking.listingId,
    borrowerWallet: callerWallet,
    tokenSha256Hash: tokenHash,
    tokenPrefix: `${rawTokenOnce.slice(0, 14)}...`,
    endpointPath: input.endpointPath ?? '/api/demo-resource/weather',
    quotaLimit,
    usageCount: 0,
    expiresAtIso: expiresAt.toISOString(),
    revoked: false,
    createdAtIso: now.toISOString(),
  };

  store.credentialsById[credentialId] = credential;
  store.credentialIdByHash[tokenHash] = credentialId;
  store.credentialIdByBooking[booking.bookingId] = credentialId;

  return { rawTokenOnce, credential };
}

export function revokeCredential(
  store: DigitalGatewayStore,
  credentialId: string,
  callerWallet: string,
  lenderWallet: string,
  reason = 'Revoked by authorized party'
): DigitalCredentialRecord {
  const cred = store.credentialsById[credentialId];
  if (!cred) {
    throw new Error('Credential not found');
  }
  if (callerWallet !== cred.borrowerWallet && callerWallet !== lenderWallet) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: Only borrower or provider can revoke this credential');
  }
  cred.revoked = true;
  cred.revokedReason = reason;
  return cred;
}

export interface ExecuteDemoApiCallInput {
  rawToken: string;
  bookingsById: Record<string, OnChainBooking>;
  queryCity?: string;
  nowIso?: string;
}

export interface ExecuteDemoApiCallResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  statusCode: number;
  error?: string;
  remainingQuota?: number;
  expiresAtIso?: string;
  data?: {
    provider: string;
    station: string;
    city: string;
    timestampIso: string;
    temperatureC: number;
    humidityPct: number;
    windKph: number;
    pressureHpa: number;
    condition: string;
    forecast24h: string;
  };
}

const CITY_TELEMETRY: Record<string, { tempC: number; humidity: number; wind: number; pressure: number; cond: string; station: string }> = {
  'zurich': { tempC: 14.2, humidity: 62, wind: 11.4, pressure: 1016, cond: 'Clear Alpine Air', station: 'MET-ZRH-04' },
  'san francisco': { tempC: 16.8, humidity: 74, wind: 19.2, pressure: 1014, cond: 'Coastal Marine Layer', station: 'MET-SFO-09' },
  'tokyo': { tempC: 21.5, humidity: 58, wind: 14.0, pressure: 1018, cond: 'High Visibility', station: 'MET-HND-02' },
  'london': { tempC: 13.1, humidity: 79, wind: 16.5, pressure: 1009, cond: 'Scattered Stratocumulus', station: 'MET-LHR-11' },
  'singapore': { tempC: 29.4, humidity: 82, wind: 9.8, pressure: 1010, cond: 'Tropical Convection', station: 'MET-SIN-01' },
};

export function executeControlledDemoApiRequest(
  store: DigitalGatewayStore,
  input: ExecuteDemoApiCallInput
): ExecuteDemoApiCallResult {
  const nowIso = input.nowIso ?? new Date().toISOString();
  const cleanToken = (input.rawToken ?? '').trim();

  if (!cleanToken) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      statusCode: 401,
      error: 'Missing temporary API credential token in Authorization header.',
    };
  }

  const tokenHash = hashTemporaryToken(cleanToken);
  const credId = store.credentialIdByHash[tokenHash];
  const cred = credId ? store.credentialsById[credId] : undefined;

  if (!cred) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      statusCode: 401,
      error: 'Invalid or unrecognized temporary API credential.',
    };
  }

  const booking = input.bookingsById[cred.bookingId];
  if (!booking || booking.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
    store.usageEvents.unshift({
      id: `use-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      credentialId: cred.id,
      bookingId: cred.bookingId,
      timestampIso: nowIso,
      requestPath: cred.endpointPath,
      querySummary: `city=${input.queryCity ?? 'zurich'}`,
      statusCode: 403,
      outcome: 'DENIED_INACTIVE_BOOKING',
    });
    return {
      allowed: false,
      statusCode: 403,
      error: `Access denied: Associated on-chain booking (${cred.bookingId}) is no longer ACTIVE (status: ${booking?.status ?? 'UNKNOWN'}).`,
    };
  }

  if (cred.revoked) {
    store.usageEvents.unshift({
      id: `use-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      credentialId: cred.id,
      bookingId: cred.bookingId,
      timestampIso: nowIso,
      requestPath: cred.endpointPath,
      querySummary: `city=${input.queryCity ?? 'zurich'}`,
      statusCode: 403,
      outcome: 'DENIED_REVOKED',
    });
    return {
      allowed: false,
      statusCode: 403,
      error: `Access denied: Temporary credential has been revoked (${cred.revokedReason ?? 'Revoked'}).`,
    };
  }

  if (new Date(nowIso).getTime() >= new Date(cred.expiresAtIso).getTime()) {
    cred.revoked = true;
    cred.revokedReason = 'Rental duration expired';
    store.usageEvents.unshift({
      id: `use-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      credentialId: cred.id,
      bookingId: cred.bookingId,
      timestampIso: nowIso,
      requestPath: cred.endpointPath,
      querySummary: `city=${input.queryCity ?? 'zurich'}`,
      statusCode: 403,
      outcome: 'DENIED_EXPIRED',
    });
    return {
      allowed: false,
      statusCode: 403,
      error: `Access denied: Rental credential expired at ${cred.expiresAtIso}.`,
      remainingQuota: Math.max(0, cred.quotaLimit - cred.usageCount),
      expiresAtIso: cred.expiresAtIso,
    };
  }

  if (cred.usageCount >= cred.quotaLimit) {
    store.usageEvents.unshift({
      id: `use-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      credentialId: cred.id,
      bookingId: cred.bookingId,
      timestampIso: nowIso,
      requestPath: cred.endpointPath,
      querySummary: `city=${input.queryCity ?? 'zurich'}`,
      statusCode: 429,
      outcome: 'DENIED_QUOTA',
    });
    return {
      allowed: false,
      statusCode: 429,
      error: `Usage quota exhausted (${cred.usageCount}/${cred.quotaLimit} requests used). Renew or complete agreement.`,
      remainingQuota: 0,
      expiresAtIso: cred.expiresAtIso,
    };
  }

  // Enforce usage increment
  cred.usageCount += 1;
  const remainingQuota = cred.quotaLimit - cred.usageCount;

  const cityKey = (input.queryCity ?? 'zurich').toLowerCase().trim();
  const baseTelemetry = CITY_TELEMETRY[cityKey] ?? CITY_TELEMETRY['zurich'];

  store.usageEvents.unshift({
    id: `use-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
    credentialId: cred.id,
    bookingId: cred.bookingId,
    timestampIso: nowIso,
    requestPath: cred.endpointPath,
    querySummary: `city=${input.queryCity ?? 'Zurich'}`,
    statusCode: 200,
    outcome: 'ALLOWED',
  });

  return {
    allowed: true,
    statusCode: 200,
    remainingQuota,
    expiresAtIso: cred.expiresAtIso,
    data: {
      provider: 'BorrowBond Controlled Demo Weather & Atmospheric Telemetry Gateway',
      station: baseTelemetry.station,
      city: input.queryCity ?? 'Zurich',
      timestampIso: nowIso,
      temperatureC: baseTelemetry.tempC,
      humidityPct: baseTelemetry.humidity,
      windKph: baseTelemetry.wind,
      pressureHpa: baseTelemetry.pressure,
      condition: baseTelemetry.cond,
      forecast24h: 'Stable barometric trend; telemetry verified via BorrowBond gateway.',
    },
  };
}
```
