```tsx
  Globe,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Smartphone,
  QrCode,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  type MarketplaceListing,
  type OfficialProductPriceSearchResult,
  type ProviderProfile,
  estimateOfficialProductPriceAndHalfCollateral,
  convertNearAndUsdt,
  validateListingPhotosCount,
} from '../lib/security/policyEngine';
import { NearTokenIcon, UsdtTokenIcon } from '../components/TokenIcons';
import {
  ProductQrScannerModal,
  type ScannedProductQrPayload,
} from '../components/ProductQrScannerModal';
import {
  AddressForm,
  type PhysicalListingLocationFormState,
} from '../components/CountryLocationComponents';
import { validatePhysicalListingCreation } from '../lib/location/countryLocationEngine';

interface CreateListingWizardProps {
  connectedWallet: string;
  lenderProfile?: ProviderProfile;
  nearUsdRate?: number;
  onChangeNearUsdRate?: (rate: number) => void;
  displayCurrency?: 'NEAR' | 'USDT';
  onCreated: (newListing: MarketplaceListing) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

const SAMPLE_STUDIO_PHOTOS_PHYSICAL = [
  '/src/assets/images/listing_sony_camera_1794103774108.jpg',
  '/src/assets/images/listing_cinema_projector_1794103775797.jpg',
  '/src/assets/images/listing_lidar_drone_1794103777366.jpg',
];

const SAMPLE_STUDIO_PHOTOS_DIGITAL = [
  '/src/assets/images/listing_weather_api_1794103778935.jpg',
  '/src/assets/images/listing_gpu_compute_1794103779733.jpg',
];

export const CreateListingWizard: React.FC<CreateListingWizardProps> = ({
  connectedWallet,
  lenderProfile,
  nearUsdRate: initialNearUsdRate = 3.7,
  onChangeNearUsdRate,
  displayCurrency = 'USDT',
  onCreated,
  onCancel,
}) => {
  const [resourceType, setResourceType] = useState<'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL'>('PHYSICAL');
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('Cameras & Optics');
  const [brandAndModel, setBrandAndModel] = useState('');
  const [tinOrSerialNumber, setTinOrSerialNumber] = useState('');
  const [digitalAssetSubtype, setDigitalAssetSubtype] = useState<
    'DIGITAL_ACCOUNT' | 'NFT_ASSET' | 'DIGITAL_PRODUCT' | 'API_COMPUTE'
  >('DIGITAL_ACCOUNT');

  // Multi-photo gallery state: Min 2 photos, Max 10 photos
  const [images, setImages] = useState<string[]>([
    SAMPLE_STUDIO_PHOTOS_PHYSICAL[0],
    SAMPLE_STUDIO_PHOTOS_PHYSICAL[1],
  ]);
  const [customImageUrlInput, setCustomImageUrlInput] = useState('');

  // Live NEAR / USDT Exchange Rate & Active Input Currency ('USDT' or 'NEAR')
  const [liveNearUsdRate, setLiveNearUsdRate] = useState<number>(initialNearUsdRate || 3.7);
  const [nearPriceSource, setNearPriceSource] = useState<string>(
    'CoinGecko Live Market Index (NEAR/USDT)'
  );
  const [refreshingRate, setRefreshingRate] = useState(false);
  const [inputCurrency, setInputCurrency] = useState<'NEAR' | 'USDT'>(displayCurrency);

  // User-entered Rental Fee & Collateral in the selected `inputCurrency` (no hardcoded preset)
  const [rentalFeeInput, setRentalFeeInput] = useState<string>('');
  const [collateralInput, setCollateralInput] = useState<string>('');

  // AI Official Price Search State (explicit user action)
  const [aiPriceResult, setAiPriceResult] = useState<OfficialProductPriceSearchResult | null>(null);
  const [searchingOfficialPrice, setSearchingOfficialPrice] = useState(false);

  const [durationUnit, setDurationUnit] = useState<'DAYS' | 'HOURS'>('DAYS');
  const [minDuration, setMinDuration] = useState('1');
  const [maxDuration, setMaxDuration] = useState('5');
  const [conditions, setConditions] = useState(
    'Must be handled carefully and returned in identical condition. Both parties confirm handover and return on-chain.'
  );
  const [cancellationPolicy, setCancellationPolicy] = useState(
    '100% automatic refund if cancelled prior to lender acceptance.'
  );

  // Physical fields
  const [ownerEstimatedValueNear, setOwnerEstimatedValueNear] = useState('');
  const [itemCondition, setItemCondition] = useState('Excellent — Tested & Verified');
  const [includedAccessories, setIncludedAccessories] = useState('');
  const [pickupReturnInstructions, setPickupReturnInstructions] = useState(
    'In-person handover using BorrowBond one-time handover code.'
  );

  // Country-Aware Physical Location & Pickup Address State
  const [physicalLocation, setPhysicalLocation] = useState<PhysicalListingLocationFormState>({
    countryCode: lenderProfile?.countryCode || 'ET',
    regionName: lenderProfile?.regionName || 'Oromia',
    cityName: lenderProfile?.cityName || 'Adama',
    pickupArea: `${lenderProfile?.cityName || 'Adama'} Central`,
    street: 'Kebele 04, Ras Mekonnen Avenue',
    buildingName: 'Rift Valley Innovation Hub, Suite 204',
    postalCode: '1888',
    pickupVisibility: 'PRIVATE',
    publicAddressConfirmed: false,
    pickupInstructions:
      'Bring government ID and verify serial/QR tag during handover. Exact building entrance shared after acceptance.',
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (lenderProfile?.countryCode) {
      setPhysicalLocation((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        countryCode: lenderProfile.countryCode || prev.countryCode,
        regionName: lenderProfile.regionName || prev.regionName,
        cityName: lenderProfile.cityName || prev.cityName,
        pickupArea: prev.pickupArea || `${lenderProfile.cityName || 'Adama'} Central`,
      }));
    }
  }, [lenderProfile?.countryCode, lenderProfile?.regionName, lenderProfile?.cityName]);

  // Digital fields
  const [digitalServiceType, setDigitalServiceType] = useState('Controlled REST Telemetry API');
  const [accessScope, setAccessScope] = useState('read:telemetry (Read-Only)');
  const [usageQuotaRequests, setUsageQuotaRequests] = useState('25');
  const [expirationBehavior, setExpirationBehavior] = useState(
    'Automatic server-side token revocation upon quota exhaustion or rental expiry.'
  );

  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [qrScannerOpen, setQrScannerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [qrModalMode, setQrModalMode] = useState<'SCAN' | 'SHOW_TAG'>('SCAN');
  const [qrScanBanner, setQrScanBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleProductQrScanned = (scanned: ScannedProductQrPayload) => {
    if (scanned.resourceType) {
      setResourceType(scanned.resourceType);
    }
    setTitle(scanned.title);
    setBrandAndModel(scanned.brandAndModel);
    setTinOrSerialNumber(scanned.tinOrSerialNumber);
    if (scanned.category) {
      setCategory(scanned.category);
    }
    if (scanned.description) {
      setDescription(scanned.description);
    }
    if (scanned.officialRetailPriceUsd) {
      const colUsd = Number((scanned.officialRetailPriceUsd / 2).toFixed(2));
      if (inputCurrency === 'USDT') {
        setCollateralInput(String(colUsd));
      } else {
        setCollateralInput(String(Number((colUsd / liveNearUsdRate).toFixed(4))));
      }
      setOwnerEstimatedValueNear(
        String(Number((scanned.officialRetailPriceUsd / liveNearUsdRate).toFixed(4)))
      );
    }
    if (scanned.specs?.accessoriesIncluded && scanned.specs.accessoriesIncluded.length > 0) {
      setIncludedAccessories(scanned.specs.accessoriesIncluded.join(', '));
    }
    if (scanned.specs?.conditionGrade) {
      setItemCondition(scanned.specs.conditionGrade);
    }
    setQrScanBanner(
      `Scanned Product QR Tag: ${scanned.brandAndModel} (${scanned.tinOrSerialNumber}) — Populated verified hardware specs.`
    );
    setErrorMsg(null);
  };

  // Sync with parent live rate and fetch fresh rate on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialNearUsdRate && Number.isFinite(initialNearUsdRate) && initialNearUsdRate > 0) {
      setLiveNearUsdRate(initialNearUsdRate);
    }
  }, [initialNearUsdRate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    fetch('/api/market/near-price')
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((data) => {
        if (mounted && data?.nearUsd && Number.isFinite(data.nearUsd)) {
          setLiveNearUsdRate(Number(data.nearUsd));
          onChangeNearUsdRate?.(Number(data.nearUsd));
          if (data.source) setNearPriceSource(data.source);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        // Keep current live rate
      });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, [onChangeNearUsdRate]);

  // Real-time deterministic AI official price & 50% collateral preview as user types title/description
  const liveAiPreview = useMemo(() => {
    const parsedFee = parseFloat(rentalFeeInput);
    return estimateOfficialProductPriceAndHalfCollateral({
      title: title || 'Professional Equipment',
      description: description || 'Verified item specifications',
      category,
      resourceType,
      nearUsdRate: liveNearUsdRate,
      desiredRentalFee: Number.isFinite(parsedFee) && parsedFee > 0 ? parsedFee : 10,
      desiredCurrency: inputCurrency,
    });
  }, [title, description, category, resourceType, liveNearUsdRate, rentalFeeInput, inputCurrency]);

  const activeAiResult = aiPriceResult || liveAiPreview;

  // Live currency conversions for Rental Fee and Collateral
  const feeConversion = useMemo(() => {
    const val = parseFloat(rentalFeeInput);
    return convertNearAndUsdt(Number.isFinite(val) ? val : 0, inputCurrency, liveNearUsdRate);
  }, [rentalFeeInput, inputCurrency, liveNearUsdRate]);

  const collateralConversion = useMemo(() => {
    const val = parseFloat(collateralInput);
    return convertNearAndUsdt(Number.isFinite(val) ? val : 0, inputCurrency, liveNearUsdRate);
  }, [collateralInput, inputCurrency, liveNearUsdRate]);

  const photoValidation = useMemo(() => validateListingPhotosCount(images), [images]);

  // Switch between NEAR and USDT while preserving the exact monetary value
  const handleCurrencyToggle = (targetCurrency: 'NEAR' | 'USDT') => {
    if (targetCurrency === inputCurrency) return;
    if (rentalFeeInput.trim()) {
      setRentalFeeInput(
        String(targetCurrency === 'NEAR' ? feeConversion.nearAmount : feeConversion.usdtAmount)
      );
    }
    if (collateralInput.trim()) {
      setCollateralInput(
        String(
          targetCurrency === 'NEAR'
            ? collateralConversion.nearAmount
            : collateralConversion.usdtAmount
        )
      );
    }
    setInputCurrency(targetCurrency);
  };

  const handleRefreshNearPrice = async () => {
    setRefreshingRate(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/market/near-price?refresh=true');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data?.nearUsd) {
        setLiveNearUsdRate(Number(data.nearUsd));
        if (data.source) setNearPriceSource(data.source);
      }
    } catch {
      // Retain current rate
    } finally {
      setRefreshingRate(false);
    }
  };

  // Run server-side AI Official Site Search & Apply Suggested 50% Collateral
  const handleRunAiOfficialPriceSearch = async () => {
    setSearchingOfficialPrice(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      const parsedFee = parseFloat(rentalFeeInput);
      const res = await fetch('/api/collateral/ai-price-search', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          title: title.trim() || 'Equipment Listing',
          description: description.trim() || 'Standard verified condition',
          category,
          resourceType,
          nearUsdRate: liveNearUsdRate,
          desiredRentalFee: Number.isFinite(parsedFee) && parsedFee > 0 ? parsedFee : 10,
          desiredCurrency: inputCurrency,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && data.priceSearch) {
        const ps: OfficialProductPriceSearchResult = data.priceSearch;
        setAiPriceResult(ps);
        if (inputCurrency === 'USDT') {
          setCollateralInput(String(ps.recommendedCollateralUsd));
        } else {
          setCollateralInput(String(ps.recommendedCollateralNear));
        }
        setOwnerEstimatedValueNear(String(ps.officialRetailPriceNear));
      }
    } catch {
      if (inputCurrency === 'USDT') {
        setCollateralInput(String(liveAiPreview.recommendedCollateralUsd));
      } else {
        setCollateralInput(String(liveAiPreview.recommendedCollateralNear));
      }
      setOwnerEstimatedValueNear(String(liveAiPreview.officialRetailPriceNear));
    } finally {
      setSearchingOfficialPrice(false);
    }
  };

  // Multi-photo file uploader (supports selecting multiple files up to 10 total)
  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files || files.length === 0) return;

    const remainingSlots = 10 - images.length;
    if (remainingSlots <= 0) {
      setErrorMsg('Maximum 10 photos allowed per listing. Remove a photo before adding another.');
      return;
    }

    const selectedFiles = Array.from(files).slice(0, remainingSlots);
    selectedFiles.forEach((file) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        if (typeof reader.result === 'string') {
          setImages((prev) => (prev.length < 10 ? [...prev, reader.result as string] : prev));
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleAddImageUrl = () => {
    const trimmed = customImageUrlInput.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    if (images.length >= 10) {
      setErrorMsg('Maximum 10 product photos reached.');
      return;
    }
    setImages((prev) => [...prev, trimmed]);
    setCustomImageUrlInput('');
  };

  const handleRemovePhoto = (index: number) => {
    setImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== index));
  };

  const handleMakeCoverPhoto = (index: number) => {
    if (index === 0) return;
    setImages((prev) => {
      const copy = [...prev];
      const [chosen] = copy.splice(index, 1);
      copy.unshift(chosen);
      return copy;
    });
  };

  const handleResourceTypeSwitch = (type: 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL') => {
    setResourceType(type);
    if (type === 'DIGITAL') {
      setCategory('NFTs & Digital Accounts');
      setDurationUnit('HOURS');
      setMinDuration('24');
      setMaxDuration('72');
      setImages((prev) =>
        prev.length > 0 && prev[0] === SAMPLE_STUDIO_PHOTOS_PHYSICAL[0]
          ? SAMPLE_STUDIO_PHOTOS_DIGITAL
          : prev
      );
    } else {
      setCategory('Cameras & Optics');
      setDurationUnit('DAYS');
      setMinDuration('1');
      setMaxDuration('5');
      setImages((prev) =>
        prev.length > 0 && prev[0] === SAMPLE_STUDIO_PHOTOS_DIGITAL[0]
          ? [SAMPLE_STUDIO_PHOTOS_PHYSICAL[0], SAMPLE_STUDIO_PHOTOS_PHYSICAL[1]]
          : prev
      );
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);

    if (!photoValidation.valid) {
      setErrorMsg(photoValidation.error || 'Please attach between 2 and 10 product photos.');
      return;
    }

    const feeNear = feeConversion.nearAmount;
    const colNear = collateralConversion.nearAmount;
    const minD = parseInt(minDuration, 10);
    const maxD = parseInt(maxDuration, 10);

    if (title.trim().length < 4) {
      setErrorMsg('Resource title must be at least 4 characters.');
      return;
    }
    if (description.trim().length < 15) {
      setErrorMsg('Description must be at least 15 characters (include product specs for AI pricing).');
      return;
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(feeNear) || feeNear <= 0) {
      setErrorMsg('Rental fee must be greater than 0.');
      return;
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(colNear) || colNear < 0) {
      setErrorMsg('Required collateral cannot be negative.');
      return;
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(minD) || minD <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(maxD) || maxD < minD) {
      setErrorMsg('Maximum duration must be greater than or equal to minimum duration.');
      return;
    }
    if (conditions.trim().length < 10) {
      setErrorMsg('Please specify clear borrowing conditions (at least 10 characters).');
      return;
    }

    if (resourceType === 'PHYSICAL') {
      const locCheck = validatePhysicalListingCreation({
        resourceType: 'PHYSICAL',
        lenderCountryCode: lenderProfile?.countryCode || physicalLocation.countryCode,
        listingCountryCode: physicalLocation.countryCode,
        regionName: physicalLocation.regionName,
        cityName: physicalLocation.cityName,
        pickupArea: physicalLocation.pickupArea,
        pickupAddress: physicalLocation.street,
        structuredAddress: {
          street: physicalLocation.street,
          buildingName: physicalLocation.buildingName,
          neighborhood: physicalLocation.pickupArea,
          city: physicalLocation.cityName,
          region: physicalLocation.regionName,
          postalCode: physicalLocation.postalCode,
          countryCode: physicalLocation.countryCode,
        },
        pickupVisibility: physicalLocation.pickupVisibility,
        publicAddressConfirmed: physicalLocation.publicAddressConfirmed,
      });

      if (!locCheck.valid) {
        setErrorMsg(locCheck.errors[0]);
        return;
      }
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const fullPickupAddress = [
        physicalLocation.street,
        physicalLocation.buildingName,
        physicalLocation.pickupArea,
        physicalLocation.cityName,
        physicalLocation.regionName,
        physicalLocation.postalCode,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(', ');

      const res = await fetch('/api/listings', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ownerWallet: connectedWallet,
          resourceType,
          title: title.trim(),
          description: description.trim(),
          category,
          brandAndModel: brandAndModel.trim() || title.trim(),
          tinOrSerialNumber:
            tinOrSerialNumber.trim() ||
            `TIN-BB-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8).toUpperCase()}`,
          digitalAssetSubtype: resourceType === 'DIGITAL' ? digitalAssetSubtype : undefined,
          images,
          imageUrl: images[0],
          rentalFeeNear: feeNear,
          collateralNear: colNear,
          officialRetailPriceUsd: activeAiResult.officialRetailPriceUsd,
          preferredCurrency: inputCurrency,
          nearUsdRateAtListing: liveNearUsdRate,
          durationUnit,
          minDuration: minD,
          maxDuration: maxD,
          conditions: conditions.trim(),
          cancellationPolicy: cancellationPolicy.trim(),
          ownerEstimatedValueNear:
            parseFloat(ownerEstimatedValueNear) || activeAiResult.officialRetailPriceNear,
          itemCondition,
          includedAccessories,
          pickupReturnInstructions:
            resourceType === 'PHYSICAL'
              ? physicalLocation.pickupInstructions || pickupReturnInstructions
              : pickupReturnInstructions,
          countryCode: resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? physicalLocation.countryCode : undefined,
          regionName: resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? physicalLocation.regionName : undefined,
          cityName: resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? physicalLocation.cityName : undefined,
          pickupArea: resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? physicalLocation.pickupArea : undefined,
          pickupAddress: resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? fullPickupAddress : undefined,
          structuredAddress:
            resourceType === 'PHYSICAL'
              ? {
                  street: physicalLocation.street,
                  buildingName: physicalLocation.buildingName,
                  neighborhood: physicalLocation.pickupArea,
                  city: physicalLocation.cityName,
                  region: physicalLocation.regionName,
                  postalCode: physicalLocation.postalCode,
                  countryCode: physicalLocation.countryCode,
                }
              : undefined,
          pickupVisibility:
            resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? physicalLocation.pickupVisibility : undefined,
          publicAddressConfirmed:
            resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? physicalLocation.publicAddressConfirmed : undefined,
          pickupInstructions:
            resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? physicalLocation.pickupInstructions : undefined,
          digitalServiceType,
          accessScope,
          usageQuotaRequests: parseInt(usageQuotaRequests, 10) || 20,
          expirationBehavior,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setErrorMsg(data.error || 'Failed to publish listing');
      } else {
        onCreated(data.listing);
      }
    } catch {
      setErrorMsg('Network error publishing listing.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 py-8 space-y-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-800/80 pb-6">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#00EC97]">
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>NEAR ESCROW &amp; ANTI-SCAM REGISTRY</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold font-display text-[#F5F8FF]">
            List a Physical or Digital Asset
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#9BA8C0]">
            Attach 2–10 photos, register your item&apos;s TIN/Serial or NFT ID, and set your rental price and refundable collateral in NEAR or USDT.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setQrModalMode('SCAN');
              setQrScannerOpen(true);
            }}
            className="btn-near-primary px-3.5 py-2 text-xs shrink-0"
          >
            <QrCode className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Scan Product QR / Barcode</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {qrScanBanner && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#00EC97]/12 border border-[#00EC97]/40 text-xs text-[#00EC97] flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{qrScanBanner}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setQrModalMode('SHOW_TAG');
              setQrScannerOpen(true);
            }}
            className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#06080F] border border-[#00EC97]/50 text-[#F5F8FF] font-semibold cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            View Product QR Tag
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Step 1: Select Physical vs Digital */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Resource Type">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleResourceTypeSwitch('PHYSICAL')}
          className={`p-5 rounded-2xl text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            resourceType === 'PHYSICAL'
              ? 'near-glow-card'
              : 'near-glass-card hover:border-slate-700'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
            <span className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F5F8FF]">
              Physical Item (Same-Country Borrowing)
            </span>
            <Camera className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00EC97]" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#9BA8C0]">
            Requires country, region, city &amp; pickup address. Borrowers and lenders must be in the
            same country for physical handover.
          </p>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleResourceTypeSwitch('DIGITAL')}
          className={`p-5 rounded-2xl text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            resourceType === 'DIGITAL'
              ? 'near-glow-card'
              : 'near-glass-card hover:border-slate-700'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
            <span className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F5F8FF]">
              Digital Resource (Global Availability)
            </span>
            <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 text-[#17F1D1]" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#9BA8C0]">
            Globally available across all countries. Instant temporary credentials &amp; API access
            after escrow lock.
          </p>
        </button>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="near-glass-card rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-7">
        {errorMsg && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#F87171]/10 border border-[#F87171]/40 text-xs text-[#F87171] flex items-center gap-2.5"
          >
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{errorMsg}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Section A: Product Title, Anti-Scam TIN/Serial Registry & Specifications */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <label htmlFor="wiz-title" className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#F5F8FF] mb-1.5">
              Product / Digital Asset Title *
            </label>
            <input
              id="wiz-title"
              type="text"
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={
                resourceType === 'PHYSICAL'
                  ? 'iPhone 18 Pro Max — 256/32GB Silver'
                  : 'NEAR Zero-G Utility NFT Pass & Pro Account'
              }
              className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 text-sm bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00EC97]"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="wiz-brand" className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#F5F8FF] mb-1.5">
              Exact Brand &amp; Model (Anti-Scam Registry) *
            </label>
            <input
              id="wiz-brand"
              type="text"
              value={brandAndModel}
              onChange={(e) => setBrandAndModel(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={
                resourceType === 'PHYSICAL'
                  ? 'Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max 256/32 Silver'
                  : 'NEAR Zero-G NFT Pass #402'
              }
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00EC97]"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
              <label htmlFor="wiz-tin" className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#00EC97]">
                TIN / Serial / IMEI / NFT Token ID *
              </label>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setQrModalMode('SCAN');
                  setQrScannerOpen(true);
                }}
                className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[#17F1D1] hover:text-[#00EC97] inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <QrCode className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Scan QR / Barcode</span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                id="wiz-tin"
                type="text"
                value={tinOrSerialNumber}
                onChange={(e) => setTinOrSerialNumber(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={
                  resourceType === 'PHYSICAL'
                    ? 'TIN-AAPL-IP18PM-994821'
                    : 'NEP171-ZEROG-PASS-0402'
                }
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm font-mono bg-[#06080F] border border-[#00EC97]/40 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00EC97]"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                title="Generate or Scan Product QR Tag"
                onClick={() => {
                  setQrModalMode('SHOW_TAG');
                  setQrScannerOpen(true);
                }}
                className="btn-near-secondary px-3 py-2.5 text-xs shrink-0"
              >
                <QrCode className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00EC97]" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {resourceType === 'DIGITAL' && (
            <div className="sm:col-span-2">
              <label htmlFor="wiz-dsubtype" className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#17F1D1] mb-1.5">
                Digital Product Type
              </label>

              value={conditions}
              onChange={(e) => setConditions(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF]"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="wiz-cancel" className="block text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] mb-1">
              Cancellation Policy
            </label>
            <input
              id="wiz-cancel"
              type="text"
              value={cancellationPolicy}
              onChange={(e) => setCancellationPolicy(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF]"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-4">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onCancel}
            className="btn-near-secondary px-4 py-2.5 text-xs"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="btn-near-primary px-6 py-2.5 text-xs"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>
              {submitting
                ? 'Publishing Listing...'
                : `Publish Resource Listing (${images.length} Photos)`}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      <ProductQrScannerModal
        isOpen={qrScannerOpen}
        onClose={() => setQrScannerOpen(false)}
        mode={qrModalMode}
        title="Scan Product QR or Serial Barcode to Auto-Fill Listing"
        subtitle="Scan a BorrowBond Anti-Scam Product QR tag or device IMEI/Serial sticker to auto-populate specs & 50% collateral."
        activeProductTag={{
          title: title.trim() || 'iPhone 18 Pro Max — 256/32GB Titanium Silver',
          brandAndModel: brandAndModel.trim() || 'Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max (256GB / 32GB Silver)',
          tinOrSerialNumber: tinOrSerialNumber.trim() || 'TIN-AAPL-IP18PM-994821',
          category,
          resourceType,
          officialRetailPriceUsd: activeAiResult.officialRetailPriceUsd,
        }}
        onScanSuccess={handleProductQrScanned}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  KeyRound,
  Play,
  Ban,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  ArrowUpRight,
  Wallet,
  Award,
  Bell,
  AlertTriangle,
  RotateCcw,
  Search,
  Calendar,
  Filter,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  calculateLateDueDateInterest,
  filterBookingsHistory,
  type OnChainBooking,
} from '../lib/near/escrowStateMachine';
import type { MarketplaceListing, ProviderProfile } from '../lib/security/policyEngine';
import type { DigitalCredentialRecord, DigitalUsageEvent } from '../lib/digital/accessGateway';
import {
  LocationCard,
  CountryBadge,
} from '../components/CountryLocationComponents';

export interface EnrichedCredential extends DigitalCredentialRecord {
  authorizedRawToken?: string;
}

interface DashboardViewProps {
  connectedWallet: string;
  profile?: ProviderProfile;
  bookings: OnChainBooking[];
  listings: MarketplaceListing[];
  claimableBalancesNear: Record<string, number>;
  myCredentials: EnrichedCredential[];
  myUsageEvents: DigitalUsageEvent[];
  notifications: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    timestampIso: string;
    bookingId?: string;
  }[];
  onOpenBookingDetails: (bookingId: string) => void;
  onOpenListing: (listingId: string) => void;
  onWithdrawClaimable: () => Promise<void>;
  onRefreshState: () => Promise<void>;
  onResetDemoState?: () => Promise<void>;
}

export const DashboardView: React.FC<DashboardViewProps> = ({
  connectedWallet,
  profile,
  bookings,
  listings,
  claimableBalancesNear,
  myCredentials,
  myUsageEvents,
  notifications,
  onOpenBookingDetails,
  onOpenListing,
  onWithdrawClaimable,
  onRefreshState,
  onResetDemoState,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<
    'BORROWINGS' | 'LENDINGS' | 'DIGITAL_ACCESS' | 'LISTINGS' | 'PASSPORT'
  >('BORROWINGS');

  // Booking History Search & Filter state (item name, status, or date)
  const [historySearchQuery, setHistorySearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [historyStatusFilter, setHistoryStatusFilter] = useState('ALL');
  const [historyDateFilter, setHistoryDateFilter] = useState('');

  // Interactive Controlled Demo Weather API Tester state
  const [selectedCity, setSelectedCity] = useState('Zurich');
  const [customTokenInput, setCustomTokenInput] = useState(
    myCredentials[0]?.authorizedRawToken || ''
  );
  const [apiResponseJson, setApiResponseJson] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [apiLoading, setApiLoading] = useState(false);
  const [withdrawing, setWithdrawing] = useState(false);
  const [resettingDemo, setResettingDemo] = useState(false);

  const myBorrowings = useMemo(
    () => bookings.filter((b) => b.borrower === connectedWallet),
    [bookings, connectedWallet]
  );
  const myLendings = useMemo(
    () => bookings.filter((b) => b.lender === connectedWallet),
    [bookings, connectedWallet]
  );
  const myListings = useMemo(
    () => listings.filter((l) => l.ownerWallet === connectedWallet),
    [listings, connectedWallet]
  );

  const activeRoleBookings = activeTab === 'LENDINGS' ? myLendings : myBorrowings;

  const filteredRoleBookings = useMemo(
    () =>
      filterBookingsHistory(activeRoleBookings, {
        searchQuery: historySearchQuery,
        statusFilter: historyStatusFilter,
        dateFilter: historyDateFilter,
      }),
    [activeRoleBookings, historySearchQuery, historyStatusFilter, historyDateFilter]
  );

  const hasActiveHistoryFilters =
    historySearchQuery.trim() !== '' ||
    historyStatusFilter !== 'ALL' ||
    historyDateFilter.trim() !== '';

  const clearHistoryFilters = () => {
    setHistorySearchQuery('');
    setHistoryStatusFilter('ALL');
    setHistoryDateFilter('');
  };

  const lockedCollateralNear = myBorrowings
    .filter((b) => ['REQUESTED', 'ACCEPTED', 'ACTIVE', 'RETURN_REQUESTED', 'DISPUTED'].includes(b.status))
    .reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.collateralNear, 0);

  const myClaimableNear = claimableBalancesNear[connectedWallet] ?? 0;

  const handleCallDemoWeatherApi = async (simulateExpired = false) => {
    const tokenToUse = customTokenInput.trim() || myCredentials[0]?.authorizedRawToken || '';
    setApiLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/demo-resource/weather', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${tokenToUse}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          city: selectedCity,
          simulateExpired,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      setApiResponseJson(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
      await onRefreshState();
    } catch {
      setApiResponseJson(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Network error calling Demo API Gateway' }, null, 2));
    } finally {
      setApiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRevokeCredential = async (credentialId: string) => {
    await fetch('/api/digital/revoke-token', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        credentialId,
        callerWallet: connectedWallet,
        reason: 'Manually revoked by borrower from Digital Access Dashboard',
      }),
    });
    await onRefreshState();
  };

  const handleWithdraw = async () => {
    setWithdrawing(true);
    try {
      await onWithdrawClaimable();
    } finally {
      setWithdrawing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDemoClick = async () => {
    if (!onResetDemoState) return;
    setResettingDemo(true);
    try {
      await onResetDemoState();
    } finally {
      setResettingDemo(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-8 space-y-8">
      {/* Header & KPI Metrics Row */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#27312A] pb-5">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold font-display text-[#F2F5F1]">
            Dashboard
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#A0AAA2]">
            Manage your active borrowings, lending agreements, digital credentials, and location settings for{' '}
            <code className="font-mono text-[#F2F5F1]">{connectedWallet}</code>.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          {onResetDemoState && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={resettingDemo}
              onClick={handleResetDemoClick}
              className="btn-near-secondary px-3.5 py-2 text-xs"
            >
              <RotateCcw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#8BD6A7] ${resettingDemo ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span>{resettingDemo ? 'Resetting...' : 'Reset Demo Data'}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {myClaimableNear > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={withdrawing}
              onClick={handleWithdraw}
              className="btn-near-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs"
            >
              <Wallet className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>
                {withdrawing
                  ? 'Withdrawing...'
                  : `Withdraw Claimable Escrow (${myClaimableNear.toFixed(4)} NEAR)`}
              </span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4-Column Metric Strip */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-1">
          <span className="text-xs text-[#A4B0C4]">Active Borrowings</span>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-[#F3F6FC] tabular-nums">
            {myBorrowings.filter((b) => ['REQUESTED', 'ACCEPTED', 'ACTIVE', 'RETURN_REQUESTED'].includes(b.status)).length}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">Total agreements: {myBorrowings.length}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-1">
          <span className="text-xs text-[#A4B0C4]">Locked Refundable Collateral</span>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-[#5EEAD4] tabular-nums">
            {lockedCollateralNear.toFixed(2)} NEAR
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">Held in `borrowbondtest.testnet`</span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-1">
          <span className="text-xs text-[#A4B0C4]">Claimable Settlement Balance</span>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-[#34D399] tabular-nums">
            {myClaimableNear.toFixed(4)} NEAR
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">Safe pull-withdrawal pattern</span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-1">
          <span className="text-xs text-[#A4B0C4]">Active Digital Credentials</span>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-[#8297FF] tabular-nums">
            {myCredentials.filter((c) => !c.revoked).length}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">Quota & expiration enforced on server</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Screen A & Screen G: User Profile Location, International Phone & Contact Privacy Card */}
      <LocationCard
        profile={profile}
        walletAccountId={connectedWallet}
        isOwnProfile={true}
        onProfileUpdated={() => {
          onRefreshState();
        }}
      />

      {/* Navigation Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
        {[
          { id: 'BORROWINGS', label: `My Borrowings (${myBorrowings.length})` },
          { id: 'LENDINGS', label: `Incoming Lending Requests (${myLendings.length})` },
          { id: 'DIGITAL_ACCESS', label: `Digital Access & API Gateway (${myCredentials.length})` },
          { id: 'LISTINGS', label: `My Listed Resources (${myListings.length})` },
          { id: 'PASSPORT', label: 'Borrowing Passport & Notifications' },
        ].map((tab) => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id as typeof activeTab)}
            className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer glass-nav-pill ${
              activeTab === tab.id
                ? 'glass-nav-pill-active text-[#8BD6A7]'
                : 'text-[#A0AAA2] hover:text-[#F2F5F1]'
            }`}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1 & 2: Borrowings or Lendings Table with Search & Filter Bar */}
      {(activeTab === 'BORROWINGS' || activeTab === 'LENDINGS') && (
        <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F3F6FC]">
                {activeTab === 'BORROWINGS'
                  ? 'Borrowing Agreements & Escrow Status'
                  : 'Lending Agreements (Provider Queue)'}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#A4B0C4] mt-0.5">
                Click any booking to inspect timeline, upload handover/return evidence, or resolve disputes
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[#5EEAD4]">
              Showing {filteredRoleBookings.length} of {activeRoleBookings.length} agreements
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Search & Filter Bar by Item Name, Status, or Date */}
          <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-[#0B1020]/70 border-b border-slate-800/80 space-y-3">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-3">
              {/* Search by Item Name, Status, or Date */}
              <div className="md:col-span-6 relative">
                <label htmlFor="dashboard-booking-search" className="sr-only">
                  Search booking history by item name, status, or date
                </label>
                <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#5EEAD4] absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                <input
                  id="dashboard-booking-search"
                  type="text"
                  value={historySearchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setHistorySearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search by item name, status (e.g. ACTIVE, COMPLETED), date, or serial..."
                  className="w-full pl-10 pr-8 py-2 text-xs bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-700/80 rounded-lg text-[#F3F6FC] placeholder:text-[#A4B0C4]/70 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00EC97]"
                />
                {historySearchQuery && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label="Clear search query"
                    onClick={() => setHistorySearchQuery('')}
                    className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#A4B0C4] hover:text-[#F3F6FC] cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Filter by Status Dropdown */}
              <div className="md:col-span-3 relative">
                <label htmlFor="dashboard-status-filter" className="sr-only">
                  Filter by booking status
                </label>
                <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#A4B0C4] absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                <select
                  id="dashboard-status-filter"
                  value={historyStatusFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setHistoryStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-2 text-xs bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-700/80 rounded-lg text-[#F3F6FC] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00EC97]"
                >
                  <option value="ALL">All Statuses</option>
                  <option value="ACTIVE">ACTIVE</option>
                  <option value="COMPLETED">COMPLETED</option>
                  <option value="REQUESTED">REQUESTED</option>
                  <option value="ACCEPTED">ACCEPTED</option>
                  <option value="RETURN_REQUESTED">RETURN_REQUESTED</option>
                  <option value="DISPUTED">DISPUTED</option>
                  <option value="RESOLVED">RESOLVED</option>
                  <option value="OVERDUE">OVERDUE (3% APY)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Filter by Date (YYYY-MM-DD or Month/Day) */}
              <div className="md:col-span-3 relative">
                <label htmlFor="dashboard-date-filter" className="sr-only">
                  Filter by booking date
                </label>
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#A4B0C4] absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                <input
                  id="dashboard-date-filter"
                  type="text"
                  value={historyDateFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setHistoryDateFilter(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Date (e.g. 2026-11 or Nov)"
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-2 text-xs bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-700/80 rounded-lg text-[#F3F6FC] placeholder:text-[#A4B0C4]/70 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00EC97]"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Status Filter Pills & Clear Action */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                {(['ALL', 'ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED', 'REQUESTED', 'DISPUTED', 'OVERDUE'] as const).map(
                  (st) => (
                    <button
                      key={st}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setHistoryStatusFilter(st)}
                      className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono transition-colors cursor-pointer border ${
                        historyStatusFilter === st
                          ? 'bg-[#00EC97]/20 border-[#00EC97] text-[#00EC97] font-bold'
                          : 'bg-[#121B2C] border-slate-800 text-[#A4B0C4] hover:text-[#F3F6FC]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {st === 'ALL' ? 'All' : st}
                    </button>
                  )
                )}
              </div>

              {hasActiveHistoryFilters && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={clearHistoryFilters}
                  className="text-xs text-[#00EC97] hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {activeRoleBookings.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center text-xs text-[#A4B0C4]">
              No agreements found for <code className="font-mono text-[#F3F6FC]">{connectedWallet}</code> in this role. Tip: Use the top-right wallet switcher to switch between <code className="font-mono">alex-builder.testnet</code> (Borrower) and <code className="font-mono">optics-lab.testnet</code> (Lender).
            </div>
          ) : filteredRoleBookings.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center space-y-3 text-xs text-[#A4B0C4]">
              <p>
                No bookings matched your filter{' '}
                {historySearchQuery && (
                  <strong className="text-[#F3F6FC]">&ldquo;{historySearchQuery}&rdquo;</strong>
                )}{' '}
                {historyStatusFilter !== 'ALL' && (
                  <span className="font-mono text-[#5EEAD4]">[{historyStatusFilter}]</span>
                )}{' '}
                {historyDateFilter && (
                  <span className="font-mono text-[#00EC97]">({historyDateFilter})</span>
                )}
                .
              </p>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={clearHistoryFilters}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#172338] text-[#00EC97] border border-[#00EC97]/40 hover:bg-[#00EC97]/10 font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              >
                Reset Search &amp; Filters
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-800 text-[#A4B0C4] bg-[#0B1020]/60">
                    <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium">Booking ID</th>
                    <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium">Resource</th>
                    <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium">Date &amp; Deadline</th>
                    <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium">Counterparty</th>
                    <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium text-right">Rental Fee</th>
                    <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium text-right">Collateral</th>
                    <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium">Contract Status</th>
                    <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium text-right">Action</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/70">
                  {filteredRoleBookings.map((bk) => (
                    <tr key={bk.bookingId} className="hover:bg-[#172338]/60">
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono text-[#F3F6FC]">
                        <div>{bk.bookingId}</div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
                          {bk.isSimulatedTx === false ? 'Verified Tx' : 'Simulated'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-[#F3F6FC]">{bk.listingTitle}</div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
                          {bk.resourceType} · {bk.durationCount} {bk.durationUnit.toLowerCase()}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
                        <div className="text-[#F3F6FC]">
                          {bk.createdAtIso ? bk.createdAtIso.slice(0, 10) : '—'}
                        </div>
                        {bk.rentalEndIso && (
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
                            Due: {bk.rentalEndIso.slice(0, 10)}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono text-[#A4B0C4]">
                        {activeTab === 'BORROWINGS' ? bk.lender : bk.borrower}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono tabular-nums text-right text-[#F3F6FC]">
                        {bk.rentalFeeNear} NEAR
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono tabular-nums text-right text-[#5EEAD4]">
                        {bk.collateralNear} NEAR
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono font-semibold">
                        {(() => {
                          if (bk.status === 'ACTIVE' || bk.status === 'RETURN_REQUESTED') {
                            const late = calculateLateDueDateInterest(bk);
                            if (late.isOverdue) {
                              return (
                                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#F87171]/20 border border-[#F87171]/60 text-[#F87171] text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap animate-pulse">
                                    <span>OVERDUE · 3% APY</span>
                                  </span>
                                  <div className="text-[10px] text-[#F87171] font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                                    +{late.accruedLateFeeNear} NEAR
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              );
                            }
                            if (late.urgencyLevel === 'DUE_SOON') {
                              return (
                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#FBBF24]/20 border border-[#FBBF24]/60 text-[#FBBF24] text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap">
                                  <span>DUE SOON</span>
                                </span>
                              );
                            }
                            return (
                              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#00EC97]/15 border border-[#00EC97]/40 text-[#00EC97] text-[10px] font-bold inline-block whitespace-nowrap">
                                ACTIVE (ON SCHEDULE)
                              </span>
                            );
                          }
                          return (
                            <span
                              className={`whitespace-nowrap ${
                                bk.status === 'COMPLETED' || bk.status === 'RESOLVED'
                                  ? 'text-[#34D399]'
                                  : bk.status === 'DISPUTED'
                                  ? 'text-[#F87171]'
                                  : 'text-[#FBBF24]'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {bk.status}
                            </span>
                          );
                        })()}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onOpenBookingDetails(bk.bookingId)}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-md bg-[#172338] text-[#5EEAD4] border border-slate-700 hover:border-[#5EEAD4] inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <span>Manage Agreement</span>
                          <ArrowUpRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 3: Digital Access Dashboard & Interactive Controlled Demo API Gateway */}
      {activeTab === 'DIGITAL_ACCESS' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-start">

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-6">

                  </h2>
                </div>

              </div>

              {myCredentials.length === 0 ? (

              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-4">

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={cred.id}
                        className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 space-y-3 text-xs"

                            Booking: {cred.bookingId}
                          </span>

                            }`}
                          >
                            {cred.revoked
                              ? `REVOKED (${cred.revokedReason || 'Expired'})`

                              ? 'QUOTA_EXHAUSTED'
                              : 'ACTIVE'}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        {cred.authorizedRawToken && (

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[#A4B0C4]">

                    </div>
                  ))}

              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right 6 Columns: Controlled Demo Weather API Gateway Interactive Console */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-[#172338] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">

              <p className="text-xs text-[#A4B0C4] mt-0.5">

              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="gw-token" className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1">

                />

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="gw-city" className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1">

                  <option value="Tokyo">Tokyo (Station MET-HND-02)</option>
                  <option value="London">London (Station MET-LHR-11)</option>
                  <option value="Singapore">Singapore (Station MET-SIN-01)</option>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 pt-2">

                <button
                  type="button"

                  className="px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-[#121B2C] text-[#FBBF24] border border-slate-700 hover:border-[#FBBF24] transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"

      )}

      {activeTab === 'PASSPORT' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8">

              <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-[#5EEAD4]" />
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F3F6FC]">
                Verifiable On-Chain Borrowing Passport
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-[#A4B0C4]">NEAR Account ID</span>
                <code className="font-mono text-[#F3F6FC]">{connectedWallet}</code>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-[#A4B0C4]">Authentication Status</span>
                <span className="text-[#5EEAD4] font-medium">
                  Wallet Connected (Not KYC Identity Verified)
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-[#A4B0C4]">Completed Borrows</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#F3F6FC] tabular-nums">
                  {profile?.completedBorrows ?? 0}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-[#A4B0C4]">Completed Lends</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#F3F6FC] tabular-nums">
                  {profile?.completedLends ?? 0}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-[#A4B0C4]">Recorded Disputes</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#34D399] tabular-nums">
                  {profile?.disputesCount ?? 0}

          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <Bell className="w-4 h-4 text-[#8297FF]" />
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F3F6FC]">
                Agreement & Settlement Notifications
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
              {notifications.map((n) => (
                <div
                  key={n.id}
                  className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800/80 text-xs space-y-1"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <strong className="text-[#F3F6FC]">{n.title}</strong>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
                      {new Date(n.timestampIso).toLocaleTimeString()}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[#A4B0C4]">{n.message}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';

}

}) => {

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">

      {/* 2. Category Selection */}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';

  evaluateSpendingAndSecurityPolicy,

} from '../lib/security/policyEngine';
import { ResilientImage } from '../components/ResilientImage';

  getCountryName,
} from '../lib/location/countryLocationEngine';

interface ListingDetailsViewProps {
  listing: MarketplaceListing;
  provider?: ProviderProfile;
  borrowerProfile?: ProviderProfile;
  policy: SpendingPolicy;
  nearUsdRate?: number;
  displayCurrency?: 'NEAR' | 'USDT';
  onToggleCurrency?: (currency: 'NEAR' | 'USDT') => void;
  onUpdatePolicy?: (newPolicy: SpendingPolicy) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  onProceedToCheckout: (listingId: string, durationCount: number) => void;
  onNavigateProfileLocation?: () => void;
}

export const ListingDetailsView: React.FC<ListingDetailsViewProps> = ({
  listing,
  provider,
  borrowerProfile,
  policy,
  nearUsdRate = 3.7,
  displayCurrency = 'NEAR',
  onToggleCurrency,
  onUpdatePolicy,
  onBack,
  onProceedToCheckout,
  onNavigateProfileLocation,
}) => {
  const [selectedDuration, setSelectedDuration] = useState<number>(listing.exampleDuration);
  const [startDateIso, setStartDateIso] = useState<string>(() => {
    const today = new Date();
    return today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  });
  const [activePhotoIndex, setActivePhotoIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const [qrModalOpen, setQrModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [qrModalMode, setQrModalMode] = useState<'SCAN' | 'SHOW_TAG' | 'SPECS_CAPTURE' | 'TRUST_VERIFY'>('TRUST_VERIFY');
  const [productTrustVerified, setProductTrustVerified] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const computedEndDateLabel = useMemo(() => {
    const base = new Date(`${startDateIso}T10:00:00`);
    if (Number.isNaN(base.getTime())) return 'Flexible';
    const msToAdd =
      listing.durationUnit === 'HOURS'
        ? selectedDuration * 3600 * 1000
        : selectedDuration * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
    const end = new Date(base.getTime() + msToAdd);
    return end.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      year: 'numeric',
    });
  }, [startDateIso, selectedDuration, listing.durationUnit]);

  const galleryPhotos = useMemo(() => {
    if (Array.isArray(listing.images) && listing.images.length > 0) {
      return listing.images;
    }
    return [listing.imageUrl];
  }, [listing]);

  const safePhotoIndex = Math.min(activePhotoIndex, galleryPhotos.length - 1);

  const ratio = Math.max(1, selectedDuration) / Math.max(1, listing.exampleDuration);
  const calculatedFeeNear = Number((listing.rentalFeeNear * ratio).toFixed(4));
  const collateralNear = listing.collateralNear;
  const totalEscrowNear = Number((calculatedFeeNear + collateralNear).toFixed(4));

  const effectiveRate = nearUsdRate;
  const calculatedFeeUsdt = Number((calculatedFeeNear * effectiveRate).toFixed(2));
  const collateralUsdt = Number((collateralNear * effectiveRate).toFixed(2));
  const totalEscrowUsdt = Number((calculatedFeeUsdt + collateralUsdt).toFixed(2));

  const physicalEligibility = useMemo(() => {
    return evaluatePhysicalEligibility({
      listing,
      borrowerProfile,
      lenderProfile: provider,
    });
  }, [listing, borrowerProfile, provider]);

  const securityCheck = useMemo(() => {
    return evaluateSpendingAndSecurityPolicy(
      listing,
      selectedDuration,
      policy,
      provider,
      undefined,
      borrowerProfile
    );
  }, [listing, selectedDuration, policy, provider, borrowerProfile]);

  const collateralRecommendation = useMemo(() => {
    const durationDays =
      listing.durationUnit === 'HOURS'
        ? Math.max(1, Math.round(selectedDuration / 24))
        : selectedDuration;
    return calculateCollateralRecommendation({
      resourceType: listing.resourceType,
      category: listing.category,
      ownerEstimatedValueNear: listing.ownerEstimatedValueNear,
      providerMinimumCollateralNear: listing.collateralNear,
      rentalDurationDays: durationDays,
      borrowerCompletedCount: borrowerProfile?.completedBorrows ?? 0,
      borrowerDisputesCount: borrowerProfile?.disputesCount ?? 0,
      digitalAccessScope: listing.accessScope,
    });
  }, [listing, selectedDuration, borrowerProfile]);

  const handleAutoAdjustPolicyForItem = () => {
    if (!onUpdatePolicy) return;
    const updatedCategories = policy.allowedCategories.includes(listing.category)
      ? policy.allowedCategories
      : [...policy.allowedCategories, listing.category];
    onUpdatePolicy({
      ...policy,
      maxRentalFeeNear: Math.max(policy.maxRentalFeeNear, Number((calculatedFeeNear * 1.2).toFixed(2))),
      maxCollateralNear: Math.max(policy.maxCollateralNear, Number((collateralNear * 1.2).toFixed(2))),
      maxTotalPaymentNear: Math.max(policy.maxTotalPaymentNear, Number((totalEscrowNear * 1.2).toFixed(2))),
      allowedCategories: updatedCategories,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 py-8 space-y-8">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <button

          onClick={onBack}
          className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#9BA8C0] hover:text-[#00EC97] flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"

          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Back to Marketplace</span>
        </button>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <motion.button
            whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setQrModalMode('TRUST_VERIFY');
              setQrModalOpen(true);
            }}
            className="btn-near-primary px-3 py-1.5 text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(0,236,151,0.25)]"
          >
            <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Verify Hardware QR with Camera</span>
          </motion.button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setQrModalMode('SHOW_TAG');
              setQrModalOpen(true);
            }}
            className="btn-near-secondary px-3 py-1.5 text-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
          >
            <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00EC97]" />
            <span>Product QR Tag</span>
          </button>

          {onToggleCurrency && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onToggleCurrency(displayCurrency === 'NEAR' ? 'USDT' : 'NEAR')}
              className="btn-near-secondary px-3 py-1.5 text-xs"
            >
              <NearTokenIcon size={15} />
              <ArrowLeftRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00EC97]" />
              <UsdtTokenIcon size={15} />
              <span>
                Viewing in {displayCurrency} (Live 1 NEAR = {nearUsdRate.toFixed(2)} USDT)
              </span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-start">
        {/* Left Column: Multi-Photo Gallery (2-10 Photos in Glass Frames), Description, & Collateral Explanation */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-6">
          <div className="near-glass-card rounded-2xl overflow-hidden p-4 space-y-4">
            {/* Hero Image Viewport inside Frosted Glass Frame */}
            <div className="glass-image-frame relative aspect-4/3 w-full">
              <ResilientImage
                src={galleryPhotos[safePhotoIndex]}
                alt={`${listing.title} — Photo ${safePhotoIndex + 1}`}
                resourceType={listing.resourceType}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover"
              />

              {/* Photo Counter Badge */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-10 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#06080F]/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-700/80 text-xs font-mono text-[#F5F8FF] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Images className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00EC97]" />
                <span>
                  Photo {safePhotoIndex + 1} of {galleryPhotos.length}

              </div>

              {galleryPhotos.length > 1 && (

                  <button

                    className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10 p-2 rounded-full bg-[#06080F]/80 text-[#F5F8FF] hover:bg-[#00EC97] hover:text-[#04080E] transition-colors cursor-pointer"

                    <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />

                  >

            {galleryPhotos.length > 1 && (

                    >

            <button
              type="button"

              onClick={() => onProceedToCheckout(listing.id, selectedDuration)}
              className={`w-full py-3 px-4 text-sm font-bold rounded-xl transition-all ${
                securityCheck.passed && physicalEligibility.eligible
                  ? 'btn-near-primary'
                  : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed border border-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              {!physicalEligibility.eligible
                ? 'Not Available in Your Country (Same-Country Physical Policy)'
                : securityCheck.passed
                ? `Proceed to Borrowing Checkout (${totalEscrowNear} NEAR / $${totalEscrowUsdt} USDT)`
                : 'Exceeds Active Spending Policy (Tap Above to Raise Limit)'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Provider Profile */}
          <div className="near-glass-card rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00EC97]" />
                <span className="font-semibold text-[#F5F8FF]">
                  {provider?.displayName || listing.ownerDisplayName}
                </span>
              </div>
              <code className="font-mono text-[#9BA8C0]">{listing.ownerWallet}</code>
            </div>
            {(provider?.countryCode || listing.countryCode) && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1.5 px-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800/80">
                <span className="text-[#9BA8C0]">Provider Location:</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-[#F5F8FF] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <CountryFlag countryCode={provider?.countryCode || listing.countryCode} />
                  <span>
                    {provider?.countryName || getCountryName(provider?.countryCode || listing.countryCode)}
                    {provider?.regionName ? ` · ${provider.regionName}` : ''}
                    {provider?.cityName ? ` · ${provider.cityName}` : ''}
                  </span>
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
            <p className="text-[#9BA8C0] leading-relaxed">
              {provider?.bio || 'Active NEAR resource provider.'}
            </p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 text-center">
              <div className="p-2 bg-[#06080F] rounded-lg">
                <span className="block text-[#9BA8C0]">Completed Lends</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#F5F8FF] text-sm tabular-nums">
                  {provider?.completedLends ?? 0}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2 bg-[#06080F] rounded-lg">
                <span className="block text-[#9BA8C0]">Completed Borrows</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#F5F8FF] text-sm tabular-nums">
                  {provider?.completedBorrows ?? 0}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2 bg-[#06080F] rounded-lg">
                <span className="block text-[#9BA8C0]">Disputes</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#00EC97] text-sm tabular-nums">
                  {provider?.disputesCount ?? 0}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ProductQrScannerModal
        isOpen={qrModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setQrModalOpen(false)}
        mode={qrModalMode}
        title={`Verify ${listing.brandAndModel || listing.title} on NEAR`}
        subtitle="Scan the physical item's QR tag or barcode using camera API to validate serial, specs, and anti-tamper marks against on-chain metadata."
        activeProductTag={{
          listingId: listing.id,
          title: listing.title,
          brandAndModel: listing.brandAndModel || listing.title,
          tinOrSerialNumber: listing.tinOrSerialNumber || 'TIN-SONY-A7IV-884120',
          category: listing.category,
          resourceType: listing.resourceType,
          officialRetailPriceUsd: listing.officialRetailPriceUsd,
        }}
        onScanSuccess={() => {
          setProductTrustVerified(true);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```
