```tsx
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Search,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  ArrowUpDown,
  Sparkles,
  Plus,
  Images,
  ArrowLeftRight,
  QrCode,
  Camera,
  Eye,
  TrendingUp,
  Star,
  MapPin,
  Globe,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { MarketplaceListing, ProviderProfile } from '../lib/security/policyEngine';
import { ResilientImage } from '../components/ResilientImage';
import { NearTokenIcon, UsdtTokenIcon } from '../components/TokenIcons';
import {
  ProductQrScannerModal,
  type ScannedProductQrPayload,
} from '../components/ProductQrScannerModal';
import {
  CountryBadge,
  CountryFlag,
  SameCountryIndicator,
} from '../components/CountryLocationComponents';
import {
  COUNTRY_CATALOG,
  evaluatePhysicalEligibility,
  getCountryFlagEmoji,
  getCountryName,
} from '../lib/location/countryLocationEngine';

interface MarketplaceViewProps {
  listings: MarketplaceListing[];
  profiles: Record<string, ProviderProfile>;
  connectedWallet?: string;
  initialCategory: 'ALL' | 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL';
  nearUsdRate?: number;
  displayCurrency?: 'NEAR' | 'USDT';
  onToggleCurrency?: (currency: 'NEAR' | 'USDT') => void;
  onOpenListing: (listingId: string) => void;
  onNavigateCreate: () => void;
  onOpenAiAgent: () => void;
}

export const MarketplaceView: React.FC<MarketplaceViewProps> = ({
  listings,
  profiles,
  connectedWallet = 'alex-builder.testnet',
  initialCategory,
  nearUsdRate = 3.7,
  displayCurrency = 'NEAR',
  onToggleCurrency,
  onOpenListing,
  onNavigateCreate,
  onOpenAiAgent,
}) => {
  const callerProfile = profiles[connectedWallet];
  const userCountryCode = (callerProfile?.countryCode || 'ET').toUpperCase();

  const [resourceFilter, setResourceFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'PHYSICAL' | 'DIGITAL'>(initialCategory);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('ALL');
  // Default physical listings to the authenticated user's country ("MY_COUNTRY"), with option to inspect ALL or specific countries
  const [countryFilter, setCountryFilter] = useState<string>('MY_COUNTRY');
  const [regionFilter, setRegionFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [cityFilter, setCityFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [maxFeeNear, setMaxFeeNear] = useState<number>(500);
  const [maxCollateralNear, setMaxCollateralNear] = useState<number>(1000);
  const [onlyAvailable, setOnlyAvailable] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [minCompletedDeals, setMinCompletedDeals] = useState<number>(0);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<
    'RELEVANCE' | 'PRICE_ASC' | 'COLLATERAL_ASC' | 'NEWEST' | 'POPULARITY'
  >('RELEVANCE');
  const [qrModalOpen, setQrModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [qrModalMode, setQrModalMode] = useState<'SCAN' | 'SHOW_TAG' | 'SPECS_CAPTURE' | 'TRUST_VERIFY'>('SCAN');
  const [activeQrListing, setActiveQrListing] = useState<MarketplaceListing | null>(null);

  const categories = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    listings.forEach((l) => set.add(l.category));
    return ['ALL', ...Array.from(set)];
  }, [listings]);

  const activePhysicalCountryCode =
    countryFilter === 'MY_COUNTRY'
      ? userCountryCode
      : countryFilter === 'ALL_COUNTRIES'
      ? null
      : countryFilter;

  const availableRegions = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    listings.forEach((l) => {
      if (l.resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' && l.regionName) {
        if (!activePhysicalCountryCode || l.countryCode?.toUpperCase() === activePhysicalCountryCode) {
          set.add(l.regionName);
        }
      }
    });
    return ['ALL', ...Array.from(set)];
  }, [listings, activePhysicalCountryCode]);

  const availableCities = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    listings.forEach((l) => {
      if (l.resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' && l.cityName) {
        if (!activePhysicalCountryCode || l.countryCode?.toUpperCase() === activePhysicalCountryCode) {
          if (regionFilter === 'ALL' || l.regionName === regionFilter) {
            set.add(l.cityName);
          }
        }
      }
    });
    return ['ALL', ...Array.from(set)];
  }, [listings, activePhysicalCountryCode, regionFilter]);

  const filteredListings = useMemo(() => {
    return listings
      .filter((item) => {
        if (resourceFilter !== 'ALL' && item.resourceType !== resourceFilter) return false;
        if (selectedCategory !== 'ALL' && item.category !== selectedCategory) return false;
        if (onlyAvailable && item.availabilityStatus !== 'AVAILABLE') return false;
        if (item.rentalFeeNear > maxFeeNear) return false;
        if (item.collateralNear > maxCollateralNear) return false;

        // Country, Region, and City filtering for PHYSICAL listings (DIGITAL remains globally available)
        if (item.resourceType === 'PHYSICAL') {
          const itemCountry = (
            item.countryCode ||
            profiles[item.ownerWallet]?.countryCode ||
            ''
          ).toUpperCase();
          if (activePhysicalCountryCode && itemCountry !== activePhysicalCountryCode) {
            return false;
          }
          if (regionFilter !== 'ALL' && item.regionName !== regionFilter) {
            return false;
          }
          if (cityFilter !== 'ALL' && item.cityName !== cityFilter) {
            return false;
          }
        }

        const prov = profiles[item.ownerWallet];
        const deals = (prov?.completedLends ?? 0) + (prov?.completedBorrows ?? 0);
        if (deals < minCompletedDeals) return false;

        if (searchQuery.trim()) {
          const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
          const hay = `${item.title} ${item.description} ${item.category} ${item.ownerWallet} ${item.countryName || ''} ${item.regionName || ''} ${item.cityName || ''} ${item.pickupArea || ''}`.toLowerCase();
          if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
        }
        return true;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortBy === 'POPULARITY') {
          return (b.viewsCount ?? 0) - (a.viewsCount ?? 0);
        }
        if (sortBy === 'PRICE_ASC') return a.rentalFeeNear - b.rentalFeeNear;
        if (sortBy === 'COLLATERAL_ASC') return a.collateralNear - b.collateralNear;
        if (sortBy === 'NEWEST') {
          return new Date(b.createdAtIso).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAtIso).getTime();
        }
        return 0;
      });
  }, [
    listings,
    profiles,
    resourceFilter,
    selectedCategory,
    activePhysicalCountryCode,
    regionFilter,
    cityFilter,
    onlyAvailable,
    maxFeeNear,
    maxCollateralNear,
    minCompletedDeals,
    searchQuery,
    sortBy,
  ]);

  const handleResetFilters = () => {
    setResourceFilter('ALL');
    setSearchQuery('');
    setSelectedCategory('ALL');
    setCountryFilter('MY_COUNTRY');
    setRegionFilter('ALL');
    setCityFilter('ALL');
    setMaxFeeNear(500);
    setMaxCollateralNear(1000);
    setOnlyAvailable(true);
    setMinCompletedDeals(0);
    setSortBy('RELEVANCE');
  };

  const formatAmount = (nearAmount: number) => {
    const usdt = Number((nearAmount * nearUsdRate).toFixed(2));
    if (displayCurrency === 'USDT') {
      return {
        primary: `${usdt.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} USDT`,
        secondary: `${nearAmount} NEAR`,
        isUsdtPrimary: true,
      };
    }
    return {
      primary: `${nearAmount} NEAR`,
      secondary: `≈ ${usdt.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} USDT`,
      isUsdtPrimary: false,
    };
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-8 space-y-8">
      {/* Header & Resource Type Switcher */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-end justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#27312A] pb-6">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold font-display text-[#F2F5F1]">
            Marketplace
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#A0AAA2]">
            Browse physical equipment in your country and globally available digital resources.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          {/* Segmented Resource Filter */}
          <div
            role="group"
            aria-label="Resource Type Filter"
            className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-[#101612]/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#27312A] rounded-full"
          >
            {(['ALL', 'PHYSICAL', 'DIGITAL'] as const).map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setResourceFilter(tab)}
                className={`px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer glass-nav-pill ${
                  resourceFilter === tab
                    ? 'glass-nav-pill-active text-[#8BD6A7]'
                    : 'text-[#A0AAA2] hover:text-[#F2F5F1]'
                }`}
              >
                {tab === 'ALL' ? 'All Resources' : tab === 'PHYSICAL' ? 'Physical' : 'Digital'}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {onToggleCurrency && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onToggleCurrency(displayCurrency === 'NEAR' ? 'USDT' : 'NEAR')}
              className="btn-near-secondary px-3 py-2 text-xs whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
            >
              {displayCurrency === 'NEAR' ? <NearTokenIcon size={14} /> : <UsdtTokenIcon size={14} />}
              <ArrowLeftRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#8BD6A7]" />
              <span>{displayCurrency}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveQrListing(listings[0] || null);
              setQrModalMode('TRUST_VERIFY');
              setQrModalOpen(true);
            }}
            className="btn-near-secondary px-3.5 py-2 text-xs whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#8BD6A7]" />
            <span>Verify QR</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenAiAgent}
            className="btn-near-secondary px-3.5 py-2 text-xs whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#8BD6A7]" />
            <span>AI Assistant</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onNavigateCreate}
            className="btn-near-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>List Item</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Bar */}
      <div className="near-glass-card rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <div className="md:col-span-2">
            <label htmlFor="mkt-search" className="block text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] mb-1.5">
              Search Keyword, Model Spec, or Provider
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#9BA8C0] absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
              <input
                id="mkt-search"
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search iPhone 18, camera, projector, weather API, GPU..."
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-xs bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF] placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00EC97]"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="mkt-category" className="block text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] mb-1.5">
              Category
            </label>
            <select
              id="mkt-category"
              value={selectedCategory}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedCategory(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00EC97]"
            >
              {categories.map((cat) => (
                <option key={cat} value={cat}>
                  {cat === 'ALL' ? 'All Categories' : cat}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="mkt-sort" className="block text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] mb-1.5">
              Sort By
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <ArrowUpDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#9BA8C0] absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
              <select
                id="mkt-sort"
                value={sortBy}
                onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as typeof sortBy)}
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-2 text-xs bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00EC97]"
              >
                <option value="RELEVANCE">Relevance</option>
                <option value="POPULARITY">Popularity: Most Viewed</option>
                <option value="PRICE_ASC">Rental Fee: Low to High</option>
                <option value="COLLATERAL_ASC">Collateral: Low to High</option>
                <option value="NEWEST">Newest Listed</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800/80 items-end">
          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
              <label htmlFor="mkt-max-fee" className="text-[#9BA8C0]">Max Rental Fee</label>
              <span className="font-mono text-[#F5F8FF] tabular-nums">
                {maxFeeNear} NEAR (${(maxFeeNear * nearUsdRate).toFixed(0)})
              </span>
            </div>
            <input
              id="mkt-max-fee"
              type="range"
              min="0.05"
              max="500"
              step="0.05"
              value={maxFeeNear}
              onChange={(e) => setMaxFeeNear(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full accent-[#00EC97] cursor-pointer"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
              <label htmlFor="mkt-max-col" className="text-[#9BA8C0]">Max Collateral</label>
              <span className="font-mono text-[#00EC97] tabular-nums">
                {maxCollateralNear} NEAR (${(maxCollateralNear * nearUsdRate).toFixed(0)})
              </span>
            </div>
            <input
              id="mkt-max-col"
              type="range"
              min="0.1"
              max="1000"
              step="0.5"
              value={maxCollateralNear}
              onChange={(e) => setMaxCollateralNear(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full accent-[#00EC97] cursor-pointer"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="mkt-min-rep" className="block text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] mb-1">
              Provider Completed Deals
            </label>
            <select
              id="mkt-min-rep"
              value={minCompletedDeals}
              onChange={(e) => setMinCompletedDeals(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF]"
            >
              <option value={0}>Any History (Include New Providers)</option>
              <option value={5}>5+ Completed Deals</option>
              <option value={15}>15+ Completed Deals</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#F5F8FF] cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={onlyAvailable}
                onChange={(e) => setOnlyAvailable(e.target.checked)}
                className="rounded accent-[#00EC97]"
              />
              <span>Available Only</span>
            </label>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleResetFilters}
              className="text-xs text-[#00EC97] hover:underline cursor-pointer"
            >
              Reset Filters
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Country, Region & City Physical Location Filters */}
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-800/80 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00EC97]" />
              <span className="font-bold text-[#F5F8FF]" data-testid="physical-country-filter-banner">
                {countryFilter === 'MY_COUNTRY'
                  ? `Physical items available in your country (${getCountryFlagEmoji(userCountryCode)} ${getCountryName(userCountryCode)})`
                  : countryFilter === 'ALL_COUNTRIES'
                  ? 'Viewing physical items across all countries (cross-country items show restriction alert)'
                  : `Filtering physical items in ${getCountryFlagEmoji(countryFilter)} ${getCountryName(countryFilter)}`}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-[#9BA8C0] hidden sm:inline">
                • Digital resources remain globally available
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                data-testid="toggle-all-countries-btn"
                onClick={() => {
                  setCountryFilter((prev) =>
                    prev === 'MY_COUNTRY' ? 'ALL_COUNTRIES' : 'MY_COUNTRY'
                  );
                  setRegionFilter('ALL');
                  setCityFilter('ALL');
                }}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#0D1322] border border-slate-700 hover:border-[#00EC97]/50 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#00EC97] cursor-pointer"
              >
                {countryFilter === 'MY_COUNTRY'
                  ? 'Browse All Countries (Inspect Cross-Country)'
                  : `Filter to My Country (${getCountryFlagEmoji(userCountryCode)} ${getCountryName(userCountryCode)})`}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="mkt-country" className="block text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] mb-1">
                Physical Item Country
              </label>
              <select
                id="mkt-country"
                value={countryFilter}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setCountryFilter(e.target.value);
                  setRegionFilter('ALL');
                  setCityFilter('ALL');
                }}
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF]"
              >
                <option value="MY_COUNTRY">
                  {getCountryFlagEmoji(userCountryCode)} Physical items available in your country ({getCountryName(userCountryCode)})
                </option>
                <option value="ALL_COUNTRIES">🌐 All Countries (Include Cross-Country Items)</option>
                {COUNTRY_CATALOG.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.code} value={c.code}>
                    {getCountryFlagEmoji(c.code)} {c.name} ({c.code})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="mkt-region" className="block text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] mb-1">
                Region / State / Province
              </label>
              <select
                id="mkt-region"
                value={regionFilter}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setRegionFilter(e.target.value);
                  setCityFilter('ALL');
                }}
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF]"
              >
                {availableRegions.map((reg) => (
                  <option key={reg} value={reg}>
                    {reg === 'ALL' ? 'All Regions' : reg}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="mkt-city" className="block text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] mb-1">
                City / Pickup Area
              </label>
              <select
                id="mkt-city"
                value={cityFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setCityFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-[#06080F] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[#F5F8FF]"
              >
                {availableCities.map((cty) => (
                  <option key={cty} value={cty}>
                    {cty === 'ALL' ? 'All Cities' : cty}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Results Count */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-[#9BA8C0]">
        <span>
          Showing <strong className="text-[#F5F8FF] font-mono tabular-nums">{filteredListings.length}</strong> of {listings.length} resources
        </span>
        <span className="font-mono inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <NearTokenIcon size={14} />
          <span>Live Market Rate:</span>
          <strong className="text-[#00EC97]">1 NEAR = {nearUsdRate.toFixed(2)} USDT</strong>
          <UsdtTokenIcon size={14} />
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Listing Grid or Empty State */}
      {filteredListings.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="near-glass-card rounded-2xl p-12 text-center space-y-4">
          <SlidersHorizontal className="w-8 h-8 text-[#00EC97] mx-auto" />
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold font-display text-[#F5F8FF]">
              No matching resources found
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] max-w-md mx-auto">
              Adjust your country/region filters or rental fee sliders, or reset filters to view all physical and digital offerings.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleResetFilters}
            className="btn-near-primary px-5 py-2.5 text-xs"
          >
            Reset All Filters
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {filteredListings.map((item) => {
            const prov = profiles[item.ownerWallet];
            const completedCount = (prov?.completedLends ?? 0) + (prov?.completedBorrows ?? 0);
            const totalRequiredNear = Number((item.rentalFeeNear + item.collateralNear).toFixed(4));
            const photoCount = item.images?.length || 1;
            const feeDisplay = formatAmount(item.rentalFeeNear);
            const colDisplay = formatAmount(item.collateralNear);
            const totalDisplay = formatAmount(totalRequiredNear);
            const eligibility = evaluatePhysicalEligibility({
              listing: item,
              borrowerProfile: callerProfile,
              lenderProfile: prov,
            });

            return (
              <article
                key={item.id}
                data-testid={`marketplace-card-${item.id}`}
                className="near-glass-card rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#00EC97]/40"
              >
                <div>
                  {/* Frosted Glass Image Frame */}
                  <div className="p-3 pb-0">
                    <div className="glass-image-frame relative aspect-4/3 w-full">
                      <ResilientImage
                        src={item.images?.[0] || item.imageUrl}
                        alt={item.title}
                        resourceType={item.resourceType}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                      />
                      <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-10 max-w-[68%]">
                        <CountryBadge
                          countryCode={item.resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? item.countryCode || prov?.countryCode : undefined}
                          countryName={item.countryName || prov?.countryName}
                          regionName={item.regionName || prov?.regionName}
                          cityName={item.cityName || prov?.cityName}
                          pickupArea={item.pickupArea}
                          compact={true}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 z-10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#06080F]/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-700/80 text-[11px] font-mono text-[#F5F8FF] flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Images className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00EC97]" />
                        <span>{photoCount} {photoCount === 1 ? 'Photo' : 'Photos'}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="p-5 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1.5 text-xs text-[#9BA8C0]">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-bold text-[#00EC97]">
                          {item.resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' ? 'Physical' : 'Digital'}
                        </span>
                        <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                        <span>{item.category}</span>
                      </div>
                      <SameCountryIndicator listing={item} eligibility={eligibility} />
                    </div>

                    <h2 className="text-base font-bold font-display text-[#F5F8FF] line-clamp-1">
                      {item.title}
                    </h2>

                    {item.resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[#E6EDF7] bg-[#0B101C] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/8">
                        <CountryFlag countryCode={item.countryCode || prov?.countryCode} />
                        <span className="truncate font-medium">
                          {item.countryName || getCountryName(item.countryCode || prov?.countryCode)} ·{' '}
                          {item.regionName || prov?.regionName || 'Region'} ·{' '}
                          {item.pickupArea || item.cityName || prov?.cityName || 'City'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <p className="text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                      {item.description}
                    </p>

                    <div className="text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] pt-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="truncate max-w-[180px]">
                        Provider: <code className="font-mono text-[#F5F8FF]">{item.ownerWallet}</code>
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{completedCount} deals</span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Views & Booking Conversion & Reputation Rating Strip */}
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono">
                          <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#5EEAD4]" />
                          <span>{(item.viewsCount ?? 120).toLocaleString()} views</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[#00EC97]">
                          <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>{item.bookingConversionRate ?? 95}% conv</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono font-semibold text-[#FBBF24]">
                        <Star className="w-3 h-3 fill-[#FBBF24] text-[#FBBF24]" />
                        <span>{item.averageRating?.toFixed(1) ?? '5.0'}</span>
                        <span className="text-[#A4B0C4] font-normal text-[10px]">({item.ratingsCount ?? 12})</span>
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Distinct Rental Fee vs Refundable Collateral Breakdown in NEAR & USDT with 2D Icons */}
                <div className="p-5 pt-4 border-t border-slate-800/80 bg-[#06080F]/60 space-y-3">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[#9BA8C0] block">
                        Rental Fee ({item.exampleDuration} {item.durationUnit.toLowerCase()})
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#F5F8FF] text-sm tabular-nums inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                        {feeDisplay.isUsdtPrimary ? <UsdtTokenIcon size={15} /> : <NearTokenIcon size={15} />}
                        <span>{feeDisplay.primary}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#9BA8C0] tabular-nums block">
                        {feeDisplay.secondary}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[#9BA8C0] block">Refundable Collateral</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#00EC97] text-sm tabular-nums inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                        {colDisplay.isUsdtPrimary ? <UsdtTokenIcon size={15} /> : <NearTokenIcon size={15} />}
                        <span>{colDisplay.primary}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#17F1D1] tabular-nums block">
                        {colDisplay.secondary}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[#9BA8C0] pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/60">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span>Total Lock:</span>
                      <strong className="text-[#F5F8FF] font-mono tabular-nums">{totalDisplay.primary}</strong>
                    </span>
                    <span>{item.minDuration}–{item.maxDuration} {item.durationUnit.toLowerCase()}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onOpenListing(item.id)}
                      className="btn-near-primary flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 text-xs"
                    >
                      View {photoCount}-Photo Gallery & Borrow
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      title="Authenticate Physical Product Specs via Camera QR"
                      aria-label={`Verify Product QR for ${item.title}`}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setActiveQrListing(item);
                        setQrModalMode('TRUST_VERIFY');
                        setQrModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      className="btn-near-secondary py-2.5 px-3 text-xs shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00EC97]" />
                      <span className="hidden sm:inline text-[11px]">Verify QR</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <ProductQrScannerModal
        isOpen={qrModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setQrModalOpen(false)}
        mode={qrModalMode}
        title="Scan or Inspect BorrowBond Product QR Tag"
        subtitle="Scan any BorrowBond product QR code or serial barcode to open its listing or verify its Anti-Scam TIN."
        activeProductTag={
          activeQrListing
            ? {
                listingId: activeQrListing.id,
                title: activeQrListing.title,
                brandAndModel: activeQrListing.brandAndModel || activeQrListing.title,
                tinOrSerialNumber:
                  activeQrListing.tinOrSerialNumber || 'TIN-SONY-A7IV-884120',
                category: activeQrListing.category,
                resourceType: activeQrListing.resourceType,
                officialRetailPriceUsd: activeQrListing.officialRetailPriceUsd,
              }
            : undefined
        }
        onScanSuccess={(scanned: ScannedProductQrPayload) => {
          if (scanned.listingId) {
            const matched = listings.find((l) => l.id === scanned.listingId);
            if (matched) {
              onOpenListing(matched.id);
              return;
            }
          }
          const matchedByTin = listings.find(
            (l) =>
              l.tinOrSerialNumber?.toLowerCase() === scanned.tinOrSerialNumber.toLowerCase() ||
              l.title.toLowerCase().includes(scanned.title.toLowerCase().slice(0, 10))
          );
          if (matchedByTin) {
            onOpenListing(matchedByTin.id);
          } else {
            setResourceFilter('ALL');
            setSearchQuery(scanned.title.split('—')[0].trim());
          }
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

```tsx
  const [nowMs, setNowMs] = useState<number>(Date.now());

    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);

  const lateCalc = calculateLateDueDateInterest(booking, new Date(nowMs).toISOString());

  const formatCountdownDigits = (ms: number) => {
    const totalSecs = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000));
    const days = Math.floor(totalSecs / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((totalSecs % 86400) / 3600);
    const mins = Math.floor((totalSecs % 3600) / 60);
    const secs = totalSecs % 60;
    return {
      days: String(days).padStart(2, '0'),
      hours: String(hours).padStart(2, '0'),
      mins: String(mins).padStart(2, '0'),
      secs: String(secs).padStart(2, '0'),
    };
  };

  const activeDurationMs = lateCalc.isOverdue ? lateCalc.overdueMs : lateCalc.remainingMs;
  const countdownDigits = formatCountdownDigits(activeDurationMs);

  // Review & Rating State for Completed Transactions
  const [ratingScore, setRatingScore] = useState<number>(5);
  const [selectedReviewTags, setSelectedReviewTags] = useState<string[]>([
    'Punctual Handover',
    'Flawless Condition',
    'Original Serial Verified',
  ]);
  const [reviewComment, setReviewComment] = useState<string>('');
  const [submittingReview, setSubmittingReview] = useState<boolean>(false);

          callerWallet: connectedWallet,
          rating: ratingScore,
          tags: selectedReviewTags,
          comment: reviewComment.trim(),
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setActionError(data.error || 'Failed to publish review');
      } else {
        setActionSuccess(`Published ${ratingScore}★ verified review to BorrowBond on-chain reputation ledger!`);
        await onRefreshState();

  return (

      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-[#172338] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">

                            setHandoverChecklist((p) => ({ ...p, bodyAndOpticsInspected: e.target.checked }))
                          }
                          className="accent-[#00EC97]"
                        />
                        <span>Physical chassis &amp; optics free of undisclosed defects</span>
                      </label>
                      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#A4B0C4] cursor-pointer">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={handoverChecklist.accessoriesIncluded}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            setHandoverChecklist((p) => ({ ...p, accessoriesIncluded: e.target.checked }))
                          }
                          className="accent-[#00EC97]"
                        />
                        <span>Included cables, case &amp; accessories present</span>
                      </label>
                      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#A4B0C4] cursor-pointer">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={handoverChecklist.beforePhotoCaptured}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            setHandoverChecklist((p) => ({ ...p, beforePhotoCaptured: e.target.checked }))
                          }
                          className="accent-[#00EC97]"
                        />
                        <span>Before-handover photo SHA-256 logged on agreement</span>
                      </label>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={busy || (!isLender && !isBorrower)}
                      onClick={() =>
                        callBookingAction(
                          'handover',
                          { callerWallet: connectedWallet },
                          `Handover / receipt confirmed by ${connectedWallet}.`
                        )
                      }
                      className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-[#5EEAD4] text-[#0B1020] hover:bg-[#5EEAD4]/90 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {isBorrower
                        ? `Confirm Borrower Received Product (${connectedWallet})`
                        : `Confirm Lender Handed Over Product (${connectedWallet})`}
                    </button>
                    <span className="text-xs text-[#A4B0C4]">
                      Lender Handover: {booking.lenderHandoverConfirmed ? 'Confirmed' : 'Pending'} · Borrower Got Product:{' '}
                      {booking.borrowerHandoverConfirmed ? 'Confirmed' : 'Pending'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {booking.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                <>
                  {booking.resourceType === 'PHYSICAL' && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={busy || !isBorrower}
                      onClick={() =>
                        callBookingAction(
                          'request-return',
                          { callerWallet: connectedWallet },
                          'Return initiated by borrower. Awaiting lender TIN/serial inspection confirmation.'
                        )
                      }
                      className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer ${
                        isBorrower
                          ? 'bg-[#5EEAD4] text-[#0B1020] hover:bg-[#5EEAD4]/90'
                          : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed'
                      }`}
                    >
                      Initiate Product Return (Borrower: {booking.borrower})
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {booking.resourceType === 'DIGITAL' && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={busy || (!isBorrower && !isLender)}
                      onClick={() =>
                        callBookingAction(
                          'confirm-return',
                          { callerWallet: connectedWallet },
                          `Digital return & completion confirmed by ${connectedWallet}.`
                        )
                      }
                      className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-[#5EEAD4] text-[#0B1020] hover:bg-[#5EEAD4]/90 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Confirm Digital Asset Return &amp; Release Escrow ({connectedWallet})
                    </button>
                  )}
                </>
              )}

              {booking.status === 'RETURN_REQUESTED' && (
                <div className="w-full space-y-3">
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 space-y-2 text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <label htmlFor="verify-tin" className="block text-[#A4B0C4]">
                        Verify Returned Item TIN / Serial Matches Registry ({booking.productIdentity?.tinOrSerialNumber}):
                      </label>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setQrModalMode('SCAN');
                          setQrModalOpen(true);
                        }}
                        className="btn-near-secondary px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px]"
                      >
                        <ScanLine className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00EC97]" />
                        <span>Scan Product QR to Verify TIN</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <input
                      id="verify-tin"
                      type="text"
                      value={verifiedReturnTin}
                      onChange={(e) => setVerifiedReturnTin(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 font-mono bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-700 rounded text-[#00EC97]"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={busy || !isLender}
                    onClick={() =>
                      callBookingAction(
                        'confirm-return',
                        {
                          callerWallet: connectedWallet,
                          verifiedTinOrSerial: verifiedReturnTin.trim(),
                        },
                        'Safe return & matching TIN confirmed! Rental fee released to lender and 100% of collateral refunded to borrower.'
                      )
                    }
                    className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer ${
                      isLender
                        ? 'bg-[#34D399] text-[#0B1020] hover:bg-[#34D399]/90'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed'
                    }`}
                  >
                    Confirm Safe Return &amp; Release Escrow (Lender: {booking.lender})
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
              Locked collateral (<strong className="text-[#F3F6FC]">{booking.collateralNear} NEAR</strong>) cannot be touched by either party until return is confirmed or the BorrowBond Team resolves a dispute.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Physical Condition Record & Supporting Evidence Upload */}
          <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <FileCheck2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#5EEAD4]" />
                <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F3F6FC]">
                  Condition Evidence &amp; SHA-256 Hashes ({booking.evidence.length})
                </h2>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">On-chain hash audit trail</span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {booking.evidence.map((ev) => (
                <div
                  key={ev.id}
                  className="p-3.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 text-xs space-y-1"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-[#5EEAD4]">{ev.stage}</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
                      By {ev.uploaderWallet} · {new Date(ev.timestampIso).toLocaleTimeString()}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[#F3F6FC]">{ev.conditionNotes}</p>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#A4B0C4] truncate">
                    File: {ev.fileReference} · SHA-256: {ev.contentSha256Hash}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {(isBorrower || isLender) && (
              <form onSubmit={handleUploadEvidence} className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3 text-xs">
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-[#F3F6FC]">Log Condition Evidence</h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label htmlFor="ev-stage" className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1">Stage</label>
                    <select
                      id="ev-stage"
                      value={evidenceStage}
                      onChange={(e) => setEvidenceStage(e.target.value as typeof evidenceStage)}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-[#F3F6FC]"
                    >
                      <option value="HANDOVER_BEFORE">Before Handover Inspection</option>
                      <option value="RETURN_AFTER">Return Condition Inspection</option>
                      <option value="DISPUTE_EVIDENCE">Dispute Supporting Evidence</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label htmlFor="ev-file" className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1">Photograph / File Reference</label>
                    <input
                      id="ev-file"
                      type="text"
                      value={evidenceFileRef}
                      onChange={(e) => setEvidenceFileRef(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 font-mono bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-[#F3F6FC]"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="ev-notes" className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1">Condition Notes *</label>
                  <input
                    id="ev-notes"
                    type="text"
                    value={evidenceNotes}
                    onChange={(e) => setEvidenceNotes(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Verified TIN serial and inspected body..."
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-[#F3F6FC]"
                  />
                </div>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={busy}
                  className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-[#172338] text-[#F3F6FC] border border-slate-700 hover:border-[#5EEAD4] flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Record Condition Evidence</span>
                </button>
              </form>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Mutual Damage Settlement & BorrowBond Team Arbitration Panel */}
          {(booking.status === 'ACTIVE' ||
            booking.status === 'RETURN_REQUESTED' ||
            booking.status === 'DISPUTED' ||
            booking.status === 'RESOLVED') && (
            <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Scale className="w-4 h-4 text-[#FBBF24]" />
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F3F6FC]">
                    Damage Settlement Negotiation &amp; Arbitration
                  </h2>
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[#A4B0C4]">
                  Arbiter: {designatedResolver}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* 48-Hour Post-Return Lender Response Window */}
              {booking.status === 'RETURN_REQUESTED' && booking.lenderResponseDeadlineIso && (
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-[#5EEAD4]/40 text-xs flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="space-y-0.5">
                    <strong className="text-[#5EEAD4] block">
                      48-Hour Post-Return Lender Inspection Window Active
                    </strong>
                    <span className="text-[#A4B0C4]">
                      Lender deadline: {new Date(booking.lenderResponseDeadlineIso).toUTCString()}. If uncontested after 48h, anyone can finalize return on-chain (`finalize_uncontested_return`).
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={busy}
                    onClick={() =>
                      callBookingAction(
                        'finalize-uncontested-return',
                        { callerWallet: connectedWallet },
                        '48-hour uncontested return finalized on-chain! Rental fee credited to lender and net collateral refunded to borrower.'
                      )
                    }
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#172338] border border-[#5EEAD4]/50 text-[#5EEAD4] hover:bg-[#5EEAD4]/15 font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Finalize Uncontested Return (48h)
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Two-Party Mutual Damage Proposal & Counterparty Acceptance */}
              {(booking.status === 'ACTIVE' ||
                booking.status === 'RETURN_REQUESTED' ||
                booking.status === 'DISPUTED') && (
                <div className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 space-y-3 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <strong className="text-[#F3F6FC]">
                      Two-Party Mutual Damage Settlement (`propose_damage_settlement` / `accept_damage_proposal`)
                    </strong>
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#5EEAD4]">
                      Counterparty Signature Required
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[#A4B0C4]">
                    Neither party can unilaterally deduct collateral. Either borrower or lender may propose a damage deduction capped at <code className="font-mono text-[#F3F6FC]">collateral - 1% platform fee</code>, which only executes if the counterparty explicitly signs and accepts.
                  </p>

                  {booking.damageProposal && booking.damageProposal.status === 'PENDING' ? (
                    <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#121B2C] border border-[#FBBF24]/40 space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-[#FBBF24]">
                          Pending Damage Proposal: {booking.damageProposal.proposedDamageNear} NEAR
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
                          Proposed by {booking.damageProposal.proposedByWallet}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[#F3F6FC]">&ldquo;{booking.damageProposal.reason}&rdquo;</p>
                      {(isBorrower || isLender) && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                          {connectedWallet !== booking.damageProposal.proposedByWallet && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={busy}
                              onClick={() =>
                                callBookingAction(
                                  'accept-damage',
                                  { callerWallet: connectedWallet },
                                  `Mutual damage proposal (${booking.damageProposal?.proposedDamageNear} NEAR) accepted by ${connectedWallet} and settled on-chain!`
                                )
                              }
                              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#00EC97] text-[#04080E] font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              Sign &amp; Accept Proposal ({booking.damageProposal.proposedDamageNear} NEAR)
                            </button>
                          )}
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={busy}
                            onClick={() =>
                              callBookingAction(
                                'reject-damage',
                                {
                                  callerWallet: connectedWallet,
                                  rejectionReason: 'Counterparty declined proposed damage amount.',
                                },
                                'Damage proposal rejected.'
                              )
                            }
                            className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#F87171]/15 border border-[#F87171]/40 text-[#F87171] font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Reject Proposal
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    (isBorrower || isLender) && (
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          step="0.01"
                          min="0"
                          max={booking.collateralNear}
                          value={damageDeductionNear}
                          onChange={(e) => setDamageDeductionNear(e.target.value)}
                          className="w-28 px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-700 rounded text-[#F3F6FC]"
                          aria-label="Proposed damage amount in NEAR"
                        />
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={busy}
                          onClick={() =>
                            callBookingAction(
                              'propose-damage',
                              {
                                callerWallet: connectedWallet,
                                proposedDamageNear: parsedDamage,
                                reason:
                                  disputeReason.trim() ||
                                  `Proposed mutual damage settlement of ${parsedDamage} NEAR based on return condition inspection.`,
                              },
                              `Proposed ${parsedDamage} NEAR mutual damage settlement. Waiting for counterparty wallet signature.`
                            )
                          }
                          className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#172338] border border-[#5EEAD4]/50 text-[#5EEAD4] hover:bg-[#5EEAD4]/15 font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          Propose {parsedDamage} NEAR Mutual Damage Settlement
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {(booking.status === 'ACTIVE' || booking.status === 'RETURN_REQUESTED') && (
                <form onSubmit={handleOpenDispute} className="space-y-3 text-xs">
                  <p className="text-[#A4B0C4]">
                    If the item is damaged, swapped, or unreturned after the deadline, open a dispute so the BorrowBond Team can review with both parties and deduct repair costs from the locked <strong className="text-[#F3F6FC]">{booking.collateralNear} NEAR</strong> collateral.
                  </p>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={disputeReason}
                    onChange={(e) => setDisputeReason(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Describe damage or serial mismatch for BorrowBond Team review..."
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-[#F3F6FC]"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={busy}
                    className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-[#F87171]/15 text-[#F87171] border border-[#F87171]/40 hover:bg-[#F87171]/25 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Open Dispute &amp; Freeze Escrow</span>
                  </button>
                </form>
              )}

              {booking.status === 'DISPUTED' && (
                <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg bg-[#F87171]/10 border border-[#F87171]/30 text-[#F3F6FC] space-y-1">
                    <div className="font-semibold text-[#F87171]">
                      Dispute OPEN — {booking.totalEscrowedNear} NEAR Locked in Escrow
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[#A4B0C4]">
                      Opened by <code className="font-mono">{booking.dispute?.openedByWallet}</code>: &ldquo;{booking.dispute?.reason}&rdquo;
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Side-by-Side Before Handover vs. After Return Evidence Comparison */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 space-y-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#00EC97] block">
                        Before Handover Evidence
                      </span>
                      {booking.evidence.find((e) => e.stage === 'HANDOVER_BEFORE') ? (
                        <>
                          <p className="text-[#F3F6FC] font-medium">
                            {booking.evidence.find((e) => e.stage === 'HANDOVER_BEFORE')?.conditionNotes}
                          </p>
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#A4B0C4] truncate">
                            File: {booking.evidence.find((e) => e.stage === 'HANDOVER_BEFORE')?.fileReference}
                          </div>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="text-[#A4B0C4]">
                          Baseline TIN Registry: {booking.productIdentity?.tinOrSerialNumber || 'Verified clean at pickup'}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-[#FBBF24]/40 space-y-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#FBBF24] block">
                        Return / Dispute Evidence
                      </span>
                      {booking.evidence.find((e) => e.stage !== 'HANDOVER_BEFORE') ? (
                        <>
                          <p className="text-[#F3F6FC] font-medium">
                            {booking.evidence.find((e) => e.stage !== 'HANDOVER_BEFORE')?.conditionNotes}
                          </p>
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#A4B0C4] truncate">
                            File: {booking.evidence.find((e) => e.stage !== 'HANDOVER_BEFORE')?.fileReference}
                          </div>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="text-[#F3F6FC]">
                          Claim: &ldquo;{booking.dispute?.reason || 'Pending post-return inspection notes'}&rdquo;
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* BorrowBond Team Damage Deduction Calculator */}
                  <form onSubmit={handleResolveDispute} className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-[#F3F6FC]">
                        BorrowBond Team Damage Deduction (`resolve_dispute_with_damage_deduction`)
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#00EC97]">
                        Total Locked: {booking.totalEscrowedNear} NEAR
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <label htmlFor="res-damage" className="block text-[#FBBF24] font-semibold mb-1">
                          Assessed Damage Cost (NEAR)
                        </label>
                        <input
                          id="res-damage"
                          type="number"
                          step="0.01"
                          min="0"
                          max={booking.collateralNear}
                          value={damageDeductionNear}
                          onChange={(e) => setDamageDeductionNear(e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 font-mono bg-[#121B2C] border border-[#FBBF24]/50 rounded text-[#F3F6FC]"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1">
                          Lender Payout (Fee + Damage)
                        </span>
                        <div className="px-3 py-1.5 font-mono font-bold bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded text-[#00EC97]">
                          {calculatedLenderPayout} NEAR
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1">
                          Borrower Refund (Left Collateral)
                        </span>
                        <div className="px-3 py-1.5 font-mono font-bold bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded text-[#5EEAD4]">
                          {calculatedBorrowerRefund} NEAR
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label htmlFor="res-notes" className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1">
                        BorrowBond Team Decision Notes
                      </label>
                      <input
                        id="res-notes"
                        type="text"
                        value={resolverOutcomeNotes}
                        onChange={(e) => setResolverOutcomeNotes(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-700 rounded text-[#F3F6FC]"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      disabled={busy || !isResolver}
                      className={`w-full py-2.5 px-4 font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer ${
                        isResolver
                          ? 'bg-[#00EC97] text-[#04080E] hover:bg-[#00EC97]/90'
                          : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isResolver
                        ? `Confirm Deal: Send ${calculatedLenderPayout} NEAR to Lender & Refund ${calculatedBorrowerRefund} NEAR to Borrower`
                        : `Switch Wallet to ${designatedResolver} to Resolve`}
                    </button>
                  </form>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Right 5 Columns: Payment Breakdown & Chronological Event Timeline */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-3 text-xs">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F3F6FC]">
              Escrow Accounting Summary
            </h2>
            <div className="flex justify-between py-1">
              <span className="text-[#A4B0C4]">Agreed Rental Fee</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-[#F3F6FC] tabular-nums">
                {booking.rentalFeeNear} NEAR
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between py-1">
              <span className="text-[#A4B0C4]">Refundable Collateral</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-[#5EEAD4] tabular-nums">
                {booking.collateralNear} NEAR
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between py-1">
              <span className="text-[#A4B0C4]">
                Platform Fee Snapshot ({typeof booking.feeBpsSnapshot === 'number' ? booking.feeBpsSnapshot / 100 : 1}% of Collateral on Active Completion)
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[#A4B0C4] tabular-nums">
                {booking.platformFeeNear ?? Number((booking.collateralNear * 0.01).toFixed(4))} NEAR
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-t border-slate-800 pt-2">
              <span className="text-[#F3F6FC] font-semibold">Currently Locked in Contract</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#F3F6FC] tabular-nums">
                {booking.totalEscrowedNear} NEAR
              </span>
            </div>

            {booking.settlement && (
              <div className="mt-3 p-3.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-[#34D399]/40 space-y-1">
                <span className="text-[#34D399] font-semibold block">
                  Final Settlement Recorded on NEAR Testnet
                </span>
                <div className="flex justify-between font-mono">
                  <span>Lender Credited:</span>
                  <span>{booking.settlement.lenderPayoutNear} NEAR</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between font-mono">
                  <span>Borrower Refunded:</span>
                  <span>{booking.settlement.borrowerRefundNear} NEAR</span>
                </div>
                {typeof booking.settlement.platformFeeNear === 'number' &&
                  booking.settlement.platformFeeNear > 0 && (
                    <div className="flex justify-between font-mono text-[#5EEAD4]">
                      <span>Treasury Fee (treasury.borrowbond.testnet):</span>
                      <span>{booking.settlement.platformFeeNear} NEAR</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                {typeof booking.settlement.damageDeductionNear === 'number' &&
                  booking.settlement.damageDeductionNear > 0 && (
                    <div className="flex justify-between font-mono text-[#FBBF24]">
                      <span>Deducted Damage Cost:</span>
                      <span>{booking.settlement.damageDeductionNear} NEAR</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                <p className="text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4] pt-1">
                  {booking.settlement.resolutionNote}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Reputation Review & Rating Component for Completed Transactions */}
          {(booking.status === 'COMPLETED' || booking.status === 'RESOLVED') && (
            <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-[#00EC97]/30 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-[#FBBF24]" />
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F3F6FC]">
                    Agreement Review &amp; Reputation
                  </h2>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#00EC97]/15 text-[#00EC97] font-bold">
                  Verified Completion
                </span>
              </div>

              {booking.review ? (
                <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 space-y-3 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((star) => (
                        <Star
                          key={star}
                          className={`w-4 h-4 ${
                            star <= booking.review!.rating
                              ? 'text-[#FBBF24] fill-[#FBBF24]'
                              : 'text-slate-600'
                          }`}
                        />
                      ))}
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#F3F6FC] ml-1">
                        {booking.review.rating}.0 / 5.0
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4]">
                      {new Date(booking.review.createdAtIso).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-[#F3F6FC] italic leading-relaxed">
                    &ldquo;{booking.review.comment || 'Verified agreement completed satisfactorily.'}&rdquo;
                  </p>

                  {booking.review.tags && booking.review.tags.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
                      {booking.review.tags.map((tag) => (
                        <span
                          key={tag}
                          className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-[#172338] text-[#5EEAD4] border border-slate-700 font-mono"
                        >
                          #{tag}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-[#A4B0C4] font-mono">
                    <span>By: {booking.review.reviewerWallet} ({booking.review.reviewerRole})</span>
                    <span>For: {booking.review.revieweeWallet}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : isBorrower || isLender ? (
                <form onSubmit={handleSubmitReview} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <p className="text-[#A4B0C4]">
                    Rate your experience with{' '}
                    <strong className="text-[#F3F6FC]">
                      {isBorrower ? `Lender (${booking.lender})` : `Borrower (${booking.borrower})`}
                    </strong>{' '}
                    to build on-chain trust and marketplace reputation.
                  </p>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1.5 font-medium">
                      Select Rating (1 to 5 Stars):
                    </label>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((star) => (
                        <button
                          key={star}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setRatingScore(star)}
                          className="p-1 rounded hover:scale-110 transition-transform cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <Star
                            className={`w-6 h-6 transition-colors ${
                              star <= ratingScore
                                ? 'text-[#FBBF24] fill-[#FBBF24]'
                                : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-amber-300'
                            }`}
                          />
                        </button>
                      ))}
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#FBBF24] text-sm ml-2">
                        {ratingScore} / 5 Stars
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1.5 font-medium">
                      Reputation Highlights:
                    </label>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {[
                        'Punctual Handover',
                        'Flawless Condition',
                        'Original Serial Verified',
                        'Smooth Communication',
                        'Safe Return',
                        'Great Provider',
                      ].map((tag) => {
                        const isSelected = selectedReviewTags.includes(tag);
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={tag}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => toggleReviewTag(tag)}
                            className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                              isSelected
                                ? 'bg-[#00EC97]/20 border-[#00EC97] text-[#00EC97]'
                                : 'bg-[#0B1020] border-slate-800 text-[#A4B0C4] hover:border-slate-700'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isSelected && <Check className="w-3 h-3 inline mr-1" />}
                            {tag}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label htmlFor="rev-comment" className="block text-[#A4B0C4] mb-1 font-medium">
                      Review Comment:
                    </label>
                    <textarea
                      id="rev-comment"
                      rows={2}
                      value={reviewComment}
                      onChange={(e) => setReviewComment(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Share condition, promptness, and handover experience..."
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-[#F3F6FC] placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:border-[#00EC97] outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={submittingReview}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 font-semibold rounded-lg bg-[#00EC97] text-[#04080E] hover:bg-[#00EC97]/90 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-[#00EC97]/10"
                  >
                    <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>
                      {submittingReview ? 'Publishing Review...' : 'Publish Verified Review to Escrow'}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </form>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800 text-xs text-[#A4B0C4]">
                  Awaiting review publication by {booking.borrower} or {booking.lender}.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Transaction Timeline */}
          <div className="bg-[#121B2C] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold font-display text-[#F3F6FC]">
              Verifiable Agreement Timeline
            </h2>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {booking.timeline.map((evt) => (
                <div
                  key={evt.id}
                  className="p-3.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-slate-800/80 text-xs space-y-1"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-[#F3F6FC]">{evt.title}</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#5EEAD4]">{evt.status}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[#A4B0C4] leading-relaxed">{evt.detail}</p>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#A4B0C4] pt-1 flex justify-between">
                    <span>Actor: {evt.actor}</span>
                    <span>{new Date(evt.timestampIso).toLocaleString()}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ProductQrScannerModal
        isOpen={qrModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setQrModalOpen(false)}
        mode={qrModalMode}
        title="Scan Product QR to Verify Anti-Scam TIN & Handover"
        subtitle="Scan the BorrowBond QR tag or serial sticker on the returned/handed-over item to verify it matches the on-chain agreement."
        activeProductTag={{
          listingId: booking.listingId,
          title: booking.listingTitle,
          brandAndModel: booking.productIdentity?.brandAndModel || booking.listingTitle,
          tinOrSerialNumber:
            booking.productIdentity?.tinOrSerialNumber || 'TIN-SONY-A7IV-884120',
          resourceType: booking.resourceType,
          oneTimeHandoverCode: booking.oneTimeHandoverCode,
          contractAddress: booking.contractAddress,
        }}
        onScanSuccess={(scanned: ScannedProductQrPayload) => {
          setVerifiedReturnTin(scanned.tinOrSerialNumber);
          setEvidenceNotes(
            `Scanned & verified Product QR Tag: ${scanned.brandAndModel} (${scanned.tinOrSerialNumber})`
          );
          setActionSuccess(
            `Product QR Code Scanned & Verified: ${scanned.brandAndModel} — TIN/Serial [${scanned.tinOrSerialNumber}] matches BorrowBond Anti-Scam Registry!`
          );
          setActionError(null);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```
